༄tsho/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod bco lnga pa bzhugs so//
lge/ /gter spon chen po rig 'dzin chong kyi lem 'pha can nam rig 'dzin ngangos gab rgyal mtshan mi/ bod rab byung drug pa'i me glang loga / tsho / / / / sa / da su / / / / / ༄ / /g.yas ru stod byang ga zang zang lha brag gi 'dabs rol ri rgyal bkra bzang gi mdun du bkra shos pa' ltas bcas sku 'khrungs/ thugs rigs sad de zab mo baspungs 'dra'am lha brag nas bod khams bde zhing mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i chos skor rnams bse sgrom smug rya mdzod lnga'i nang nas rdzogs chen kun bzang dgobyung ba chos tshan brgya phrag lnga lhag spyan drangs shing shog ser las gtan la phab nas skal ldan las can rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad/ de bzhin gu ru padma'inai ba gnang nga/ 4 ba3da 'dzin ni sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po dang sdim mtshan ldan ma spruX pa'i 〉spra sbyin/ kun spaX don sbyod rgyal mtshan sogs thugazi kyi
༄༅/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /'phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam bco lnga pa'i nang bzhugs/ nub zangs dmar po nas byon pa'i rten 'brel gyi chos bdun skor pod gcig bzhugs pa la/ rten 'brel chos bdun gyi thems byang /2 (1) dbang chen yongs rdzogs kyi thems byang /6 (5) 'od dpag med ye shes rang gsal gyi sgrub thabs/3 (17) thugs rje chen po me long mthong grol gyi sgrub thabs/4 (23) rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi sgrub thabs/6 (31) rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi 'phrin las dgos 'dod kun 'byung /6 (43) rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang chog3 (55) dbang chen rtsa ba'i lo rgyus/4 (61) rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi phrin las/8(69) sngon 'gro'i byin rlabs snying gi ti ga3 (85) rta mgrin 'khor 'das dbang sdud kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/4 (91) lha chen 'od rgyus bsnyen pa'i tshad bstan pa/3 (99) o rgyan padma'i sgrub pa gnyen po stobs kyi sgrub pa/3 (105) lha chen rjes gnang zab mo/5 (111) dbang phyug chen po'i mchod pa'i 'phrin las 'jig rten dbang sdud bya ba/6 (121) lha chen ma hā dhe wa'i man ngag skor rnams tshang bar 7 (133)
lha chen ma hā dhe ba yab yum gyi 31ga 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod/6 (147) dbang sdud zab mo'i las mtha'/8 (159) lha chen ma hā dhe ba'i yang khol gyi sgrub pa zhal khrigs bla rdo bca' ba gnad dbab gegs sel / 7 (175) lha chen dbang phyug chen po bsod nams dpal 'bar gyi dbang chog4 (189) ma hā dhe wa'i sngags kyi thems yig3 (197) ma hā dhe wa'i bsam rgyud ar la gtad pa zer ba/4 (203) lha chen ma hā dhe wa'i las tshogs sgrub thabs/11 (211)sgrub thabs las kyi phreng ba/7 (233) u ma dhe ba'i sgrub thabs khyad par can/5 (247) dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/9 (257) rdo rje thogs med kyis gsungs pa'i ma hā dhe ba rlung gi zhags pa'i dbang sdud sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs/8 (275) lha chen srog 'khor rgyas pa/3 (291) lha chen ma hā dhe ba'i mchod bskul/3 (297) ma hā dhe ba las shi sa bstan pa'i man ngag2 (303) 3(gas chog gnad kyi ti ka zhes bya ba gsal ba/2 (307) gsang ba yang 9rdzol dang sngags byang thems yig5 (311) gnyan chen thang lha'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa las 'o1 rgyus/2 (321) lha chen thang lha'i phyi sgrub/5 (325) lha chen thang lha'i gsang sgrub/6 (335) lha chen thang lha'i las tshogs gsang sgrub therdzog dril/11 (347) gnyan chen thang lha'i mchod phreng las bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba/3 (369)
༄༅/ /(ga) 'di man na rten 'brel chos bdun gyi chog 'khrigs skor la/rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi brgyud 'debs dang phrin las dgos 'dod kun 'byung /10 (375) byang gter rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi bzlog pa'i phrin las gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs/9 (395) rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi brgyud 'debs/2 (413) rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi nyams len rgyun khyer/3(417) rgyal khams pa rdo rje snying pe'i dpal gyis mdzad pa'i rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi bsnyen yig don zab gsal byed me long zhes bya ba/7 (423) padma theg mchog gis mdzad pa'i byang gter zangs mdzod nas byon pa'i rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang chog nag 'gros su bkod pa dbang chen zhal lung /13 (437) rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang bsdus/2 (463) rdo rje thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i dbang sdud kyi gdams pa nyams su len tshul seng gdong dmar mo'i rtsa gsum dbang gi phrin las bzhugs/3 (467) byang gter rten 'brel chos bdun gyi nang tshan lha chen gyi chog khrigs bskang bshags mnga' gsol 'phrin las bcol thabs la5(473)skyabs mgon khams gsum zil gnon gyi gsung yin rtsis kyi byang gter rten 'brel chos bdun gyi nang tshan gnyen po stobs sgrub dang lha chen mchod pa'i phrin las chu 'bab tu bkod pa/6 (483) byang gter
rten 'brel chos bdun gyi nang tshan lha chen gyi chog khrigs/3 (495) sangs gling gter ma lha chen 'gab 'dre mnan pa/3 (501) skal bzang padma dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i lha chen me mchod khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lcags kyu/8 (507) khyab bdag sman lung bas mdzad pa'i thod sgrub rta bdun nor bu'i khri skang rab bdun dgos 'dod gter gyi bum pa/1 (523) sngags 'chang yol mo bas mdzad pa'i lha chen 'bar ba rtsal gyi mnga' gsol yid bzhin rgyal mtshan/3 (525) rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba/7 (531) lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi gser skyems sogs/2 (545) zangs mdzod gter srung rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi mchod sprin yid bzhin sprin phung /6 (549) sngags ban ewa rgyan 'jigs med klongs yangs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten 'dzugs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa dwangs shel me long zhes bya ba/11 (561) gnyan chen thang lha'i bstod bskul mu tig phreng ba bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags mdzad byang med pa/7 (583) rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi phrin las brgya phrag nyi ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/25 (597) thang lha'i phyi rten 'bul thabs/2 (647) rā ga a gses bsgrigs pa'i thang lha'i bka' gtad smyo 'dre rgod kyi 'grim shul/5 (651) dam can 'bar ba rtsal gyi

༄༅caX ’shalhanarnganasgronanargyargyanazla4 caslob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi'oX brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su dbang phyug chen po yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsgrub pa mdzad nasacaX mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi mnga' thang rgyas par mdzadacaX steng gi lha 'og gi klu'oX bar gnod sbyin gyi yul nasacaX nor bu cha brgyad blangs nasacaX bsam yas kyi dkor mdzod gang bar mdzad pasacaX mnga' bdag dgyes te zhus pa'oX kyai slob dpon chen po sprul pa'i sku'oX phyi rabs bstan pa tha ma'i dus na'oX bdag gi rgyal brgyud dang chos skyongs ba'i sde rgud pa byung na'oX de gso ba'i thabs khyad par can 'di lta bu gnang ba zhu zhes zhus socaX slob dpon padmas bka' stsal pa'oX mnga' bdag rgyal po gson cigacaX ma 'ongs pa'i bstan pa la phan pa'i don du'oX gter zab mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbas pa'i nang na'oX
༄tshocaX longs spyod rgyas pa'oX dgra bsgral bcaX bgegs 'dul ba/ tshe bsring ba/ gzhan don bya bcaX bla na med par sangs rgyas pa dang caX gang la gang dgos cha tshang bar mchisacaX de yang gter chen po so bdun gyi nang na dbang gi sgrub thabs tshang ba sbas yod pasacaX rim pas rnyed pa dang las can gyis zab gter la dbang ba bdun po desacaX mnga' bdag gi rgyal rabs gang na 'dug gsos shigacaXgter de rnams thon pa'i dus na lung bzhin bsgrub pasacaX zla ba gcig nas zas la dbang thobacaX zla ba gnyis nas nor dang longs spyod 'phel nas yong caX zla ba gsum nas snyan pa'i 'ur gdangasacaX zla ba bdun nas rgyal srid la dbang thobacaX zla ba bcu gsum nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thob par 'gyur pasacaX brtson 'grus bskyed la sgrubs shigacaX sa ma lha'oX rgya rgya rgya'oX 'di'i bka' mi 'gyur
ba'i thems bstan pa nigiX rtsa ba'i lha lnga yod dogiX dbang sdud thams cad kyi ngo bo rang gi rig pa dbang du sdud pa la4༷༷ mgon po 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs4༷༷ gdul bya'i zhing 'gro drug dbang du sdud pa la4༷༷'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs4༷༷ lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud pa la4༷༷ khro bo rta mgrin gyi bsgrub thabs4༷༷ mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa la4༷༷ rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub thabs4༷༷ 'dod khams kyi bdag po dbang du sdud pa la4༷༷ rig 'dzin padma'i bsgrub thabs dang lnga'ogiX mgon po 'od dpag med la ma rig mun sel rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs4༷༷ ye shes rang snang 'phrin las kyi sgrub thabs4༷༷ dbang gi las tshogs dang gsum yodagiX 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la4༷༷ 'gro ba 'dul ba mthong grol gyi sgrub thabs dang ltoX 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro don gyi bsgrub thabs gnyis4༷༷ btags grol dang dri med shel phreng gnyis4༷༷ de ltar chos skor bzhi yodagiX khro bo rta mgrin la dregs pa dbang sdud las tshogs dang bcas pagiX 'khor 'das dbang sdud las tshogs dang bcas pagiX dbang chen hrī'i 'phrin las4༷༷ gsung mchog rta mgrin gyi dgongs pa dang chos sde bzhi yodagiX rdo rje phag mo la4༷༷ dmar mo dbang sdud kyi bsgrub thabs4༷༷ nag mo thugs kyi sgrub pagiX las tshogs/ me mchod chos sde bzhi yodagiX rig 'dzin padma'i sgrub pa la4༷༷ phyi 'bor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po
༄tshiltoX ltar sgrub pagiX nang yid bzhin nor bu ltar bsgrub pagiX gsang ba thugs kyi bsgrub pagiX gnyen po stobs kyi sgrub pa dang bzhi yodagiX de ltar lnga tshang dgos pa'i gnad 'di lta stegiX mgon po 'od dpag med padma dbang gi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po yin pas4༷༷ dang po la bsgrub pa gal che stegiX de yang rigs pas sems can gyi 'khrul gzhi gsal bas4༷༷ rang snang dbang du 'du ba yin pas gal che'ogiX ye shes rang snang gi sgrub pa byas pas mgon po 'od mi 'gyur pa'i dgongs pa dbang du 'dugiX de las khyad par che ba'i dbang sdud med dogiX 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bsgrub pas4༷༷ 'gro ba rigs drug gdul bya ru 'du stegiX'gro ba'i mgon po yin no4༷༷ rta mgrin bsgrub pas lha srin sde brgyad dbang du 'du stegiX bgegs dang bar chad med par bka' gnyan dang las kyi bran byed pa'ogiX rdo rje phag mo sgrub pas4༷༷ dbyings kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro dang ltoX rang gi rtsa khams rlung gsum dbang du 'du stegiX rdo rje lta bu'i lus su 'gyur ro4༷༷ rig 'dzin padma bsgrub pas4༷༷ 'chi med tshe'i dbang thob pa dngagiX 'dod khams kyi lha dbang phyug chen po dngagiX mu stegs kyi lha dbang phyug chen po las la 'khol nus pa'ogiX sa ma yugiX rgya rgya rgya4༷༷ dbang chen rtsa ba'i lha lnga la4༷༷ bka'i wo nya las mkhan gyi sgrub thabs dgos te4༷༷ 'od dpag med la4༷༷ lha dbang phyug chen po las mkhan du

༄tshi/ /mgo rgodagiX bod khams sems can bde ru dmag 'khrugs daraltoX hūXltoX bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa sprin ltar gtibs4༷༷ khro po 'jigs pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrogs4༷༷ 'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rje glog ltar 'khyugagiX byin rlabs mthu rtsal drag po'i thog ltar 'bebs4༷༷ bdud dang 'gong po dam sri sha za dngagiX phung byed gdon gyi rigs rnams thal bar rlogs4༷༷ dug lnga byol nyog rang rgyud 'khrug pa'i migiX bdud kyi sde dpon rgyal phran cham la phobs4༷༷ las ngan rngams sems me ltar 'bar ba yigiX dmag dpon dmag mi rang gshed rang la phobs4༷༷ sangs rgyas bstan pa bzhig pa'i gdon bgegs dngagiX chos rgyal dmangs su 'bebs pa'i dgra bo dang ltoX bod khams phung bar byed pa'i 'gong po dngagiX rnal 'byor bdag la sdang pa'i dgra bgegs kun4༷༷ yid kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa smyo ru chugagiX ngag gi smra ba lkugs shing brgyal du chugagiXgdos bcas lus kyi phung po myur du sgrol4༷༷ /bdag cag bar gcod 'di las thar bar mdzodagiX bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus bsgrub par mdzodagiX cesabaskul/ 'grub rlang bskyed pa/ bden brdar sogs tshogs tha ma'i zhal bstab rang lugs rtsa gsum bskang ba bcas song nas/ bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūXltoX rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug rta mchog dpal/ /dbang chen las la rngams mdzad 〈sna bo yis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor skurdzon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /
dgra gdon bar chod mi mthun thams cad bzlog /sku mdog dmar nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /khams gsum srid gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /gzugs can gzugs med gnod 'tshe thams cad bzlog /dbu ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yul rtser slebs/ /rta skad nam mkha'i mthongs su 'tsher ba yis/ /bdag dang rgyu: /steng phyogs lha rigs gnod pa thams cad bzlog /zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i steng du brkyangs pa yis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag ma lus gnon par byed/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor: /'og gdon klu gdon gnod pa thams cad bzlog /g.yas kyi phyag rgya gyen du gdengs pa yis/ gzugs khams lha gnas thams cad 'deng par byed/ /bdag dang rgyu: /gzugs khams lha gdon gnod pa thams cad bzlog /g.yon gyi phyag rgya 'og tu gdengs pa yis/ /'dod khams 'jig rten sa gzhi thams cad gnon/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor: /'dod khams 'jig rten dregs pa'i gnod pa bzlog /nyi zla gza' skar thams cad sked la 'khor/ /gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /bdag dang = /drang srong gza' yi gnodangu /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol ba yis/ /lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bran du khol/ /bdag dang: /lha srin sde brgyad gnodangu /dbu gtsug rta skad g.yas su thengs gsum 'tsher/ /
༄tshi/ /srid pa'i pho rgyud thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /bdag dang: srid pa pho rgyud lha 'dre'i gnod: /rta skad g.yon gyi phyogs su thengs gsum 'tsher/ /srid pa'i mo rgyud thams cad dbang du: /bdag dang: /srid pa mo rgyud lha 'dre'i gnodangu /rta skad steng phyogs thengs gsum 'tsher ba yis/ /srid pa'i gza' skar thams cad dbang du: bdag dang: /steng gdon bgogs dang bar chod thams cad bzlog /rta skad 'og phyogs thengs gsum 'tsher ba yis/ srid pa'i klu khams thams cad dbang du/ /bdag dang: 'og gdon sa bdag gdug pa'i gnod: hrī4༷༷yi sgra chen drag por sgrogs pa yis/ /srid gsum 'jig rten thams cad 'dar 'gul dngangs / / bdag dang: /srid gsum lha 'dre'i gnod pa: /hūṃX gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir ba yis/ /khams gsum gdug pa'i lha 'dre bran du 'khol/ /bdag dang: /lha srin gdug pa'i gdug rtsub thams cad: /phaṭa kyi sgra skad drag po thog ltar 'bebs/ /bdud kyi dmag tshogs thams cad spyi nas 'joms/ /bdag dang: /bdud sde dpung tshogs gnod pa: /sku stod ri rab steng na brjid chags pas/ /stong gsum dregs pa thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /bdag dang: log 'dren bgegs kyi gnod pa thams cad: /phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur/ /ri rab 'jig rten thams cad rdul du 'jig /bdag dang: /'byung po gdon gyi
gnod pa: /sku las bskal ba'i me dpung 'ur 'ur 'bar/ /'jig rten gsum gyi khams kun bsregs par byed/ /bdag dang: 'jig rten dregs pa'i dpung gi gnod pa bzlog hūXltoX dbang chen rta mchog rol pa khro rgyal che'i/ /byin rlabs mthu stobs nus pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /bdag dang: lha srin spyi yi gnod pa dgra la bsgyur/ /khyad par gza' chen brgyad po man chad nas/ /gza' skar phran bu yan chad thams cad kyi/ /gza' grib mthong thos dran reg gnod pa sogs/ /bar chod mi mthun thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /zhe gdug klu chen brgyad po man chad nas/ /sa bdag klu srin phra mo yan chad kyi/ /mdze shul phol 'bras dregs grum gnyan nad sogs/ /bar chod mi mthun: /'chi bdag gshin rje chos rgyal man chad nas/ /gshin bdud srog gcod phra mo yan chad kyi/ /byad gtad rbod gtong sbyor ba ngan pa sogs/ /bar chod mi mthun: /ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro man chad nas/ /nad bdag brag srin 'dre mo yan chad kyi/ /nad yams dal rims gdug rtsub la sogs pa/ /bar chod mi mthun: /che btsan dpe dkar rgyal po man chad nas/ /dkor bdag rgyal 'gong dam sri yan chad kyi/ /rgyal gzer smyo 'bog rgyal nad cho 'phrul sogs/ /bar chod mi mthun: /btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun man chad nas/ /btsan phran stong sde btsan rigs yan chad kyi/ /
༄tshi/ /btsan gzer khrag skyugs gri 'thab la sogs pa/ /bar chod mi mthun: /nag po bdud rgyal 'gong yag man chad nas/ /bdud srin 'byung po phra mo yan chad kyi/ /bdud kyi bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub pa sogs bar chod mi mthun: /the'u rang sde dpon rdor legs man chad nas/ /grong rgyu the'u rang sri rkun yan chad kyi/ /the rang rkyal kha than dang ltas ngan sogs/ /bar chod mi mthun: /bgegs rgyal bi na ya ga man chad nas/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i bgegs rigs yan chad kyi/ /glo bur ye 'brog gnod pa la sogs pa/ /bar chod mi mthun: /mdor na lha 'dre che chung thams cad kyi/ /rang rang dngos dang brgyud kyis gnod pa kun dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i byin mthu yis/ /thams cad ma lus bzlog cing dgra la bsgyur/ cesabazlog bsgyur bya/ gzhan yang byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar gyi khro rol las byung ba ltar: bhyoX gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni/ /mon nag 'jigs pa'i cha byad can/ /mdze pho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /las kyi gshin rje'i cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /nag mo drel zhon khram bam can/ /bdud bya nag po lding ba sogs/ /ma mo khros pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang: /mi nag khyi nag bya nag sogs/ /bdud dang mu stegs cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang dmar: /mi dkar rta dkar seng ge sogs/ /dkar po lha yi cho
'phrul yin/ /de yang: bud med bya nag sbra gur sogs/ /ma bdud rgyal mo'i cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang: bud med mi sdug gcan ga zhon/ /nag mo khros mas bskor ba ni/ /khrag 'thung srin mo'i cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang: bya khyi dkar po bu chung dang / /lha khang 'bag seng btsun pa sogs/ /chos 'khor rgyal po'i cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang: mi dmar skyes bran zhub can dang / /rta khyi dmar po bya dmar sogs/ /dmar po btsan gyi cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang: 'dab chags phug ron 'phur ba dang / /mun pa nag po 'thibs pa rmis/ /nag po dmu yi cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang: spyang zhi sngon po nyer zhing rgyug /bandhe skyes phran bro pa ni/ /rdo rje legs pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /de yang: mi lus gcan gzan lpags pa gyon/ /lus la me stag 'phro ba ni/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i: de yang: ban bon nag po dar nag 'phyar/ /mi nag pho mos bskor ba ni/ /chos skyong mgon po'i cho5 de yangaca sprang po hrul po glang 'khar can/ /spra sprel byi las bskor ba ni/ /the'u rang 'gong po'i cho5 de yang5 sbal sbrul sdom sdig 'bu srin dang5 /rgan rgon khyi gu byi ba sogs/ /sa bdag klu yi cho5 de yang: khyi spyang rta rgod krong stong dang / /mon dang sprang mo sgom ma sogs/ /dam sri nag mo'i cho5 de yang: thog 'bebs sad ser kha ba dang / /skyogs dang mda' rdo shwa rdil dang / /dmag dpung mtshon rtse tshur
༄tshi/ /'phang sogs/ /rbod gtong spyi yi cho: de yang : sde brgyad cho 'phrul dgra la bsgyur/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang / /dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad dang / /gshis ngan gum pa bco lnga dang / /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /spyi chags sgos chags thams cad dang / /mo ngan pra ngan la sogs pa/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur chags che nyam nga dgra la: rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la bsgyur/ /mi rung cho 'phrul dgra la bsgyur/ /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bhyoXbhyoXbhyo:༷༷ dang po bhyo yis mi gdab tu/ /ma mo'i dal kha bhyo la thug / bar du bhyo yis mi gdab tu/ /snang srid lha 'dre bhyo yis bzlog /tha ma bhyo yis mi gdab tu/ /nad dang ltas ngan bhyo yis gdab/ bhyo/ ltas ngan kun gyi pha rmos pa/ /gnam la bya dkar mche ba can/ /bya la mche ba yong mi srid/ /ltas ngan dang po pha ru byung / /ltas ngan kun gyi ma rmos pa/ /sa la byi dkar gshog pa can/ /byi bar gshog pa yong mi srid/ /ltas ngan dang po ma ru byung / /de gnyis sdeb pa'i sprul pa las / / ltas ngan brgyad cu byung ba ni/ /gnam gyi ma bdud ltas ngan du/ /nyi zla shi ba'i ltas ngan byung / /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /bar snang stong pa'i ltas ngan ni/ /srog bdag rgyal po'i ltas ngan
te / / bya dang rgod kyi ltas ngan babs/ /de yang dmar: gangs ma de ni dkar gong na/ /lha bdud ma mo'i ltas ngan byung / /dbyings dang g.ya' yi ltas ngan babs/ /de yang : spang ma de ni smar gong na/ /sman dang gza' yi ltas ngan te/ /sha ba rgo ba'i ltas ngan babs/ /de yang : brag ri de ni dmar gong na/ /brag btsan gnyan gyi ltas ngan te/ /gla ba 'ug pa'i ltas ngan babs/ /de yang dmarazo nag ma de ni mun gong na/ /ya bdud gnyan gyi ltas ngan te/ /dom dang dred kyi ltas ngan babs/ /de yang cu g.ya' ma de ni sngo gong na/ /dmu dang bdud kyi ltas ngan te/ /'brong bu g.yag gi ltas ngan babs/ /de yang cu gnam nas ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /gza' skar gnyan gyi ltas ngan te/ /rgod po sder 'dzings ltas ngan babs/ /de yang : rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum na/ /sa bdag klu yi ltas ngan te/ /sbal sbrul nya yi ltas ngan babs/ /de yang ca sa la ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /sa bdag gnyan gyi ltas ngan te/ /lus la mdze shu g.yan pa byung / /de yang : dur dang 'chad pa grogs po nas/ /'dre mo nag mo'i ltas ngan te/ /srin bya khu yis 'debs pa byung / /de yang : brag dang spang nag shing gseb nas/ /'dre srin phra mo'i ltas ngan te/ /gong sreg glu chung len pa byung / /de yang : phu nas ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /bdud dang gnyan gyi ltas ngan te/ /sha pho rwa 'dzings ltas ngan
༄tshi/ /byung / /de yang = /mda' nas ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /klu srin 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan te/ /nya mo rnga 'dzings ltas ngan byung / /de yang = /dur nas ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /dur 'dre dur sri'i ltas ngan te/ /dur nas wa rgyal wa ro sbram/ /de yang = /rta la ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /drug grum gdong gas gzi mig byung / /de yang = /phyugs la ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /'bri la be'u mtshe ma byung / /de yang : lug la ltas ngan byung ba ni / / dre bkal sked skor nag po byung / /de yang = /ra la ltas ngan byung bza /zangs ldan spu rtags dmar po byung / /de yang = /khyi la ltas ngan byung bza /tshi ba byung dang tho rangs phywa /de yang = /byis pa chung gi ltas ngan ni/ /sre mong kha na byi ro khyer/ /de yang = /bya la ltas ngan byung ba ni/ /rgyal 'gong 'dre yi ltas ngan yin/ /srod la de pho 'tsher ba byung / /de yang = /pho rog 'ug pa sder 'dzings byed/ /rme 'ban bdud kyi ltas ngan babs/ /de yang = /'ja' 'khyil lha yi ltas ngan yin/ /seng ge ngu 'bod gshin rje'i ltas/ /de yang = /dom dred stag gzig 'thab pa dang / /pha spun nang dme byed pa ni/ /srin po ma mo'i ltas ngan yin / / de yang = /sha rkyang btsan gyi ltas ngan yin/ /rlung nag 'khyil ba klu yi ltas/ /dom nag bdud kyi ltas ngan yin/ /gla ba sman gyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang = /bya rgod rgyal po'i ltas ngan yin/ /khrung khrung
'dre mo'i ltas ngan yin/ /spyang zhi dge bsnyen ltas ngan yin/ /bya rgod sder 'dzings byed pa dre gas/ /bdud kyi ltas ngan thams cad bzlog /ltas ngan brgyad bcu rtsa gcig bzlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog / dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad: glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcigazo /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi: gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga: smi lam mtshan ma ngan pa: lus la nad du gtong ba tshe la bar du gcod (5 skeg ngan sri ngan thams cad: mo ngan gtsug lag ngan pa: kha blta la nye ngan pa: bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub pa: 'dun ngan 3was ngan brtsodas pa: mi rung ltas ngan thams cad ni/ /bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo:༷༷ bhyo bhyo gnod pa'i bgegs la bhyo:༷༷ bhyo bhyo za ba'i 'dre la bhyo:༷༷ bhyo bhyo phung pa'i sri la bhyo:༷༷ bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog dgra la bzlogagiX bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la bsgyur/ sogs bting na legs par mthong /bskang bzlog lta busazor gtor gser skyems 'bul/ rol mo drag brdung bya/ lhag ma bsagasachad tho brtan skyongs gtang rag mchod bstod bzod gsol gshegs gsol bsngo smon bkra shisasogs phyag bzhesaltar bya/ de lta bu zhag grangasaji ltar 'osapa byed/ grol nyin rgyas par spro na gtor lam gtor rgyags rang lugs byang gter bka' brgyad rang shar ltar byas pasamathusaso/ /'di ni sngon chad yig cha med kyang gzhung dang 'gal ba ni ma yin pa/ rang shar rgyud gzhung las/ dbang dang cho ga kha skong sogs/ /rgyasapar 'dod na rigs mthun pa'i/ /rgyud dang man ngag gzhan nas
༄tshi/ /blangs / /len du rung ba nga yi bka'/ /kun tu bzang posaganang ba ste/ /mi mthun theg pas bslad mi bya/ sogs mang du gsungs pas lhan tu rung ba dang / ma tshad lam 'di yi rnal 'byor ma bu mdzad dge slong padma mdo sde nasakyang ring nasabaskul ba dang / rang nyid kyang lam 'di la mosshing byang gter gyi rta mgrin 'di nyag phra ba bcas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs dang / mchog dman yongs kyi gnas skabasarkyen sel sogs la phan re'i lhag bsam gyi kun nas bslangasate/ padma theg mchog tu 'bod pasame byi hor zla bcu ba'i tshesabacu la shar mar thol byung du brisapa yi ge pa ni nye gnas dge slong padma gsang sngags kyisabrisapa'i dge desa'agro rnams bar chod dgra bgegs kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal zhing mthar thug dbang chen rta mchog rol ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
(ba/)༄tsho//rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi brgyud 'debasabazhugs:
༄tshi/ /na moX 'od dpag med mgon brtse chen spyan ras gzigs/ rta mgrin dbang sdud padma 'byung gnas dpal/ srid pa'i bdag po dbang phyug yab yum la/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ khri srong lde'u btsan lha sras mu khri btsan/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gter ston rgod ldem can/ rnam rgyal mgon po sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus / rdo rje mgon po byams pa bshes gnyen dang / ngag dbang grags pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang po/ chos rgyal bsod nams chos skyong bsod bkras la/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ mkhyen brtse dbang phyug byams pa skal bzang dang / dbang phyug rab brtan bsod nams mchog ldan zhabs/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ chos dbyings rang grol blo
༄༅/ /bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ ngag dbang grags pa legs ldan bdud 'joms rje/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ dbang po'i sde dang ngag dbang yol mo ba/ stobs ldan dpa' bo phyag rdor nor bu la/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ chos dbyings rang grol drag rtsal rdo rje dang / a ti'i rig 'dzin padma 'phrin las la/ gsol ba 'debs so: rig 'dzin dbang rgyal rdo rje thog med zhabs/ padma bshes gnyen khyab bdag ngag dbang la/ gsol ba 'debs so: 'jigs med dpa' bo kun bzang nam mkha' klong / padma dbang rgyal bdud 'dul rdo rje la/gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ rgyal ba'i myu gu dharma bī dza'i dang / mnyam nyid rdo rje theg mchog bstan 'dzin la/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ 'bral med
snying dbus drin chen bla ma rdze/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong mched dang lcam dral la/ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ srid gsum zil gnon snyan grags phyogs bcur spel/ mchog dang thun mongs dalnga(sa khru/ba stsal du garbershal/ kha skong smon tshig 'di ni gnyer phyag dam pa'i ngor rig pa'i rdo rjesaso/ shubhaX/ dharma shri padma sirnyi dang / khyab bdag sems dpa' 'gyur med rnam rgyal la/ gsol ba 'debasaso khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ pad 'phrin nas smin gling lo chen brgyud pa ltar rdo rje thogs med bar brgyud tshul gnyisaso// //
lado༅:rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi nyamasalen rgyun khyer bzhugs so
༄tshicaX na mo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i thugs rje cana'oX dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i rta mgrin lacaX bdag gis skyabs mchi yi dam mchog sgrub stecaX gdug pa tshar gcod sems can drangs bar bgyi'ocaX zhes lan gsum brjodacaX bdag nyid tha mal snying ga na'oX yi ge hrī dmar gnas pa lacaX bdag nyid hrīXyi lus su gyuracaX hrī de 'od du zhu ba lasacaX bdag nyid dbang chen rgyal po'i sku'oX dbu ni tshangs pa'i yul rtser slobasacaX zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyangacaX g.yas kyi phyag gis gzugs khams 'degasacaX g.yon gyi phyag gis 'dod khams gnona'oX nyi zla gza' skar sked la 'khoracaX sku mdog bskal pa'i me ltar 'baracaX sku stegs ri rab steng na 'cha'acaX dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsheracaX g.yas kyi rta skad thengs gsum gyisacaX srid pa'i pho rgyud dbang du sdudacaX g.yon gyis
༄tshiltoX rta skad thengs gsum gyis4༷༷ srid pa mo rgyud dbang du sdudagiX steng du rta skad thengs gsum gyis4༷༷ srid pa'i gza' rnams dbang du sdudagiX 'og tu rta skad thengs gsum gyis4༷༷ srid pa'i klu rnams dbang du sdudagiX hrī hūXltoXphaṭa gsum bsgrags pa yis4༷༷ 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba tsamagiX khams gsum dbang du sdud byed cingagiX srid gsum zil gyis gnon par gyuraltoX de nas bzlas pa bya ba nigiXhrī4༷༷ mahā kro ta padma ta krid ha yaX gri wa hūX hūX phaṭa4༷༷ 'di rtsa ba'i sngags yin pas yi dam lha'i byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la zhugs pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du sngags 'di kho na la bsnyen pa byed cing thun gyi mjug tu hrī hūX phaṭa4༷༷ zhes pa yang brgya stong sogs bzlas par bya'ogiX 'di rtsa sngags bsdus pa yin pas thun gyi mjug tu nges par bzlas par bya'ogiX bzlas pa tshar ba dang mjug tu bstod pa 'di bya'ogiX

༄tshiltoX nas sde brgyad kyi bla rdo gzhung dang mthun par bcas la rang gi rkang pa'i 'og tu bcug la sngags 'di bzlas la gzir ro4༷༷ hrī mahā kro ta padma ta krid ha yaX ghri wa hūX hūX phaṭa4༷༷ ya ma ra tsa du tri phu ti hrī hūX phaṭa4༷༷zhes lha srin sde brgyad dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du bzlas pa bya'ogiX rtags ni yi dam lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags dang lha 'dre thul pa'i rtags gnyis las4༷༷ dang po yi dam lha'i rtags nigiX dar 'phyar dung bus nyi ma sharaltoX ri mtho rtse la 'dzegs pa rmis4༷༷ yi dam lha yi rtags su bshadagiX gzhan yang rmi lam bzang po mthong ba nigiX yi dam gyi drod tshad thon pa'i rtags4༷༷ lha 'dre thul pa'i rtags nigiX 'di'i sgrub thabs gzhung na bshad pas 'dir bri ma dgos4༷༷ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter gzhung na4༷༷ lha 'dre thul pa'i rtags nigiX lus la go malhangon gyon pa dngagiX lag tu skyurdzo mtshon thogs pa dngagiX ban dhe bu chung bsad pa dngagiX gnag phyugs mang po bsad pa nigiX lha 'dre thul ba'i rmis ltas yin par bshad 'dugagiX 'on kyang 'di rang gi sgrub gzhud nas bshad pa'i lha 'dre thul ba'i rtags ma byung gi bar du bzlas bsgrub par bya'ogiX sde brgyad kyi bla rdo'i 'bor lo nigiX so sor dbye ba dngagiX spyi ru dril ba gnyis yod pa las4༷༷ spyi ru dril ba'i 'bor lo zab par bla ma'i zhal nas gsungs sogiX sngags bzlos byed pa'i dmigs pa zur du blta'ogiX bkra
shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du dresan4༷༷ 'di brisadage bas bdag gzhan sems can rnams/ dregs pa dbang sdud sku gsung thugs 'grub nas/ snang srid zil gyisaganon pa'i mthu stobasadang / khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i dpal thob shog /grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po pad ma phrin las kyi zhal gsung grub dbang padma bgesaganyen gyi yin par rdo brag skyabasamagon nas gsungs so/ 31sa dbyings ngang las sku sprul dbang gi rgyal/ /mthongs sku dpal chen gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /drag 〈sna'i phrin las thabs la mkhas pa yi/ /rta mchog rol ba'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /maṅga lam/ /chos dbyings ngang las khro gtum 'bar ba'i sku/ /lha yi lha mchog padma dbang gi lha/ /bdud kyi bdud gshed ma rung 'dul mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal kun gyi gtso la phyag mtshal bstod/ / sarba maṅgalaX/ dmar nag zla gam dbang gi pho brang nas/ /lha yi gtso bo ma hā dhe ba dang / /u ma de wa mkha' 'gro rig bzhi bcas4༷༷ dbang sdud rigs lnga'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ / bkra shesadage'o/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /yid sbyin nor bu'i char 'beb dbang gi lha/ /dgos 'dod rtag tu 'bad med dbang stsol ba'i/ /dbang gi rgyal po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bakhu1da/ /sho lo ka drug po 'di dam pa gnyisakyisayang yang bskul ngor/ /rig 'dzin chen posathub bstan e waX rdo rje brag de'i cog sgar gzim chung phug tu sbyar dge'o: bkris/ lha: maṅga lam// //
(ca)༄༅/ /rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi bsnyen yig don zab gsal byed me long zhesabya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄ga/ /bcom ldan khrag 'thung dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed khro rgyal padma he ru ka /gtum rngams rab khros khrag 'thung khros pa'i gar/ /sa gsum g.yo zhing srid gsum zil gyis gnon sde brgyad dregs pa'i gnya' bar lci la 'dud/ de la 'dir rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa zab mo la 'jug par 'dod pa rten gyi gang zag blo chos su bor zhing stong nyid snying rje zung tu bsgom pa'i sgom par dbang thob pa dag gis 'di lta bu'i rno myur dregs pa tshar gcod pa'i rim pa 'di la zhugs nas zhi bas mi thul ba'i gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod sems can thams cad dpal chen po'i gho 'phang kyi sar 'god par 'dod pa'i skye bu blo dang ldan pa dag gi nyams su blang bar byed pa la/ de yang rdo rje sems dpa'i lam gyi rtsa ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ de yang bsnyen pa
༄༅/ /dang nye bsnyen sgrub pa dang sgrub pa chen po bzhir 'du byed rnams kyi khong nas las bzhi rab 'byams ston par byed/ de lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub zab mo nyams su len par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnam sa bar gsum dpyad dbang drag sgrub pa'i bar rung ba dag gi gnas dben pa yid dang mthun zhing rang dbang du gyur pa'i sar phyag brdar bgyis/ rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa'i mdun du steng bu'i khar 'bru tshom gyi steng mazhi'i khar dpal gtor rgyan ldan mdun du dma' ba'i sar bka' srung spyi sgos kyi gtor ma dang / g.yas g.yon du sman rag mdun du tpū nang gi mchod pa sogs bkod legs shing yid du 'ong bar bya/ sku rten yang bkram/ rang gi mal 'og tu 'bru'am sa dkar gyis g.yung drung chos skor du bris pa'i khar/ stan nang tshang can steng / mdun du
nang mchod/ rdor dril/ cang tes bsang chu/ gul yungs rnams kyang tshogs par bya/ drag sgrub kyi bsnyen pa gzhan sngon du song ngam 'di'i grangs bsnyen tsam them pas ni sde brgyad gnad la dbab pa'i 'khor lo sogs kyang sgrub thabs bzhin shes par bya zhing / lus la bcang ba dang / mal 'og tu sba ba sogs te/ rtsa bar sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bcangs4༷༷ zhes pas phur pa spyi bor 'khor/ rang srung rnams ma bral bar lus la bcang ngo / /'on kyang thog ma nas de ltar ma 'grub na rtsa bsnyen dang las bsnyen mthar phyin par song ba'i mjug tu sgrub thabs bzhin/ bdun gnyis gsum tsam rtags dang sbyar nas bsgrub cing gnad la dbab par bya/ slar 'khor lo spos dkar gyis bdug cing khrus sogs kyis gtor ma nas gong ltar sku gsung thugs rten bcang ba rnams bsgrub na shin tu legs par 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ ji srid mtshams kyi bya ba ma rdzogs pa de srid du rkyen dbang gis 'grol mi dgos pa'i dam bca' brtan po dang / mtshams g.yog lha rje 'tsho chas len khang sogs kyang khral yod tsam bya/ gzhan ka gca' gtong len rnam g.yeng rgyang bsring zhing 'dod pa'i lha nyid myur du 'grub par bya snyams pa'i zhi dam drag po bya zhing / yar ngo mar ngo sogs kyi dus khyad par can gyi dgong thun nas dbu btsug par byed dgos/ sgo drung du tho dkar po
༄7/ /zhig brtsig la rgyal po chen po bzhi'i sngags byang yang gzugs/ de nas rang nyid stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi chos kyi 'dug nas ḍā dril sgras bskul te gdangs dbyangs kyis tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bya/ las byang ltar skyabs sems tshar gsum bya/ de ma thag sgrub thabs bzhin/ bdag nyid tha mal snying kha na/ zhes pa nas/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon par gyuraltoX zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal btab la rtsa sngags brgya rtsa tsam bzla zhing gu gul dang yungs thun la phus btabs so/ /de nas phyi mtshams rgyal chen bzhir mchod pa ni/ sgo drung gi tho rgyal chen bzhir mos la/ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas4༷༷ zhes sogs kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ ye shes pa bstim pa/ mchod gtor 'bul zhing phyi mtshams bsrung ba'i phrin las bcol pa sogs thugs sgrub ltar bya zhing / rjes su su pra tidzis bzhugs gsol bya/ nang mtshams bgegs bskrad ni/ mdun du bgegs gtor bshams/ yi ge gsum gyis bsang sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs/ hrīX rang nyid rig pa ye shes bskyed pa'i lhagiX zhes sogs bgegs bskrad gnas khang dang sa gzhi bar snang thams cad rang 'dra'i khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i nang nas bgegs rnams phyi yi rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad par bsam la gtor ma phyir gtong / drag sngags
bzla zhing gu gul gyis mtshams khang bdug yungs thun gyis brab cing bgegs dang bral ba'i cho ga bung bskyed bya'o// gsang mtshams lta ba'i ngang la bzhag ste/ bar du gcod bya'i yul bar chad kyi bgegs gsang ba bar chod dang rang gi ngo po ste gsum ka mi dmigs pa spros bral ka dag gi ngang du lhan gyis bzhag go /de nas mtshams bcad bsrung ba'i 'bor lo bsgom pa/ rang bzhin ye shes kyi sgo dbye ba/ mdun mkhar tshogs zhing yid kyi spyan drangs la bshags pa bya/ bdag gnas sgrub gnas rnams la byin dbab pa/ phyi nang gi mchod pa byin rlobs nas bstod pa'i bar las byang ltar dang bzlas pa'i skabs rtsa sngags ci rigs song ba'i mjug tu las sngags btags pa brgya tsam bzlas mthar spyi sgos kyi bsrung mar bskang ba/ tshogs byin rlabs nas/ tshogs tha ma'i mjug tu rtsa gsum bskang ba'ang bya/ tshogs la rol ba dang lhag ma'i bar bya/bsnyen sgrub ma grol bar nub re bzhin tshogs gtong na lhag ma btson 'dzin bya/ mi gtong na de ma thag lhag ma yang phyir btang ba dang chad tho smon lam btab pa yan dkyus ltar dang bkra shis kyang bya ste/ nyin dang po'i dgongs thun no// srod thun la babs pa'i tshe bde ba'i stan la 'dug la/ skyabs sems lan gsum song ba'i mjug bdag nyid dbang gi lhar dam ye dbyer med kyi sgo nas gsal 'debs pa ni/ bdag nyid tha
༄tsho/ /mal snying kha na4༷༷ zhes pa nas/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon par gyuraltoX zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal btab/ de lta bu'i lha sku'i gsal snang la shes pa gtad cing gdod nas grub pa'i rig pa ye shes kyi khro bo khrag 'thung dbang gi rgyal po che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba de nyid nga'o/ /mnyam pa'i nga rgyal dang de nyid bde gsal stong pa nyid du 'char ba rnams kyang zung gcig tu byas nas gsal snang la dar gcig bzhagde'i ngang las bdag gi thugs gar nyi dkyil gyi steng hrīXyig dmar po nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa lta bu'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i mthar/ mdun nas brtsams te sngags 'phreng kha dog dmar po 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba g.yas skor du 'khod pa gsal btab la hrīXsngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs dus kyis rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub kun 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par bsdus pa rang gi gnas gsum du thims yang 'od zer 'phros dregs pa sde brgyad ma rung pa thams cad tshar bcad de bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam/ 'od zer des sems kyi sdig sgrib glo bur las nyon gyi 'khrul rtog thams cad sbyangs te dpal chen po'i skur gyur/ de'i ngang las snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dbang drag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang dang / bcud kyi sems can rnams padma
he ru ga'i skur gyur pa la snang ba lha/ sgra thams cad sngags sgra 'brug ldir ba lta bu dran rtog thams cad rang rig rang gsal spros bral ka dag gi ngang nas bzlas pa la 'jug par bya/ bzlas pa'i mthar yig brgya dang dbyangs gsal yang kha shas brjod la ngag 'grol bsnyen pa'i skabs spyan 'dren bstod sogs ma byas kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang 'grub na shin tu legs pas/ hrīX padma he ru ka ni dbyings nas bzhengs4༷༷ sogs kyis mdun mkhar spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ gtor ma'ang lha dang mchod rdzas zung 'grel du bltas la mchod pa nas bstod pa'i bar bya/ bstod pa'i mthar gter srung rnams la bskang ba yang byas rjes/ yig brgya dang nong bshags sogs kyi mthar ye shes pa mdun rten la bstim la brtan bzhugs bya/ bdag nyid nyer bsdu snod bcud thams cad 'od dmar por ltem gyis zhu ba bdag lhar gsal ba la de hrīXl de nam mkha' 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i ngang la bzhag slar lhar langs bsngo smon dang bkra shis bya/ nyal ba'i tshe thugs srog hrīXl shes pa gtad de nyal/ nyin dang po'i srod thun no/ /nang par ldang ba'i tshe lhar langs la/ dkyil 'khor gsum gsal btab ste/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang skyabs sems bya/ bgegs gtor mi dgos mtshams bcad/ bshags pa byin dbab mchod rdzas brlab pa rnams bya zhing de
༄༅/ /ma thag bdag nyid tha mal snying kha na4༷༷ sogs kyi gsal btab/ lha sku'i gsal snang la sems 'dzin sogs gong ltar nas bzlas pa la 'jug bzlas pa'i gong du 'phreng ba byin rlabs kyang bya/ bzlas pa'i mthar dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya bya/ spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i bar dang bskang ba mi dgos/ bstod pa'i mthar bdag nyid nyer bsdu dang bsngo smon bkra shis sogs bya/ nyin gnyis pa'i thor thun no/ /bar der dge sbyor chags med yod na bya/ de nas zhogs thun ni/ skyabs sems gnyis song ba'i mjug tu/ bdag nyid tha mal snying kha sogs kyis sngar ltar gsal 'debs pa nas bzlas pa la 'jug go/ mchod bstod bya/ bstod pa'i mthar bdag nyid dam tshig pa nyer bsdu sngar ltar ldang ba bsngo smon shos brjod sogs bya/ zhogs thun no/ /dgongs thun dang srod thun gnyis la'ang zhogs thun ltar sngon 'gro skyabs sems gnyis kyi rjes lha bskyed bzlas pa'i mthar bstod pa dang nyer bsdu bya ba yin/ srod thun la spyi bye brag gi srung mar gtor bsngo sogs nas nyer bsdu'i mthar thugs srog hrīXl shes pa gtad nas nyal ba sogs nyin dang po'i srod thun bzhin no/ /gang ltar kyang thun bzhi po de rnams gcod tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yin te/ thor thun tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyas pa dang skyabs sems mtshams gcod
sman gtor rakta byin rlabs rgyas pa nas bskyed bzlas nyer bsdu bsngo smon bar dang / zhog thun dgongs thun gnyis la sngon 'gro skyabs sems tsam nas nyer bsdu bsngo smon bar dang / srod thun sngon 'gro skyabs sems tsam nas bstod pa'i mthar bskang ba dang rjes chog sogs rgyas pa nas nyer bsdur 'jug pa sogs te/ thun de rnams kyi thog mtha' ni de gnyis so/ /de yang 'dir skabs don 'ga' zhig bye brag tu bshad na/ lha bskyed skabs bdag nyid tha mal snying kha nas4༷༷ zhes pa'i dus rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i snying khar yi ge hrīXdamar gsal 'tsher dwangs ma gsal ba las 'od zer dmar po dpag med bun long gi 'phros pas rang lus rnam smin sha khrag rdos bcas kyi lus 'dis mtshon ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i dngas ma 'od phung dmar por gyur/ de skad cig tsam gyi yi ge hrīXdamar po 'od nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzi 'od dang ldan pa de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dbang gi rgyal po ni/ zhes sogs kyi tshig gshar tsam ma yin par gsal btab la/ rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ de 'dzin med kyi rgyas 'debs pa zil gnon gyi sngags btags pa'ang 'bum phrag tsam yang / sogs gong du bshad pa ltar bya zhing bsnyen pa ni rtsa ba'i sngags nyid la rab 'bru 'bum/ 'bring bdun 'bum
༄༅/ /tha ma gsum 'bum sogs song ba'i mjug tu/ rtsa sngags la sde brgyad srog sngags dang kha chings/ mthar yang lnga khri tsam bzla/ de ltar bzlas pas ma bzod de sde brgyad 'khrug par 'gyur te/ rtsa bar/dbang chen zil gnon sngags bzlas pas4༷༷ lha 'dre thams cad 'khrug 'gyur te4༷༷ dang po cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston4༷༷ bar du dbang sdud bka' la nyon4༷༷ tha ma : dgos las rnams byedagiX bu ga gsal la las la gtong ltoX zhes pas/ de yang rtsa sngags la las sngags btags pa/ 'bum khri tsam song ba'i dus cho 'phrul mi bzad pa sna tshogs byung yang / 'jigs shong ya nga ba dang / bag zhums pa sogs spangs te rig pa la ngar btags lta ba'i dpangs bstod gnas lugs kyi ngang du bzhag go /ci ste da dung zhir ma song ba'am/ song yang lnga khri drug tsam song ba'i mjug tu kha chings zil gnon gyi dmigs pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hrīXlas hrī4༷༷dmar nag grangs med par 'phros pas de kun sde brgyad kun gyi bu ga dgur zhugs te bkag pas/ rang dbang med par myos shing stobs dang nus mthu gzi brjid kun 'phrogs gdug sems thams cad bcings shing brtan pa thams cad dang bral bar bsam la rtsa sngags la sde brgyad srog snying zil gnon sngags sbrel ba lnga 'bum sum 'bum rtags dang sbyar nas drag tu bzla/ de ltar bzlas pas phyag 'tshal ba dang /
bskor ba byed pa dang ci bgyi zer ba sogs ni/ dbang du 'dus shing bdag gi bka' la nyan pa'i rtags so/ /ci bcol gyi las byed pa'i rtags su/ nyi zla shar ba dang / mtshon cha khong du mid pa rmi ba sogs las byed pa'i rtags/ de ltar mtshan ma kun rten la phebs shing gdon shin tu rid cing nyam thag pa 'ba' zhig rmis na bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros hrīXl phog pas bu ga dgu'i hrīXrnams tshur bsdus pa bdag gi thugs ga'i hrīr thim zhing sde brgyad la bka' bsgo zhing gtor ma byin phrin las bcol ba sogs bya/ slar yang tshul rgol zhing mi nyan na sngar ltar dmigs pas bcun la gnad la dbab par bya ste rang gi nyams dang sbyar ba gces so/ /gzhan yang las tshogs kyi bye brag dgra la rbad pa/ dam 'gong 'dul ba/ sri'u gso ba/ tshe bsring ba dang / tshe 'gugs pa/ phyag rgya 'gugs pa/ zas nor spel ba dang / cho 'phrul che ba zhir ma 'dod pa la sde brgyad bsad pa'i sngags gdags pa sogs ni sgrub gzhung dang gzhan don gyi gnas zhal las shes pa'ang 'ga' zhig tsam na dam pa rnams la brtan par bya zhing rang rang gi gzhung don dang mi 'gal ba'i nyams myong gis kyang bcad pas shes so/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni gang ltar kyang de lta bu'i sgrub pa rab rtags/ 'bring mtshan ma/ ma mtha' grangs bsnyen sogs rdzogs pa'i sang nyin grol rgyu'i snga thun la tshogs
༄tshi/ /mchod pa gsar ba bsham/ rnying pa rnams kyang zhal gsogiX sngon 'gro rgyas pa nas skyabs sems sgo dbye sogs nas lha bskyed bzlas pa bstod pa'i bar dang / spyi dgos kyi srung mar bskang ba sogs rgyas pa tshogs byin rlabs nas rtsa gsum yan bya/ tshogs la rol ba dang / lhag ma dang bstun phyag brdar byas pa'ang phyir btang / chad thos gtor ma phul/ bshal chus brtan ma bskyang / phyir log rol pa'i rta bros bro brdung bya/ de nas sgrub gtor lhar gsal ba la sman rag bran la/ bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'igiX zhes pa nas/ sku gsum dbyer med padma he ru kaXr bsgyur nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i mjug tu/ hrīX mahā kro ta padma ta krita ha ya ghri wa sirnyi pha la hūX hūX na na kha dhe zhes pa nas/ sa ma ya bsdus bsdus zhes pa'i dngos grub blangs/ dmigs pa gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer byung ba rang gi gnas gsum du thim par bsams/ ka ya siddhi oX / wa ka siddhi āX tsitta siddhi hūX/ zhes pas gnas gsum du gtugs nas dngos grub blangs pas thob par bsam rjes mchod pa kha gsos/ dbang chen yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas la4༷༷ zhes pa tsam gyis mchod cing bstod nas yig brgya yang gang mang du brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs kyis nyes byas bshags/ ye shes pa bris sku
la bstim/ dam tshig pa bdud rtsir zhu ba/ dngos grub kyi rdzas su spyod/ bdag nyid nyer bsdu srung 'khor snod bcud nas mthar thugs srog hrīX'i bar bsdu zhing / slar yang lhar langs/ dge ba bsngo ba dang bkra shis kyi me tog bzang po char du bsnyil nas shis pa brjod pa sogs bya/ sgo drung gi thor mchod gtor 'bul zhing ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba dang / dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu ba sogs bya zhing / rim pas bag bsogs pa sogs spyi'i 'gros ltar bya'o/ /gtum chen nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /khrag 'thung padma he ru ga'i/ /bsnyen sgrub yi ge zab mo'i don/ /spel lo skal ldan dpal thob shog /zhes pa 'di yang dam pa du ma'i zhal dkyil lhan cig tu blta zhing zab mo'i dbang gi dkyil 'bor mang por lhan cig tu 'dzoms pa rdo rje'i mched dam pa'i gsung ngor rgyal khams pa rdo rje snying po'i dpal gyis smon 'grub chos lding gi dben khang gi mtshams mal thog thun mtshams gcig gi khongs su sug bris su bstar ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga laX/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //
(ja)do༅/ /byang gter zangs mdzod nasabyon pa'i rta mgrin dregs pa dbang bsdud kyi dbang chog nag 'grosasu bkod pa dbang chen zhal lung bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /bla ma dang dbyer med dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dul ga'i 'grerdzo rnams thabs kyi 'dul ba'i phyir/ /snang ba mtha' yas drag po'i skur ston pa/ /khams gsum dbang bsdus dregs pa'i rgyal stu1 zhes/ /mtshan tsam thos pas nyes brgya 'alnga(mas la 'dud/ de la 'dir byang gter rten 'grel chosabadun gyi nang tshan yi dam rta mgrin dregs pa dbang bsdusakyi dbang chog ji ltar bskur ba'i rim pa la/ dang po ni/ dbang chog gzhung las/ sngon 'gro bkra shisadag pa'i sa phyogs su/ /maṇḍal mchod gtor mkho ba'i yo byad bsags/ /zhesagasungs pa ltar/ yid mthun gyi gnas su dbang gi skabs su mkho ba'i yo byad ni/ maṇḍal dkyil 'khor gzhung ltar bshams pa'i steng maphyi'i dbusasu dpal gtor phyag len ltar lha tsaka dang bcas pa bshams/ shar du rnam bum rgyan ldan/ lhor gsang rdzas bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ nub tusher rten me long / byang du bka' srung thang lha'i gtor ma sman raka mig dar me tog dam chu bdud rtsi'i snod gser thur maṇḍal me tog bcasadang / rdor dril thod rnga/ nas bzed/
༄tsho/ /thun bzed/ gu gul sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnamasa'adu bya'o// phrin las dgosa'adod kun 'byung bzhin phyir lhag ma'i mgor/ slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor yol bsabacad pa'i phyir bcosal/ ji ltar bltams pas: khrusanas byung ba bgegs gtor bshams la/ raX yaX khaX oX āXhūX lan gsum hūX mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas pa las/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma: sangs rgyas kyi: chos kyi: dge 'dun: gsang sngags rig sngags gzugs sngags snying po bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang / yi dam khro bo'i rgyal po dbang chen rta mchog rol pa dregs pa dbang bsdus kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la byin rlabs smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo bgyi ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad gtor ma
'dis tshim par gyis la sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gal te mi 'gro ba rnams lus ngag thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bgyi'o/ / hrīX rang nyid rig pa ye shes ::: mā ra ya phaṭa bar dang / steng thams cad rdo rje gur dang bla bre/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dra bas 'khrig shing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūXltoX de nasachosastad pa ni / me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ ngag dal grel mtshams par/ 'o 'gro ba ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid khyab bdag kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du yi dam khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo thob par bya snyam byang chub kyi mchog sems bskyed pa sngon du btang te nyan par bya/ de yang chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams skyes rabs las/ /rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i sems ni rab tu skyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gi blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ nad pas sman pa nyan pa ltar/ /rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig ces gsungs nas bka' dri ma med pa mdo rgyud du ma nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin snod kyi skyon gsum dang / dri ma
༄tsho/ /drug sogs dang bral ba'i 'du shes gsum gyis legs par gtan la 'bebs pa'i nyan par gal che/ dam pa'i chos lam du 'gro ba thog ma'i sgo thos pa byed dus nas ma 'chug pa zhig gal che/ de yang 'phags pa yon tan rin po che yang dag pa bsdus pa'i mdo las/ dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer bzhag ste/ sgrib pa nyon mongs sel nas dri ma las 'das pa/ 'gro don mngon bzhugs nges pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin/ gang la dpa' rnams spyod pa 'di ni nyan par bgyis/ zhes gsungs pa ltar nges shig /de yang chos ston pa'i slob dpon de rnam pa ji lta bu zhig yod kyang rang ngos nas sangs rgyas dngos kyang 'di ka las lhag med snyam pa'i dad pa dang mos gus rjes su yi rangs pa'i ci mdzad legs par mthong ba dang / ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin pa ni nges par gal che ba ni/ mdo las/ chos smra ba la mchod par bya ba ni/ston pa 'dra ba de la bsnyen bkur bgyis/ gsungs pa ltar dang / bstan bcos yid bzhin mdzod las/ de la dang po thos pa'i shes rab bskyed/ 'di ni thar ba'i rtsa ba lags par gsung zhes gsang sngags bla na med kyi lugs ltar na lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar/ ngag pi waX gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar yid rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang bral ba ltar rnam rtog snga phyi bar gsum gyis lhad ma zhugs pa dran pa'i so btsug te nyan dgos
pa ni/ bstod pa glur blangs kyi rgyud las gsang ba'i bdag po de phyir nges/ khyod la legs par ston par bya/ khyod ni rtse gcig yid kyis nyon zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngang tshul de las ldog pa rnams la ni rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi nam yang byin rlabs mi 'jug pa ni/ rig pa rang shar gyi rgyud las rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas kyang / shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon/brjed nges blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ /zhes gsungs zhing / de las gzhan du yang dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi bskyed de/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po bskyed mi srid ces dang / /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' las/ dad pa med na gsang sngags kyi snod du mi rung / brtson 'grus med na le lo can tha mal du 'chor/ shes rab med na gsang sngags kyi lta spyod zab mo dbye mi shes/ zhes gsung pas/ dad brtson shes rab rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas chos nyan par 'tshal/ de yang phun sum tshogs pa legs par gsal btab dgos shing / gnas khang 'di nyid kyang tha mal gyi gnas khang 'di lta bu ma yin pas dbang chenapadma'i gzhag yas khang yongs su gsal btab/ de yi dbus chos ston pa
༄༅/ /po bdag kyang tha mal gyi btsun gzugs 'di lta bu ma yin pa dbang chen rta mchog rol pa dngos su 'du shes [bskyed ]pa dang / /nyan pa po rnams kyang dad brtson shes rab rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa sogs yon tan gyi sgo du ma zhig dang ldan pa gal che/ chos kyang dri ma med pa bka' mdo rgyud nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin rtsod pa dang bral ba padma'i thugs bcud zab mo'i gter chos dngos yin pa dang / dus kyang rang rang mos pa'i tshe/ dus kyi rgyal po dran pa'i tshe na bzang / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ phun sum tshogs pa legs par gsal btab te nyan pa gal che/ nyan par bya ba'i chos ni/ mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ ces gsungs pas/ dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi snying po sdig spongs dge sgrub kyi nyams len la ma 'dus pa med pas na/ thog mar las rgyu 'bras la blangs dor bya ba kho na gal che bar yin zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan kyang mdo las/ /lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyad yang chud mi za tshogs zhing dus la babs pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pas/ rang cag rnams kyi las dkar nag gang byas pa thams cad chud mi za ba rnam smin lus kyi grib ma ltar rjes su 'brang
nas 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis su smin par byed pa yin cing deng sang ni sdig pa'i las la spyod pa mang bas na/ /de'i rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ chen pos dmyal ba/ 'bring gis yi dwags/ nyung 〈chung 〉ngus dud 'gror skye shing / rgyu mthun dang bdag po'i 'bras bu ni gnas skabs su mtho ris kyi rten la yang tshe thung ba nad mang ba/ gzhan gyi gnod 'tshe mang ba dang / yul yid du mi 'ong ba sogs sdug bsngal kho na las ma 'das pa yin te/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ mi dge ba las kyi ngan 'gro dang / /de ni sdug bsngal thams cad do/ /ces pa dang / yang dge ba'i las che chung 'bring gsum du spyad pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ lha mi/ lha ma yin rnams su skye lhang / rgyu mthun dang bdag 'bras gnyis kyi dud 'gror skyes na'ang / gzugs bzang longs spyod che ba yul nyams dga' ba sogs bde ba bskyed pa 'byung ste/ gong gi 'phros las/ dge ba'i las kyi bde 'gro thob/ /skyes ba kun tu bde ba ldan/ /ces gsungs pas sdig spong dge sgrub kyi nyams len la 'bad dgos pa yang le lo dang g.yeng ba'i dbang du ma song ba gal che/ de yang 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad ni nam du yang mi rtag te/ skyes pa'i mtha' ma 'chi bas mi rtag /'dus pa'i mtha' ma 'bral ba'i mi rtag /bsags pa'i mtha' ma zad pa'i mi rtag /dar ba'i mtha' la rgud pa'i mi
༄༅/ /rtag /'dus byas kyi dngos po thams cad mi rtag pa'i sgo bzhir ma 'dus pa med cing / de ltar 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pa'i yid bskul te/ dam pa'i chos la brtson pa ma byas na/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di nyid thob pa don ldan du sgrub pa gal che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu'i don 'grub thob par 'gyur pa las/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma sgrub na/ /phyis nas yang dag 'byor ba ga la 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol bar byed pa'i mi yi lus rten gyi gru 'di la rang dbang spyod du yod pa'i skabs 'dir snyoms las kyi dbang du ma song ba zhig nges par dgos/ /de yang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can de ci 'dra ba zhig yod snyam na/ mdo las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams dud 'gro gcig gi gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag yongs su 'chal ba'i nyams/ /lha min 'thab dang rtsod pas nyams/ /lha rnams bag med g.yeng bas nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /bde ba 'dod na 'khor ba spong / /zhes gsungs shong / thams cad mkhyen pa zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyi zhal snga nas/ 'khor bar gnas phyin sdug bsngal rang bzhin du/ /bstan tshul
bsam na snying yang dum bur 'gas/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ /su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ /yo byad gang la spyod kyang sdug bsngal gyi yo lang 'ba' zhig yin pas na/ /skyon can 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i thabs thar pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba skabs su babs cing / de yang rgyu pha rol du phyin pa dang 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis las snga ma ni lam ring zhing bgrod bka' ba dang / myur lam bgrod bde ba gsang sngags kyi lam kho na mchog tu 'phags shing / de las kyang rang cag snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo rmongs pa shes rab dang brtson 'grus dman pa rnams kyi/ rgyud sde rin po che snying po'i bcud phyung ba nyams su len shing / don gyi skye bo 'tshangs med man ngag gyi zab lam zhig la nges par brten dgos te/ rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po'i zhal lung las/ skye 'gro tshe thung longs spyod dbul ba'i dus/ /mdo rgyud lung rigs nyan bshad mi 'tshal gyi/ /lha gcig bsgom la snying po sngags gcig bzlas/ /sems kyi ngo po gsal stong 'dzin med ltos zhes gsungs pa bzhin nyams su len pa la/ sngon du rgyud smin par byed pa dbang bskur ba gal che ste/ phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med pa la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir bas mar mi 'byung / /
༄tshi/ /gang zhig rgyud lung man ngag gi /dbang bskur med par chos mi 'chad/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal ba skye/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing / dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni gsang ba mchog las/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur nas/ /dus 'dir phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /mtho ris thar ba'i bdag por gyur ces pa'i gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i dbang bskur ba de la yang / gang gi bskur ba slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ /gang la bskur pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ /ji ltar bskur ba cho ga'i rim pa dang gsum las/ dang po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni mdo rgyud nas mang du gsungs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'o/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig nges par gal che/ dad ldan gyi slob ma yang / dad brtson shes rab rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa sogs yon tan gyi sgo du ma dang ldan pa dgos pa yin la bskur bya'i chos ni dbang chog rtsa bar/ de ltar dbang chen dregs pa'i dbang bskur thabs/ /rang gi mig dang snying las 'phang gyur kyang / /ma 'ongs snyigs ma bzhi bcu kha ral dus/ /dam sri sde brgyad rdul du brlag pa dang / /chos zab padma'i snying khrag dwangs ma 'di/ /'gro ba mchog dman su yi nyams
blangs kyang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar nges/ /rtag tu mi 'bral bcing ba'i chos mchog tu/ /bzang ngan 'brel tshad thugs rje'i smon lam gyi/ /bde chen gnas su 'khrid pa de la spro/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin zab pa las ches zab pa dpal rta mgrin rol pa dregs pa dbang bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba yin/ de lta bu'i zab mo chos kyi che ba yang / gter gzhung rtsa bar/ /dregs pa dbang bsdus zil gnon 'di/ /klu chen brgyad dang klu phran dang / /lha chen brgyad dang lha phran dang / /ma mo ye shes mkha' 'gro dang / /grong rgyu bsen mo man chod dang / /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po nas/ /'chi bdag las 'dre thams cad dang / /rgyal po gnam lha man chad nas/ /srid rkun the'u rang yan chad dang / /bdud rje 'gong yag man chad nas/ /nag po rta thod yan chad dang / /btsan rgod yam shud dmar po nas/ /sha ba 'phreng thod yan chad dang / /srid pa'i lha rabs sham po nas/ /yul lha lha phran thams cad dang / /bgegs rgyal bi na ya ga nas/ /yul 'dre chags 'dre man chad dang / /gza' bdud rog ti man chad nas/ /gza' bran rkun po yan chod rnams/ /dang po kha 'ching zil gyis gnon/ /bar du dbang bsdus bka' la nyan/ /tha ma las rnams ci bcol byed/ /ces gsung pa bzhin gyi byin rlabs tshad med 'byung shing / bka' gter
༄tshi/ /dag snang las byung ba'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub skor dpag tu med pa zhig bzhugs na yang kun las khyad par byin rlabs che ba/ slob dpon chen pos chos rgyal khri srong gi bzhed don sgrub phyir bod kyi lha 'dre gdug rtsubs can tha dag 'dul phyir dbang chen 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bcud phyung ba ni/ byang gter gyi nang tshan rta mgrin dregs pa dbang bsdus dang / 'khor 'das dbang bsdus gnyis su bzhugs pa la/ 'di ni dregs pa dbang bsdus kyi skor yin zhing / de yang sgrub thabs rtsa ba las/ /padma thod phreng rgyal po ngas/ /rje yi bka' byung bod du mchis/ /srid pa'i lha 'dre gdug rtsubs che/ /bod kyi lha 'dre 'dul ba dka'/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'og mi nyan/ /tshe la dbang thob rig 'dzin ngas/ /dbang chen 'dus pa'i rgyud las ni/ /dregs pa kha 'chings zil gnon rnyed/ /snang srid lha 'dre zil gyis gnon/ /rje yi thugs dam bsam yas bzhengs rgyal po'i thugs dgongs 'grub par bgyi/ /spel ba'i gnas med gter du sbas/ /las can gcig dang 'phrad par therdzog /bar gyi gnod sbyin 'dul ba la/ /'di las lhag pa med do bu/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i dbang chen dregs pa dbang bsdud kyi smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor du rgyud dag par byed pa las/ slob dpon gyi bgyi 'os dang / slob ma'i bgyi 'os gnyis su yod
pa las/ slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os ni sngon du bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes bzhin bsnyen pa bsgrub mchod gter bsrung mchod pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs legs par grub zin rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ngo skal du gyur ba las bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rta mchog rol pa tha mi dad pa'i zhabs drung du smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ maṇḍal khrul bcug la/ de ltar maṇḍal legs par phul grub nas thog mar/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du ma zhugs zhing ma rig pa'i brdar seng ras dmar po zhig mig dar du bkab pa'i tshul mdzod/ oX tsakyu bhanta wa ra ma ṇa ye swāhā:༷༷thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mjal ba la phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas phyag rten duspru dum wā ra'i me tog gi phreng ba re bzung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ a khaX we ra hūXltoX de nas me tog de nyid snyim pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste gsol ba btab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ /kyai:༷༷ 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa bla na medagiX bde gshegs kun 'dus bdag la dgongs su gsol4༷༷ ma rig las kyi mnar ba'i sems can la4༷༷thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang mchog bskur du gsol4༷༷ cesalan gsum rjesabazlosabya/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnang ba sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /kyai:༷༷ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod bdag la gson4༷༷ gsang ba
༄༅/ /mchog 'di rab tu gnyan pas na4༷༷ mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig bsrung nus samagiX de ltar khas len bdag gi gsang mchog sbyin4༷༷ zhesabla masangag tu brjod la dam tshig bdud rtsi ñtsa la byin/ de ltar dam tshig gi bdud rtsi 'di nyid bzhag pa lce la bzhag kyang thim pa snying gi dbus su thim rgyu yin pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung tshe mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'byung shing / tshul dang ma mthun tshe nyes pa 'byung bas legs nyes kyi bdud rtsi mna' chu 'di nyid lce thog myang ba dang khas blangs ba 'di yi rjes bzlos mdzod/ sa ma ya i dan na ra gan4༷༷ zhes bdud rtsi blud/ /de nas sngags kyi chos thams cad kyi sngon du skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa gnyis su yod pa las mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul dbang chen rta mgrin rol pa'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba skyabs yul gyi dbang por mos la/ /drin chen pha mas thog drangs sems can thams cad dang lhan gcig tu skyabs su 'gro ba dang / ma gyur sems can la byams pa/ snying rje byang chub sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i 'di yi rjes bzlos mdzod/las gzhung bzhin/ na mo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i:: sogs lan gsum bya/ de nas byin dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai ho/ bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad
kyi4༷༷ byin rlabs ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhesalan gsum/ de nas/ oX badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyod rang gi rnam smin sha khrag gi phung po 'di nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur / stong pa'i ngang las khyod rang rnams tha mal du gsal ba'i snying khar hrī yig dmar po gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa zhig gsal btab pa'i 'od zer gyi phung khams hrī dang bcas pa 'od du zhu bas rta mchog rol pa dregs pa zil gnon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byu ru'i lhun po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa ltar dmar zhing 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas kyi phyag rgyas gzugs khams 'degs shing / g.yon gyi phyag rgyas 'dod khams kyi sa gzhi gnon pa/ srid pa'i nyi zla gza' skar sked la 'khor ba dang / sku stod ri rab kyi steng du brjid chags shing / zhabs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gting du g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i dor stabs kyis gza' klu rgyal 'gong dam sri the'u rang gshin rje 'byung po rnams mnan pa/ dbu gtsug ral pa'i skra gseb nas rta mgo ljang nag zhur dkar po khrum khrum ser po rngog ma dmar po g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas rta skad thengs gsum re sgrogs pas/ srid pa'i pho rgyud mo rgyud dregs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ hrī hūX phaṭa gsum gyi drag sngags 'brug stong dus gcig sgrags pa ltar/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid
༄tshi/ /gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gsal btab/ slob dpon bdag kyang tha mal pa 'di lta bu ma yin pa dkyil 'bor gyi gtso bo rta mchog rol pa'i sku dngos su gsal ba'i dpon slob gnyis ga'i spyi bor oX dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po/ thugs gar hūX sngon po dang / hrī dmar po'i mtha' skor sngags phreng gi bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod sogs gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas khro rba'i rgyal po rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba steng nas byon pa thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa thams cad sa rlangs rdol ba lta bu/ bar nas byon pa thams cad nyi zer la rdul 'khrig pa lta bu byon nas khyod rang rnams la thim pas bar chod gdon bgegs sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms pa dang / mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus myur du 'grub par byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ dbang gzhung las/ hrīX lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas4༷༷ khro po'i rgyal po rta mgrin dbang gi lhagiX bde gshegs khro po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas4༷༷ thugs rjes brtser dgongs gnas 'dir byin phob cigagiX rtsa sngagasadang / hrī hrī hrī4༷༷ zhes pas gnyis med bstim/ 'o de ltar spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs de dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du brtan par byas pa'i
mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag /de nas sngon du phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de yi dam lhag pa'i lha rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul snyam pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di yi rjes bzlos mdzod/ puspro siddhi 6༷waX zhesame tog 'bul du gzhug /de nas me tog de nyid dkyil 'khor nas blangs te mgor lan gsum dkris pas dbang dang po me tog phreng ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me tog blangasate slob ma'i mgor lan gsum dkrisspyi bor bzhag la/ puṣṭi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūXltoX zhesasbyin/ ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba mig mkhan gyis rab rib la sogs mig nad bsal ba ltar/ deng 'dir yang ma rig pa'i mig dbye shing dag pa ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod / legs 'ong bu khyod skal bar ldan/ /ma rig ling thog nga yis bsal/ /rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor ltos/ /dam tshig rtse gcig thub par bsrung / dzñā na tsakyu pra be ya phaṭa4༷༷ de nas brten pa lha yi gzhal yas khang ni/ dmar nag gru gsum zla gam gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir 'khor 'ordzo rtsibs bzhi pa gru chad bar khyams :rdzo bzhi rta babs rim bzhi bum pa chos 'khor gdugs tog ri dwags pho mo rtsig pa kha dog sna lnga mda' yab bhū shud dra ba dra phyed 'dod yon snam bu nyi dkyil dur khrod rdo rwa me ris bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sogs4༷༷ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su dbang chen rta mchog rol pa dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i lha
༄tshi/ /tshogs thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin snang la rang bzhin med pa dmigs yul du mthong byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ cesalha ngo sprad pa bsdusapa tsam byed/ de nasadabang dngosal dbang bskur te/ 'o bum pa 'di nyid phyi ltar bum pa'i dbyibs la4༷༷ nang du dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal po sku dngos su gsal ba'i khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur bas lus kyi [nang gang ]sgrib bzhi dag sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīX rin chen bum pa mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs nangagiX dag byed ye shes bdud rtsi lha yi chu/ /bde gshegs dbang chen 'dus pa'i bum pa yis/ /skal ldan dbang bskur dbang bzhi'i snod gyur shogagiXhrīX ka la sha ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūXltoX rtsa bar byin dbab bum dbang ngo sprad dag par brjod/ cesagasungs pa bzhin/ hrīX mahā krerdzo ta: rtsa sngags/ na mo phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang yi dam khro rba'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rigs kyi bu 'di nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum la 'pho nas/ dus da lta nyid du 'dug sa 'di ru byin gyis rlabs shig nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub par byin gyis rlabs du
gsol hrī4༷༷ mahā kro ta::: sogs rtsa sngags/ a be sha ya a a brtag la byin dbab sposadang ḍā dril bya'o/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gsang dbang ni/ gsang rdzas 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur bas dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal po'i gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/thod pa mgrin par gag la/ hrīX chos sku snang mtha'i ngang las ma g.yos kyangagiX longs spyod rdzogs sku'i snang tshul cir yang ston4༷༷ sprul sku khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang gi lhagiX kun 'dus byang sems bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ro4༷༷ hrīXbho dhi tsitta a mṛ ta wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūXltoX rtsa bar rtsa mdud bkrol zhing a liṃ ka klasasgra don ngo sprod bya/ zhesagasungs pa ltar/ de ltar gsang rdzas bdud rtsi 'di nyid myang ba tsam gyi khyed rang gi lus la gnas pa'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi'i dkar dmar byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin yongs su gang bas de dag thams cad yi ge a li ka li'i rang bzhin rang sgra sgrogs pas bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa'i don yin no// de tsam ni snying po bsdusapa las rgyasabashad sprosapa'i shesabya ni bdag lta bu'i brjod pasayul las 'das so/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang bskur nas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ lam rjesags rim ba〈snam pa
༄༅/ /la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// sher dbang ni me long snying gar gag la/ me long 'di nyid phyi ltar me long gi rnam pa la/ don du lhan cig bde ba bskyed pa'i yum mtshan ldan gyi gzugs mtshan nyid dang ldan pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīX reg bya bde ba 'jam zhing yid du 'ong ltoX stong gsal mnyam yangs ye shes gsal sgrib medagiX sna tshogs 'char ba shes rab dbang mchog 'diljoX skal ldan gsang sngags dam par dbang bskur ro4༷༷ hrī garma mu tra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūXltoX rtsa bar bde stong ngo sprod de bzhin dag par brjod/ cesagasungs pa ltar/ de ltar brda' don mtshan ldan gyi rig ma 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams rnam pa rta mchog rol pa'i skur gsal ba la me 'odang 'di nyid yum rdo rje phag mor gsal bar snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul gsang sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams su ji ltar byung ba bzhin sbyor ba mdzad pas yas brtan dang mas babs kyi dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi zab mo rgyud la ngo 'phrod de bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa'i don yin no4༷༷ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs/ lam rdzogs pa chen po bsgom la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// gtor dbang ni/ 'o gtor snod dur khrod rngam brjid rol ba'i
gzhal yas su/ gtor ma khro bo'i rgyal po dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i sku mngon sum gsal ba'i dbang bskur bas gtor ma lha yi gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzodagiX hrīX snod bcud rnam dag rten dang brten pa bcas/ /rang lus phung khams dang bcas gzhas yas khang / /don dam rig stong 'gyur med bzhi pa'i dbang / /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /hrī ti la ka dzñā na ba linta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūXltoX zhesadabang bskur: phyag len du 'di yi rjesasu brgyud pa'i mag nas brjod pa'i bka' bsgo zhig mdzad srol 'dug par/ na mo chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku rta mchog rol pa/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ 'chim rdo rje sprel chung / gter ston rig 'dzin chen po/ sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal ba/ mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/ drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang / thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ drin can tshe ring dbang po/ rang grol klu grub dbang po/ rig 'dzin rol ba'i rdo rje bse ston thugs mchog 'od 'bar/ khyab bdag rig 'dzin padma 'phrin las/ sha zug pa lhun grub rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang chen po skal bzang padma dbang phyug sprul sku rin po che ye shes lhun grub/ rig
༄༅/ /'dzin khyab bdag grub dbang padma bshes gnyen/ rgyal sras padma theg mchog rig 'dzin khams gsum zil gnon/ rig brgya'i khyab bdag kun bzang nam mkha' klong yangs/ bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa rgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma rnams dang / yi dam khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa rigs kyi bu 'di yi lus ngag yid gsum la dus da lta nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs la nad gdon sdig sgrib kyi tshogs spyi dang bye brag steng 'og bar gsum gyi 'byung gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad lhun gyis grub ste mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /cesabarjod/ rtsa bar bzhi pa ngo sprod de bzhin dag par brjod/ gzhan don bu la bka' srung gag rgya byed/ cesagasungs pa ltar/ de ltar gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi ba rig pa'i rtsal dbang de yang rdzogs pa chen po'i don yin pas/ snang srid snod bcud phung khams skye mched thams cad gtor ma'i lha dang gzhas yas su gsal ba yang rig pa'i rtsal las grub pa yin pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu nas gtor ma'i gzhal yas la thim/ nang bcud kyi sems can gtor ma la thim/ de yang gzhal yas rim bzhin 'od du zhu ba gtor ma'i gzhal yas la
thim / gzhas yas rim bzhin 'od du zhu ba gtor ma'i lha la thim/ lha dbu zhabs nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu bas thugs gar hrī la bsdu/ hrī de nyid rim bzhin 'ja' ltar yal nas dmigs med spros bral gyi don la mnyam par bzhag des dbang bzhi pa rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag sku gsum gyi byin rlabs lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs/ lam de kho na nyid bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa yin no/ /zhesabarjod bka' srung ba'i gag rgya 'di 'gro don nusapa'i bla ma skyesachen 'dra ma gtogs thams cad la spang bya yin pas mi bya ba gal che/ de ltar byang gter mdzod lnga'i nang tshan nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas rten 'brel khyad par can gyi chos tsan ldan gyi sdong po lta bu'i yal ga brgyad kyi nang nas yi dam khro po'i rgyal po dbang chen rta mchog rol pa dregs pa dbang bsdus kyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo legs bar grub zin pas/ dbang dus su ji ltar byung ba'i dbang bzhi so so'i dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pa bgyis la 'di yi rjes bzlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal55 sogs/ da lta dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ /slar yang lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phul nas cha shas longs spyod du gsol snyam pa'i 'di yi rjes bzlos mdzod/ dengs nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyod la
༄tsho/ /bdag ni sku ngas 'bul na/ /khyod kyi slob mar bdag bzung la/ /cha shas kyis kyang stsal du garbe/la/ /de yi dge ba ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo bar zhu/ barbe da nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba 〈snang rab 'khrugs pa'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'a11 ba 〈snal bar (keg /rjesakyi bya ba lhag ma/ chad tho brtan skyong mchod bstod bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shirisabya'o/ /de ltar dregs pa dbang du sdud pa'i chos/ /rta mchogarol pa'i smin byed dbang bskur thabs/ /gter gzhung zab mo bsre lhad med pa la/ /bla ma'i phyag len zur gyisalegs par brgyan/ /bdag dang bdaga'adra'i blo rmongs 'ga' tsam la/ /bltas chogadabang gi cho ga 'di lta bu/ /med tshe dgosadusadape snyogs brel pas nongs/ /de phyir nag 'groskhrigs chagasazhal lung 'di/ /dad ldan dge slong padma mdo sde yiris/ /lhagapa'i lha 'di nyams len byin rlabs mthun/ /gzhan don re skongs phyir du bskul ba ltar/ /sngags ban 'chol med padma thegamachogagis/ /legs par bri4sa'athub bgyisate bskrun pa'i dges/ /ma rung bdun sde'i mun pa'i tshoges bcom nas/ /padma dbang chen dgyesazhal nyin byed 'od/ /phyogs dusakun tu gsal shing 'bar gyur :rig/ //maṅgalaX// //

༄tshiltoX ltoX'ajam dbyangs gsung / 'khor 'das chos rnams rtog bral phyag rgya ches/ dbang phyug : che btsan dregs myos srid zhi'i dkor nor dang / rang srog 'khor los gtam pa'i srid mes brten/ lcags zhags nyi zlas mtshan sogs brten rdzas kyis/ dbang phyug lcam : rin chen khang bzang gser dngul dbyig dang g.yu/ ra ga nor bu rnam mang nor bu dang / ja dar sha mar 'bru rigs phyur bkang bas/ dbang phyug zo mdor na bskang dang bskang byed gnyis su med/ rgyud gsum dregs pa rang rig zang thal ngang / rang shes lhun grub 'ub tshud lta ba ches/ dbang phyug lcam dral 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / de ltar thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus dang / srid pa gsum na 'gran zla bral ba yi/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod/ zhesabaskang nas bshags pa ni/ tha mal gyi snang bas dam tshig las 'gal khrur gyur pa gnongs 'gyod drag posa.athi+-igs pa'i blos/ kyai gar gyi dbang phyug lha chen yab yum rnams/ chos dbyings chen po gshegs bzhud las 'das kyang / gdung shugs mos pa'i blo yis bskul lags na4༷༷ tshad med brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol4༷༷ rdo rje rgyal dang rtsa gsum spyan sngar cher/ sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rtsa ba dang / yan lag dam tshig tha mal gyi blo yis/ spangs blangs nyams chags ci mchis mthol lo

༄༅/ /lha dbang klu bdag lang ga'i rgyal po sogs/ /srid gsum dbang phyug kun gyis mdun bdar nas/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos srid zhur bcas mchod pa'i/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang brtsegs las rgyal ba'i/ /rin chen shel gyi sku mkhar zla ba'i byin/ /ba gam nor bu'i 'od tshogs rab rgyas pa/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i go skabs yang dag phrogs/ /rtsa ba yid bzhin 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyis/ /bar med rab rdzogs sked skabs tshon lngas po/ /'dzam bu na da'i rgya phub ches 'phar ba'i/ /rtse mo rin chen char 'beb chu 'dzin dkrig /dus gsum rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul dag las bzhin/ /rgya che bkod pa'i khyad par rgya che ba'i/ /pho brang srid rtse dgung na mngon mtho'i rtse/ /yid bzhin rgyal mtshan gsar pas mnga' gsol lo/ /dpag yas zhing gi rdul rnyed rab
༄tshi/ /'byams zhing / /skad cig nyul ba'i 'gros ldan lha rta dkar/ /rgyu skar bdag po dregs 'joms rgyan ldan pa/ /lha chen chibs kyi dam pa mnga' gsol lo/ /ka tsa linta'i ber chen gsum brtsegs pas/ /mdzes 'dzum rlabs kyi gzugs brnyan bgos 'os pa/ /'jam gnyen reg bya'i khyad par rmad byung ba'i/ /rab mdzes lha yi na bza' mnga': nor bu'i phyi lham gser gyi ske rags 'bar ga bur do shal rin chen so mo do/ /mu tig 'bras chags nor bu'i snyan cha sogs/ /mdzes byed brgyan gyi dam pa mnga'/ /gser pad g.yu yi yal 'dab mdzes pas khong / /rnam mang 'od kyi ge sar rab rgyas pa/ /spel legs 'phreng ba bltar ba'i cod paṇa 'di/ /skra mtshams mdzes pa'i rgyan du: brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu las lhag nor/ /bkra shis dam pa kun gyis bkra shis par/ /
rgyal ba'i rab sngags g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /thor tshugs mdzes pa'i rgyan du mnga'aca rtse mor zur phud lngar bcings ral pa'i khyon4༷༷ bung ba stang zil mig sman ltar snum pa'i/ /rtsa chings bkra shis ri mos rnam bkra ba'i/ /dar dkar dri med lwa bas mnga': myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan ba la har/ /bskul byed phyag rgya'i khyad par mi 'tshal yang / /ma bdud las la bskul ba'i 'phrul chen mo/ /sba lcags rdo rjes mtshan pas mnga': cha shas rab rdzogs zla ba'i spun zla zhes/ /bdud rtsis bran pa'i zan ma dngos grub ltar/ /zad mi shes 'bab nor bu'i shel phreng 'di/ /thugs dam dbyings su zlog phyir mnga'aza dar zab spyan gzigs mang pos sa bla'i khongs/ /brgya byin gzhu yi dra bas mdzes byas zhing / /snyan brjid dpa' bo nyams ldan 'bod pa'i dbyangs/ /sna tshogs rol mor bcas pa'i mnga'acha gtsang ma'i zhal zas la sogs 'dod yon lnga/ /lha klu mi dang gnod sbyin thams cad kyi/ /dkor nor ma tshangs med spungs nor 'dzin ma'i/ /'phags pa rab rdzogs 'dod dgu'i mnga'acha dkon mchog skyabs kyi dam par skyabs song mgron/ /dkar phyogs lha dang gdon can 'byung po'i tshogs/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu rtsal rmad byung ba/ /kun gyi rje bor deng bdag gzengs bstod de/ /khyad par dpal gyi sprul pa padma'i lung / /ji bzhin mnoms pa'i bka'
༄tshi/ /las ma 'da' bar/ /gter ba gnas bdag dkor bdag thams cad kyi/ /tshogs bdag tshogs kyi rje bor gzeng bstod do/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs mchis pa'i lha/ /brten gsol mchod bsgrub lha srungs gnyan rnams dang / /khri srong lha brgyud sku lha gnyan rnams kyi/ /rje btsun lha yi lha mchog gzengs bstod do/ /rgyal dbang padma'i ring lugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ /dbu 'phang ri rgyal rtse mor gzengs ba3sted phyir/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi mnga' garbershal gzengs bahrīrshad na/ /lha yi lha ma'o1ga lha zhal malngardzo bar malngangod// // cesapa'ang phyi rten gcan gzan gyi bsad pa sogs thang lha gnyan po lha ngo dma' ba'i ltas 'dra byung nas/ sngagasa'achang yol mo bas ched du byas pa'o/ lha rgyal lo// //
(tsha)༄༅/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi srog gtad kyi rjesaganang mu thi la'i 'phrong ba bzhugs so/ /
