༄༅/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ dngos grub ma lus rtsol mdzad pa/ lha mchog dri za'i rgyal po yi/ srog gtad rjes gnang rim pa bri/ de yang stegs bu ras dkar po dri ma med pa sogs kyi g.yogs pa'i steng du mañdza'i khar bsgrub gtor sku rten tsaka li/ gtor gdugs dkar po can bshams/ chu gsum chu gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod sbreng tshar/ sman phud 'bul gtor zur gsum lug mgos brgyan pa/ gser skyems bgegs gtor rol mo yungs dkar/ ar skya/ spos dkar sogs nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams mngon par 'du byas/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas bzung rta mgrin gyi bstod pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la bzlas pa mang nyung long skabs dang bstun nas bya/ chos sman ma btab pa'i nang mchod gsar pa yin na/ sman gtor gzhung bzhin byin rlabasacaX hrī mahā kro tas
༄7/ /bsangs/ swa bhā was mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las man shel gyi khang bzang zhes pa nas/ rgyab gyi ru 'dren lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa ste/ so so brgya phrag dang bcas pas bskor bas bar dang / de dag gi phyi rol du phyogs su ngo kro ye shes zhes pa nas/ mjug ma brdab pa'i me rlung 'chubs pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ de dag gi phyi rol du lha klu gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum sdes bskor bas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oX / zhes pa nas bzung ste gtor bsngos kyi bar bya/ 'dzab mang du bzlas te nus ldan du byed/ bstod pa lha yi mchog mas bstod/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi lus gangs chu gtsang mas khrus nas 'don/ spos dang gu gul dkar pos bdug phyag dang yon 'bul bgegs gtor btang / thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro smyi dang / bye brag snga 'gyur theg pa'i
chos kyi che ba phan yon bshad/ khyad par du slob dpon chen po'i bka'i srung ma rnams kyi nang nas/ gtso bor gyur ba lha chen rdo rdze 'bar ba rtsal 'di nyid ngo bo sa brgyad non pa/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po yin pa la rgyal bsen sogs lha srin ma rungs pa rnams kyi gnyen pos dam can shel gong dkar po/ lha gnam the dkar po/ gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po dung gi thor chugs can/dri za zur phud lnga pa/ khyab mjug gnam mtsho'i rgyal po ste/ sku gcig la mtshan drug tu grags pa/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'di nyid gnas skabs 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul bzung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ thang yig las de nas sku gnyan thang lha'i nyams tshad phyir/ mgo bo gru gu'i yul du slob pa la/ mjug ma khams kyi sogs chu g.yer thang bskyang / sbrul dkar zhig gi lam 'phrang bcad pa la/ slob dpon sbrul gyi sked par phyag mkhar btsugs/ klu'i rgyal po nee le thod dkar khyod/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa zhes/ khyod rang phar song tshogs 'bor bshams dang gsungs/ thang lhas gangs la bros pas gangs zhu nas/ rtse mo nag sang g.ya' sngon nyil gyi byung / ma bzod zhal zas sna tshogs tshogs 'khor drangs/ byis pa g.yu yi zur phud can du gyur/ dar dkar ral dgu zhig gyon phyag bskor byas/ srog snying phul nas dam btags gter rgya
༄tshi/ /gtad / gsang mtshan rdo rje mchog rab rtsal du gsol/ zhes pa ltar slob dpon chen po la tho 'tshams pa'i bka' rtag phyag rgya chen pos zil gyis mnan te dam la btags nas srung mar bskos/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi byang lam bar ba nas bsam yas has po ri'i mdun du byon pa'i dus su gnyan chen thang lha ste g.yag dkar po rā nam mkha'i mthong na ye re ba/ rmig pa ru bzhi'i sa bdud non pa zhig byas nas slob dpon gyi drung du tshur byung / chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan mthong ba dang / g.yag dkar por brdzus pa'i rdzu 'phrul shig nas/ skyes bu bzhin bzang dkar po dung gi mdog can g.yu'i zur phud lnga yis rgyan pa zhig tu byas te/ rgyal po la phyag dang zhe sa phul lo/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ gnyan chen po thang lha srin yal gam can zhig 'dug ste/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la 'go zhing grogs byed pa ci'i phyir gsungs so/ thang lhas zhus/ bdag gnyis la 'brel ba zhig mchis so/ bdag dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha lags pas/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan bod kyi rgyal po lags te/ che mnyam dpung gis 'brel lo/ bdag dam tshig can gyi srung ma lags pas/ rgyal po dam tshig gtsang ste dam tshig gi 'brel lo/ bdag skye bo ngo mtshar can gyi pho lha lags pas/ rgyal po gsang khrims che bas/
las dang spyod pa 'brel lo/ bdag sde pa bsod nams can gyi grogs la dga' bas che mnyam bsod nams 'brel ba lags so/ zhes zhus so/ yang zhus pa/ kyai slob dpon chen po lags/ da nang dgung gi snga dro bdag khro zhing gtum pa'i gzugs su byas te 'ong ba ni/ bdag dam tshig nyams pa'i srog bdud/ dam tshig nyams pa'i bshed ma/ grib gnon ma rabs kyi gnya' non/ smyo 'dre rgyal 'gong gi gnyen po lags pas de rnams mthong ba dang rang bzhin bdag la zhe sdang skyes te gtum zhing khros pa lags so/ zhes zhus so/ yang slob dpon gyis gsungs pas/ 'o na gnyan che thang lha khyod/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la rang bzhin gyi 'go ba 'dus pas/ rgyal po nyid nas 'od gsal lha'i gdung brgyud mtha' ma dgung du ma gshegs kyi bar du sku lha gyis shig rgyal pos mchod cig ces lha brag gter byon gyi lo rgyus las byung ba ltar/chos skyong rgyal po sku lha khyad par can 'phral byin rlabs myur zhing phugs bkra shis pa'i lha chen 'di nyid nub zangs mdzod kyi srung mar bka' bskos/ chos skor rnams zang zang lha brag tu gter du sbas pa snying thig gnad kyis man ngag don bdun las/ byang phyogs tho yor nag po'i sa phyogs sugiX ri bo bkra bzang zhes pa'i shar 'dabs sugiX chu khams glang lo sme ba'i mtshan rtags can4༷༷ padma nga yis byin gyisarlabs pa'i rtags4༷༷
༄tshi/ /spyi bor rgod kyi ldem 'phru yang yang 'byungagiX zhes lung gis zin pa'i gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rgod kyi ldem phru can gyi drangs pa'i rjes gnang dang / man ngag gi skor gnyis las/ srog dbang 'di nyid gter ston nas rtsa ba'i bla ma zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du chad med du bzhugs pa'i srog gtad zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul du bzhugs de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar skyabs sems sdom pa gzung ba'i ched du/ thugs rje dbang gis 'gro don mdzadagiX ces pa nas/ rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgomagiX zhes pa'i bar lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du bcug sku'i rjes gnang gi don du slob dpon dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i spyan sngar rjes bzlos 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces brda sprod/ dbang chen rgyal po he ru gagiX rnam sprul dpa' bo padma 'byungagiX bdag la rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷ sku yi byin rlabs gzi byin phobaltoX ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon dbang chen rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi bsgrub gtor lha chen 'bar ba rtsal du gsal ba'i sku la phog de'i rkyen gyis lha chen gyi sku las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa zla ba shar ba lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa slob ma'i lus la thim pas lus
kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bag chags thams cad sbyangs pas lus 'od kyi phung po dkar lam gyi song / de'i ngang nas slob ma skad cig gis padma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ slob ma'i rnam par shes pa āXdakar po yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo'i mngon rtogs dkyus su yod pa brjod de sgom du bcug pa'i spyi bor gtor ma bzhag te/ hūXltoX rta mgrin rgyal po dbang gi lha'igiX rnam sprul dpa' bo padma 'byungagiX skal ldan slob ma'i sgo gsum la4༷༷ dam can rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷ sku yis byin brlab gzi byin phobaltoX hrī badzra thang ka ra mu nyid khu sha li dzaXhūX baX ho:༷༷ zhes brjod sku'i byin rlabs 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa spyi bo nas sib sib thim/ lha chen gyi sku dang slob ma'i lus ngo bo dbyer med du byas/ sku'i byin rlabs dngos grub thob par bsam/ mchod pa gsar du bshams pa med na kha gsos de/ chu dang nyer spyod rol mo rnams spro na gdangs dang bcas nas tshig bcad dam mi spro na sngags tsam gyis/ slob mas gtor ma lhar gsal ba la mchod pa'i tshul bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol 'debs tshig rkang gsum po gong ltar la/ gsungs gi byin rlabs gzi byin phobaltoX ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha chen gyi mgrin par phog pa'i rkyen gyis/ lha chen gyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus pa thams
thon te/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas/ yid kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad sbyang pas/ lus sngon po'i phung por mer gyis zhu bar bsam la/ gtor ma snying gar bzhag te/ bskur tshig kha bsgyur/thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi gzi byin phobaltoX hrīXbadzra sogs brjod/ thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pa snying gar sim gyi thim pas/ lha chen gyi thugs dang slob ma'i yid dbyer med du byas thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thob par bsam la/ sngar bzhin mchod/ yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang gi don du dngos gzhi gong ltar la/ yon tan byin rlabs gzi byin phobaltoX 'phrin las byin rlabs gzi byin phob ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btabs/ slob dpon rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha chen thugs gar phog pa'i rkyen gyis lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku las nor bu dbang gi rgyal por song / lha mi'i rin po che'i char chen po dang / 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros pas lus la thim pas/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang ltem gyis gang sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar gcod thams cad sbyangs pas/ lus kha dog lnga ldan du song bar bsam la/ gtor ma lte ba'i thad du bzhag ste/ bskur tshig dngos gzhi 'dra ba la/ yon tan byin rlabs gzi byin phobaltoX 'phrin las byin rlabs gzi byin phobaltoX
༄tsho/ /hrīXbadzra sogs brjod yon tan gyi byin rlabs 'od zer ser po dang / phrin las kyi byin rlabs 'od zer ljang khu lte ba gsang gnas su sib kyis thim pas yon tan 'phrin las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam la sngar ltar mchod/ dam bsre ba ni/ dam chu a mṛ ta slob mar sbyin zhing gtor ma thogs/ gtor ma sngar bzhin spyi bor bzhag te/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal mchog padma thod phreng / paṇa chen dri med bzhes gnyen/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha sras mu khri btsan po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gter ston rig 'dzin rgod ldem/ sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po/ sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal / sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon po/ mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ drin can sangs rgya dpal bzang / ldong gi sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ za hor sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag gi dbang phyug/ blo bzang rgyal mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang grag pa/ rig 'dzin legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rngog gi bande o rgyan
yongs grags sogs kyi bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po dran par mdzod la/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'bor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi rdo rje slob ma 'di'i nyin gsum bya ra mdzod/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod la / bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs/ khyad par steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon bgegs rgyal bsen/ dam sri 'byung po/ ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad dug mtshon g.yul bshoms sogs / gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang / gzugs med gnod pa'i bgegs rnams kyis btang ba'i bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung zhing skyobs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang / thos bsam sgom gsum sogs chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas bka' bsgo rgyas pas brjod/ rjes sngags mthar/dzaXhūX baX hos/ lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas sib kyis thim par bsam te/ de nas dam tshig bsdus ste/ khas blang ba ni/ rdo rdze 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin dugiX bdag ni rtse gcig gus gdung ba'igiX ma lus bdag gi sgrub lags na4༷༷ brtse bas rjes bzung byin gyis brlobs4༷༷ zhes lan gsum gyis rjes bzlos bya/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ bkra shis rgyas pa byed/ slar yang mchod gtor kha gsos/ tsa ka li
༄tshi/ /sogs rten lhar skyed pa rnams la 'bul zhing bstod/ yig brgya brjod cing lhag chad kha bkang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ brtan bzhugs dang shos brjod bya'o/ e ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi/'khrul med phyag bzhes mu thi la/ rnam dpyod srad bur brgyus pa yis/ lha yi mchog tu grogs mdzad shog /ces lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi srog gtad kyi rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba 'di dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul bas mtshams sbyar rigs sngags 'chang ba mang po'i phan 'dod kyi yid drangs nas gter gzhung du mi gsal ba rnams bla ma dam pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan ste za hor gyi brnye thogs med rtsal gyis gro zhun zla ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa la pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid do/ shubham// //
(dza)༄tsho/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi gser skyems sogs bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa gser skyems dang bcas pa 'bul lo/ sku gsung thugs la nyams chag phog thug byung ba thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon bar chad chags sgo nyam nga / byad kha sde brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad dang / khyad par steng gdon dang / rgyal po'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ bye brag rgyal 'gong chos gos ngur smrig gyon nas bar chad rtsom pa po sprul pa'i lha g.yag dkar pos thal ba'i rdul du brlog cig /mdor na 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa can/ thang lha mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas/ 'dir gshegs mdos kyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes shog /dam rdzas
༄༅/ /bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'dis bzhes shig/ dzam bu te ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig/ dza gad dpa' po'i sman phud/ sogs dkyus bzhin no// //
(15)༄༅/ /zangasamadzod gter bsrung rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi mchod sprin yid bzhin sprin phung zhesabya ba'o/ /
༄tshi/ /'dir lha chen rdo rdze 'bar ba rtsal gyi gsang bsgrub dang 'brel ba'i 'phrin las rim pa la 'jug par 'dod pas/ bcas kyi bya ba gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin la rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan pa mngon par 'du bgyis shingacaX skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnams sngon du 'gro bsacaX rang rig sa bon yi ge hrīXdamar po 'od du zhu ba las bdag nyid skad cig gi bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag ri rab la stegs bcas pa'oX dbu tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du sleb cing zhabs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gting du bsgrad pa'oX nyi zla gza' skar sked pa la 'khor bcaX phyag g.yas kyi gzugs khams 'degs cing g.yon pas 'dod khams gnon pa'oX dur khrod kyi chas kun gyis brgyan cing dbu gtsug gi rta mgo drag po nga ro sgrog pa'oX dregs pa can thams cad skrag pas 'dar zhing dbang
༄༅/ /du sdud pa/ zhal nas hrīXhūXcaXphaṭa gsum gyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam sgrog pas khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gyuracaX hrīX mahā krerdzo ta padma ta krita hya yaX ghri wa hūX hūX phaṭa ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri hrīXhūX phaṭa'oX zhes ci rigs bzlas la bstod pa ni 'jam rol dang bcasacaX rta mgrin rgyal po dbang gi lha'oX dregs pa kun 'dul padma 'byungacaX bla ma rig 'dzin sprul sku lacaX sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo'oX de nasasku brten dang bsgrub gtor ma la dmigs te/ oX swā hā wa shuddha sarba dharma swā bha wa shurnyo3haXcaX stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du shel gyi khang bzang rin po che sna tshogs kyi sgo lcog 'od 'bar ba rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho phyur bcaX sked par 'ja' 'od na bun gyi gur phub pa'oX rtse mor sprin dkar rin po che'i zil char 'bebs pa'oX sa gzhi ljang sngon la me tog sna tshogs rgyas
pagiX 'khor yug tu gnam lha brgyad kyis gangs ris shel gyi mchod rten ltar bskor bltoX de'i steng du nyi zla padma'i gdan la stobs ldan rta mchog ngang dkar rin po che'i sga rgyan du mas mdzes pa'i stegs na lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog shel gyi ri bo ltar brjid pagiX zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pagiX spyan gsum rab tu bkra bltoX dbu skra'i thor tshugs dar dkar pos bcings pagiX phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa'i sba lcags nam mkha' la 'phyar bltoX g.yon pa shel dkar phreng ba 'dren pagiX zab ber dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi ber gsol bltoX spyi bor nor bu 'bar ba'i tog dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang bcas pagiX sku gzhon zhing mdzes pagiX rgyal po rol pa'i cha lugs su bzhugs pagiX de'i 'khosar du mched 'khosar sum brgya drug cugiX dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum thegiX thams cad dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i cha lugs su 'jigs shing dpa' ba steng dang phyogs mtshams kun nas sprul pa'i dung khra dkar po dngagiX dung spyang pho mo dngagiX 'brong g.yag zhol chen mang po lding zhing ngar bltoX de'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer dngagiX bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi dkyil la gnas pa'i hrīXyig dmar po las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros par rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku lha chen po sprul
༄tshi/ /'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du byon pa gyuraltoX hūXltoX sngon tshe ka dag rdo rdze dbyings4༷༷ nang gsal 'od kyi gzhas yas khangagiX 'og min 'phrul gyi zhing khams sugiXsangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyiraltoX byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snyingagiX sprul pa lha chen 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷ mi 'jigs kun la dbang bsgyur ba'igiX tshangs pa'i rgyal po mthu bo chegiX dregs pa'i sde dpon kun gyi rjegiX shel ging gnam lha dkar po grags4༷༷ gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron mgiX byang thang gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo stegiX mched 'khor gtsang rigs lha yi tshogs4༷༷ bka' sdod dregs ldan du mas bskoraltoX lha chen dpal 'bar drag shul can4༷༷ rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis sku bskyed tshegiX sa gzhi ri brag thams cad kyangagiX mtho dman med par shodas se zhongagiX dpung tshogs char sprin 'thib pa bzhin4༷༷ dgyes pa'i gad rgyang di ri ri4༷༷ spyan 'dren dang 〈dad 〉pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs4༷༷ nyi zla padma rin chen khriraltoX ye shes gsang ba'i lha mchog khyodagiX bstan srung rgyal po mnga' gsol tshegiX sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la4༷༷ gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum bzhin rgyas4༷༷ nag phyogs bdud dpung zil gyis mnon4༷༷ dpa' bo stobs ldan snying rje can4༷༷ sde dpon chen po'i spyan snga 〈coX bdag gis khas blangs dam bca' g.yel4༷༷ dam tshig nyams chags mthol lo
bshags4༷༷ mnyes mchod thugs dam bskang ba nigiX man shel 'od 'phros gsang ba'i rten4༷༷ ting 'dzin gsal bas thugs dam bskangagiX dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten4༷༷ bsnyen bsgrub bzlas pas thugs dam bskangagiX sku 'bag rgyan ldan phyi yi rten4༷༷ 'dod yon longs spyod thugs dam bskangagiX rab dang zhi ba'i rlan ldan gtsang ma'i chabs/ lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgra bcas rgyun 'bab klung / g.ya' chu gangs chu lu mar skye sogs kyi/ mchod yon mdzes pas bsgrengs pas khyod mchod do/ puṇḍa ri ga'i tshal rgyas utpal nags/ gzhan yang chu dang thang skyes me tog tshogs/ dpyid kyi dpal mos rab 'phel phreng mdzes pa/ lha mchog dbu la 'ching ba'i thod du 'bul/ tsandan sbos dkar lha shug sogs sbyar ba'i/ dud sprin srid pa gsum gyi blar spungs pa/ ma dag nyes pa'i dri ma kun sel ba/ shangs kyi dbang po tshim phyir bdag 'bul lo/ rab sbyangs nor bu'i sgron me sna tshogs dang / rtsi bcud til gyi mar me gsal 'bar bas/ bskal pa'i she mun mthar byed a lo ke/ ma sgrib gsal ba spyan gyis gzigs mor 'bul/ ga bur drogs pas rab bsil grum par gyi/ ge sar rdul tshon rgyas pa rab mdzes pa/ yi 'ong khrus kyi lding bu 'di dag ni/ brjid pa'i sku la byugs pa'i rdzas su sbyar/ 'bras dkar phung po 'bru bcud bzang po dang / gnyis su med sbyar rgyan
༄༅/ /ldan gtsang ma'i bshos/ dkar gsum mngar gsum shing tog 'bru sna yis/ ljags kyi dbang po kun nas tshim gyur cig rnga chen dung dang sil snyan gling bu'i sgras/ rab srangs [snyan ]〈sang 〉dri za'i dbyings su rnam 'tsher ba'i/ spyan drangs mchod bstod bskul ba'i gyer mang po/ thogs pa med gsan lha yi snyan la 'bul/ skad cig gcig la stong gsum 'jig rten kun/ bgrod byed rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan mdzes pa'i chibs/ gser dngul dar zab rgyan ldan lha rta dkar/ gsang chen bka' yi bya ra mdzad phyir 'bul/ sprin dkar dag pa'i phung po cher spungs lta'i/ zhal dkar rdo rje rwa ldan ri ltar 'gying / sna tshogs dar gyi phon pos ltar mi ngoms/ phyi rten lha g.yag mdzes pa'i thugs dam bskang / thogs med cir yang rgyu ba skar mda'i spun/ mdzes pa'i dung khra 'phur lding gzan la bcum/ shel dum [bum ]ltar dkar gtsang lug mang po yis/ lha mchog thugs kyi dgyes pa skongs gyur cig/ ri mo bris dang ratna sman sogs las/ yongs grub sku 'bag rgyan ldan phyi yi rten/ shel dkar rin chen sgo lcog 'bar ba'i dbyibs/ dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten du 'bul/ ting 'dzin gsal ba'i dar mtshon man shel dkar/ dri med 'od rgyun zad mi shes pa'i rten/ rnam par mi rtog thugs kyi dam rdzas mchog /gsang rten yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs
dam bskang / mchog dman rin chen mang spungs gter gyi ri/ dar zab lda lding 〈lde 〉rab dpyangs tshon ris kyis/ phyogs la dbang po'i mtshon dgod spyan gzigs kyis/ lha gnyan 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /mnal gru bzhi smyug rgod dar zab brgyan/ dar dkar gzhi mar legs bris snying po'i 'phreng / gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub las la sbyor ba yi/ dam rdzas ma tshang med bsags yongs kyis bskang / bde gsal mi rtog dbyings rig dbyer med pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bgrod gcig lam/ lha chen thugs kyi dgongs pa zab zhi'i ngang / ji bzhin mnyam par bzhag pas thugs dam bskang / bstod pa ni/ hūXltoXdpal ldan lha yi lha mchog khyodagiX 'dzam gling byang phyogs kha ba can4༷༷ kha ba can gyi byang ljongs sugiX sa gzhi ljang sngon rtsi bcud rgyas4༷༷ me tog padma 'od du 'phrogiX gangs dkar shel gyi phreng bas bskoraltoX yid 'ong mtsho chen mdangs dang ldan4༷༷ shel mkhar rin chen sgo lcog 'baraltoX rtsa ba yid bzhin rgya mtsho brten4༷༷ rked pa 'ja' mtshon na bun 'thibs4༷༷ rtse mo sprin dkar dgos 'dod kyi4༷༷ rin chen char 'bebs 'brug sgra sgrogs4༷༷ gzhal yas de yi nang shed na4༷༷ nyi zla padma rta mchog stengagiX dam can rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷ sku mdog dkar la khro 'dzum 'gyingagiX phyag g.yas rdo rje sba lcag 'phyaraltoX g.yon pa zla ba'i shel phreng 'dren4༷༷
༄khu/ /dar dkar thod bcings dbu skra'i rtseraltoX yid bzhin nor bu 'bar bas brgyan4༷༷ sku la ber chen phrug gsum gsol4༷༷ gzhon mdzes yid 'phrog rgyal po'i chas4༷༷ 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phrogiXmched 'khosar sum brgya drug cu dngagiX dmag dpung bye ba 'bum sdes bskoraltoX kun kyang khro gtum brjid pa'i gzugs4༷༷ dar tshon rol mos nam mkha' gangagiX bde gshegs stong gi bstan pa srungs4༷༷ padma 'byung gnas bka' bzhin sgrubs4༷༷ chos rgyal mnga' ris bu bzhin skyongs4༷༷ dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha mdzodagiX rje dpon yongs kyi dgra lhar 'gyuraltoX rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstodagiX lha chen yongs kyi rje bor bstodagiXdri za'i rgyal po khyod la bstodagiX deng nas rig 'dzin mchog thob b.raltoX snyan pa nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs4༷༷ grags pa gza' skar 'od ltar khyeraltoX dbu 'phang ri rgyal rtse ltar bstodagiX rigs rgyud chu bo'i rgyun ltar spel4༷༷ dgos 'dod dpag bsam shing ltar stsolaltoX sde brgyad dregs pa bran ltar bkol4༷༷ smyo 'dre rgyal po rdul bzhin thul4༷༷ dam med mna' zan bgegs zhing sgrol4༷༷ bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin4༷༷'a11gas nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsoleltoX gzhan yang 'phrin las bcol ba ni: dnge/ gzhan du yol mo pa gsum nga/samadzad ces 'khod 'dug padma thod 'phreng rgyal ba'i spyan snga 〈coX dam bca' zhal bzhes thugs dam rjes dbordzongs la4༷༷ rnal
'byor bdag gi ji ltar bcol ba'i las4༷༷ ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa'i las mdzod cigagiX smyo ba'i 'dre 'dul rgyal po kun 'dul zhingagiX rnam thos bu yi bdog pas yang dag 'byoraltoX sngags skyes mu tra dbang du 'du ba dngagiX phas rbesnal g.yul las rgyal ba'i las mdzod cigagiX 'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung bas yun du 'tshotoX byad ma ban bon gdug pa'i mthus mi ldigaX bstan 'dzin rigs brgyud chu bo'i rgyun lta bugiX rang gzhan don kun 'grub pa'i las mdzod cigagiX gnod byed dgra sder thog ser char ltar 'bebs4༷༷ gtad khram las kyi sde dpon sum brgya'i tshogs4༷༷ bran bkol mdze phol gzer thabs smyo 'bog dngagiX nad rims du mas bstan dgra phung du chugagiX lha yi lha mchog khyed 'khor lha chen brgyadagiX sde dpon sum cu sde brgyad brtan mar bcas4༷༷ las la bkol nas srid gsum zil gnon cingagiX grags 'bar las bzhi 'grub pa'i nus ldan mdzodagiX mtshan ldan thod pa shel phor ci rigs paraltoX 'bras dkar dza gad bzang po yongs bkang bas4༷༷ rten 'brel thabs kyis legs nyes kun gsal zhingagiX gza' rgod gnod pa zhi ba'i las mdzod cigagiX khyar par rgyal bas gnyer gtad yongs 'du'i rgyun4༷༷ dgung la reg dang bu bzhin skyongs ba rungagiX dam bca' bzhes pas dus las mi g.yel b.raltoX bsrung skyobs yongs su sba ba'i las mdzod cigagiX slob dpon dmod
༄tshi/ /rtsod skur 'debs zhe sdang pa'igiX dam nyams slob bu mna' zan skye bo'i tshogs4༷༷ log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gcod nas4༷༷ bka' gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzodagiX nga ni dbang drag padma'i sras4༷༷ nyid ni lha chen 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷ sngon gyi zhal bzhes thugs dam dgongs4༷༷ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs bskyed la4༷༷ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs/ ma lus zhi ba'i phrin las mdzodagiX tshe dang bsod nams phan bde'i tshogs4༷༷ ci yang rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzodagiX snod bcud 'khor dang longs spyod tshogs4༷༷ khams gsum dbang sdud phrin las mdzodagiX log lta gnod sbyin dgra bgegs rnams4༷༷ tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mdzodagiX snyan pa bsngags dang grags pa'i tshogs4༷༷ phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzodagiX 'gro kun smin grol legs lam ston4༷༷ don gnyis mthar phyin phrin las mdzodagiX hūXltoX g.yas su ri rgyal bkra bzang rtseraltoX rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal4༷༷ bka' nyan lha srin kun 'dus tshegiX khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha khyodagiX lha brag thugs gter bdag por bsngags/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor skyongs4༷༷snyigs dus rgyal 'gong dam sri yigiX gnyan po srog gi gshed mar bskos4༷༷ rgyal ba'i bstan la gus mchod cingagiX dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i las la brtson4༷༷ gus pa'i rten la snying nye zhingagiX mgon skyabs dpung
gnyen mi 'bral bsrungacaX mdor na bdag sogs 'khodzir bcas kyi'oX byang chub bsgrub la gegs med cingacaX bsam dgu chos bzhin 'grub pa dngacaX 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byung ba yicaX mchog thun dngos grub ma lus rnamasacaX 'bad med lhun khru/ba phrin las malnga(dacaX de ltar gong gi mchod sprin las mngon rtogs dang tshig rkang bdun ma rnams gter gzhung dngosadang / dgu ma rnamasadri za'i rgyal po 'di la rab tu dga' ba'i blo can theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor ba stobasaldan dpa' bos/ gzhung gi dgongs pa dang sbyar nasatam bu ra'i dbyangasasu blangs pa'o/ shu bhaX/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ bkra lhasashog // /
(zha)༄༅/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten 'dzugs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa dwangasashelame long zhesabya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /na mo gu ru de wa ḍākki ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun 'dus padma 'byung / / ma rung 'byung po'i gnyen por rab khros pa/ /khrag 'thung padma he ru ka dpal dang / /rig 'dzin khams gsum zil gnon dbyer med mchod/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog rgyal yum mthing 'od 'bar/ /mgon de'i shes rab yum du skur bzhengs pa/ /tshe rabs du ma'i skyabs gcig yid bzhin nor/ /rje btsun 'jigs med bde ldan zhabs la 'dud/ /gdod nas sgrib bral ngo bo nam mkha'i snying / /rang bzhin lhun grub 'bad pa med pa'i mdangs/ /las shar lha mchog dri za'i rgyal po yi/ /phyi nang gsang rten bca' thabs en tsam spro zhes mchod par brjod nas 'dir chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku lha byang gter zangs mdzod kyi bka' srung sku gcig la mtshan drug tu grags pa dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal zhes pa 'di ni
༄༅/ /dpal o rgyan chen po bod du ma byon gong du g.yung drung bon gyis brten pa'i lha chen po/ gu ru bod du byon nas bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad de nub zangs mdzod kyi srung mar gnyer du gtad cing sgrub skor rnams rig 'dzin rgod ldem pas zangs mdzod nas rtsodag ser mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs thol le bar spyan drangs4༷༷ de nas rig 'dzin brgyud pa mu tig phreng ba skyabs mgon mtsho rgyal brgyad pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma kun bzang 'jigs med bde ldan nam 'chi med 'od zer klong grol bar du byon/ dam pa de nyid kyi zhal snga nas skal bzang dga' ston du lon pa'i gnyan chen thang lha'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sngon 'gro phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang mchog gi rten dang bcas pa ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul bshad pa de la yang / rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i ljags sgrig tu/ smyug rgod lan rdzar can la
bris sku btags pa sku rten/ dar dkar la snying po bris pa dang sba lcag gsung rten/ shel phreng dang 'ja' shel thugs rten4༷༷ sgrub gtor mkhar thabs can dang chu sna'i skyems dang bcas pa yon tan gyi rten/ mchod gtor yum gtor las bzhi'i gtor ma bca' ba phrin las kyi rten du gsung pa bcas/ rten 'dzugs de dag gi rim pa'i gab sbas man ngag rnams brgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag bzhes la bsre lhad ma bzhugs par zhib tu bkrol te 'chad par bya ba la/ rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po la/ sku rten ni/ dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud dang / lha mchog 'di nyid kyi dbang lung khrid gsum nos shing gong gnon yi dam gyi lha bsnyen theb pas gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang por yar ngo'i cha tshes bco lnga sogs la/ gangs ri mthon po'i mdun nam/ ri mthon po gangs mthong ba'i sa sogs rab/ de min gang du bya ba'i sar byi dor byas la/ sbos dkar dang ljon shing sna tshogs kyi bsangs kyis bdug la/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan yol ba sogs bkod mdzes su bshams par gtor sgam lta bu sgo bcad chog pa che ba skyogs bsgul gtong mi dgos pa'i nang du/ dri ma med pa'i g.yang shun nam/ ma 'byor na ras dkar bting bar dri bzang gis chag chag gdab/ de'i steng du 'bru dkar bkram pa'i khar 'bo lta bur nas dkar mo gro 'bras rin chen sna lnga
༄༅/ /cung zad bsres pa sogs kyis legs par bkang ste bkod/ smyug rgod rtse rgyal la dar tshon sna lnga/ za 'og sna lnga'i 'phan chung / gos leb brgan gyi rgyal mtshan/ gser dngul mu tig g.yu mu men byu ru spos shel sogs btags/ mdun ngos su gdugs chung phub pa'i 'og tu dar dkar la thang lha yab yum gtso 'khor la/ rigs bdag gu ru zhi drag yod pa'i bris thang / tshad ldan gyi rgyab tu 'og tu bshad pa bzhin gyi srog 'khor bri'am/ ma grub na sku gsung thugs sngags dang rtsa sngags brtan bzhugs can bris pa rab gnas ldan pa smyug rgod de la btags te 'bru 'bo gang ba de la brtan lhang nge yod bar 'dzugs/ spro na gser dngul sogs rin po che 'am/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i 'bur sku rgyud sde spyi'i gzungs dang srog 'khor/ 'ja' shel gyi bla rdo bcas pa gzhug la rab gnas ldan pa smyug rgod kyi mdun du bkod pa grub na bris thang mi dgos ma grub kyang skyon med pa/ rtsa bar bris sku bshad pas tsakra lta bus kyang rung ba yin no/ /de ni sku rten dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba phyi rten gyi rim pa yang 'dzugs thabs bshad par bya ba la/ gter gzhung du mi gsal yang / rig 'dzin yol mo ba chen pos/ rta lug bya g.yag bcas phyi rten du 'bul tshig dang bcas 'dzugs par mdzod/ rig 'dzin padma phrin las kyis kyang / lha g.yag 'bul tshig dang bcas phyi rten du
'jugs par mdzad pa'i dgongs don bzhin/ pho rta ngang dkar sga srab gong smad kyis brgyan pa/ lha lug dkar po/ lha bya dkar po/ lha 'brong dkar po shin tu stobs che ba bcas 'du byas la/ rgya shog dkar po'am / skyems shog lta bu la/ gser dngul bsres pa'i mtshal gyis/ oX āXhūX badzra gu ru padma sirnyi hūXltoX hrīXmahā kro ta padma ta krid ha ya ghri wa hūX hūX phaṭa4༷༷ a ha ri ni sa hūXltoX oX badzra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha laṃ swā hā:༷༷ lha chen po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar phyi rten gzugs su btsugs pa 'di la dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad tha dag zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig sa mā yugiX zhes phreng gcig tu rdzogs par byas la/ dri bzang dang mchod sman byug la lhar bskyed/ rab gnas byas pagiX zhu ba las sngags phreng du bsam la dbu nas mar yig mgo nang bstan du dril la dar skud dkar pos bcing la/ gos dar dkar pos thum btang la dbu zhabs ma log par/ gos sna/ rnga phod/ dril chung / g.yer kha/ dar chen sna lnga'i cod paṇa dang / rnga rdzar bcas te rten gyi grangs dang mnyam pa rta'i phrum phrum dang / 'brong dang lug gi sog pa g.yas/ bya'i mgul la
༄tsho/ /sogs la btags te/ khrus bsangs bya/ sgrub pa'i skabs su sku lha chen po'i bris sku'i phyogs su mgo bstan/ cang shes rta mchog gser sga g.yu srab can/ sogs gyer rten 'dzugs par bya zhing slob dpon gyis rten la brtan bzhugs kyi rab gnas bya zhing / thang lha 'khor bcas mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du gzugs rten rnams la thim par mos la/ gzungs sgril cod paṇa rnams tshur bkrol nas bzung rten rnams ci bde bar btags la lo re'i nang du tshes bco lnga sogs la tshar re 'dzugs/ gal te shi chad byung na mi 'gyangs par de'i tshab sngar bzhin 'dzug go/ /'di ni 'byor ba rab kyi dbang du byas pa yin/'bring du sman 'dam las bzo ba'am/ gos chen ras sogs la gzugs 'gros btsem nas gzungs sgril de rnamasakyi khog par 'jug /tha mar gos dar ras sogs la gzugs bris pa'i rgyab tu gzungs sgril gyi yi ge bri'o/ /de ltar 'bring dang tha ma'i lugs su byas na gzugs 'gros rnams gtor sgam nang du gang 'gab tu bshams mo/ /de ni sku rten dang phyi rten gyi rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsung rten dang thugs rten 'dzugs thabs chab gcig tu 'chad pa la/ lha mchog 'di nyid gnas nges pa'i sa'am gnas bzang po nas byung ba'i sba lcag tshigs lnga'am/ tshigs gsum gang rigs mgo mjug ma log par rtse mor rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa la/
gos sna dar sna lnga'i 'phan 'phrul brgyan pa dang / dar dkar por snying po bri ba tsam las srog 'khor bri thabs ma gsung zhing / gter gzhung rtsa thor yang mi 'gal yod/ skyabs mgon skal bzang padma dbang phyug nas byang gter bka' srung re la/ rten 'dzug dar re la sku dang srog 'khor bri ba gnang 'dug pa dam pa de nyid kyi phyag bzhes gnas la khungs thub tu nges pa rnyed nas thang lha'i srog 'khor zhal bshus byas pa yin cing chos srung gzhan gyi sgrub bskor la yang bla rdo srog 'khor ni 'dab chags rnyis bzung ba ltar srung ma mi 'khor ba'i dbang med pa'i rten thabs khyad par can yin gsungs pa bzhin/ gza' tshes dge bar gos dar dkar po kha gang lhag tsam bzang drug dza gad gar mas sbran te btul ba dras la stegs kyi khar bkram pa'i steng 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ rang nyid rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas sbyong khrus khyug tsam nas thang lha bskyed bstim bzlas pa mchod bstod 'od zhu sogs byas te bris gzhi byin gyi brlabs4༷༷ 'di ni srog 'khor gyi phyir sku bri mi dgos pa gong gi sku tsaka gis 'thus/ rten mdung gyi ba dan dang / thugs gzungs sogs la sku bris kyang 'gal ba med do/ /gang ltar kyang gser dngul dang mtshal bsres pas 'khor lo mu khyud bdun bskor ba'i lte bar/ āX'abru
༄༅/ /dkar du yong ba bri/ de'i phyir yig mgo rgyab nas btsug pas/ oX āXhūX badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūXltoX hrīXmahā kro ta padma ta krid ha yaX ghri wa hūX hūX phaṭa4༷༷ a ha ri ni sa hūXltoX.oX badzra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha laṃ aXdzaXdzaXs mā ya hūX phaṭa4༷༷ oX badzra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li swā hā:༷༷ rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal aXdzaXdzaXhūXltoX byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul ba dri za'i rgyal po4༷༷ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gsang yum gnam mtsho phyug mo ye shes lha'i sprul pa khyung nag dbu dgu pa mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab kyi ru 'dren dang bcas pa rnams rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar gsang ba srog gi 'khor lo 'di dang gnyis su med par brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad tha dag zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig sa mā ya4༷༷ zhes yig mgo 'dzugs 'tshams dang bca' 'jog 'tshams 'grig pa 'khyil mor bris/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la yig mgo phyir bstan gyis mdun gyi rtsibs la/rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal aXdzaXdzaXhūXltoX shintaX ku ru ye swā hā:༷༷ zhi mdzod 'bar ba rtsal brtan par bzhugs la phrin las mdzod cigagiX ces bri/ g.yas kyi rtsibs la/ ratna 'bar ba rtsal a: puṣṭiX ku ru eXwaX rgyas mdzad
'bar ba rtsal: rgyab kyi rtsibs la/ padma 'bar ba rtsal: mā shaX ku ru ho:༷༷ dbang mdzad 'bar ba rtsal: g.yon gyi rtsibs la/ garma 'bar ba: mā ra yaXphaṭaX drag mdzad 'bar ba rtsal: zhes bris rtsibs mchan bzhi la rim bzhin/ shar lhor/ lha chen gzhon nu brtan par bzhugs la: lho nub tu/ 'brong g.yag zhol can brtan par bzhugs la: nub byang du/ dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal brtan: byang shar du/lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po brtan: zhes pa rnams yig mgo phyir bstan du so sor bri/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la yig mgo phyir bstan mdun nas brtsam ste/ oX āXhūX hrīXbadzra 'bar ba rtsal sarba siddhi hūXltoX oX āXhūX hrīX badzra 'bar ba rtsal ā yuXsiddhi hūXltoX oX āXhūX hrīX badzra 'bar ba rtsal ma ṇi ratna saddhi hūXltoX dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor bcas rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas tshe dpal longs spyod kyi dngos grub rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ zhes bri/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ dbyangs yig g.yas bskor dang gsal byed g.yon bskor du bri/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po 'dod gsol dang bcas pa/ de'i phyir mu khyud gnyis la rdo ra me ri bris shing dri nongs dag slad zan phyis byas te/ byang gter gtso bor gyur pa'i gter rdzas dang / chos sman sel med khung thub dang dri bzang gis legs par byug 'di ni tshe sgrub dang nor gyi kha
༄tshi/ /bsgyur byas pa yin cing / gzhan la spyo 'dre 'dul ba/ nad rims bsrung ba/ rig ma dbang sdud/ g.yul rgyal ba/ mthu gtad bzlog pa/ rigs rgyud 'phel ba/ thog ser 'bebs pa/ gtad khram byed par log lta/ 'gran sems can zil gyis gnon pa/ che btsan rgyal blon sogs dbang du sdud pa/ snyan grags khyab pa/ phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa/ rgyal gzer gnam dgra srung ba la sogs pa skabs thob gang dgos kyang las tshogs gsang sgrub kyi shog dril ltar rigs pa'i 'phrul gyis blang zhing 'dod gsol bcas pa'i shog rdzar kyang phyi nang gsang rten thams cad kyi sham bur 'jug rung ngo / /'on kyang thog ser 'bebs pa dang / mthu gtad byed pa rbardzogs mi la gnod pa rang nyid dmyal ba'i rgyu yin pas spangs bar byas na legs so/ /man ngag gi gnad thams cad chig brgyud yin pas kun la mi ston/ gsang ba ma byas na bka' chad 'ong da ni srog 'bor gyi 'phros bla rdo ni/ man shel zur brgyad pa'am/ zur drug pa/ ma 'byor na blug shel ma yin pa'i 'ja' shel gang 'gab cig la aXdakar po zhig bris la dri bzang chos sman dang gter rdzas sogs gong ltar byug la spra rtsis mnan/ shog bur 'dod gsol 'di ltar yig phreng gcig tu rdzogs par bris la/ hoX byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa dri za'i rgyal po lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba
rtsal4༷༷ gsang yum gnam mtsho phyug mo/ rigs bzhi'i yab yum sras bzhi/ sprul blon bka' sdod ru 'dren dang bcas pa rnams/ dpal phyag na rdo rje padma thod phreng / dri med bshes gnyen/ bee ro tsa na/ tshangs pa lha'i me tog/ mu khri btsan po/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gter ston rig 'dzin rgod ldem/ sras rnam rgyal mgon po/ rdo rje mgon po/ byams pa bshes gnyen/ ngag dbang grags pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang /chos rgyal bsod nams/ bsod nams bkra shis/ mkhyen rtse'i dbang phyug byams pa skal bzang / dbang phyug rab brtan/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ chos dbyings rang grol/ rgyal mchog blo bzang rgya mtsho/rig dzin padma 'phrin las/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ rig 'dzin rdo rje thogs med/ rig 'dzin g.yung mgon rdo rje/ grub dbang padma bshes gnyen/ skyabs mgon 'khor lo'i mgon po rig 'dzin khams gsum zil gnon/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma gnas gsum ṭakki'i gtso bo rje btsun kun bzang 'jigs med bde ldan la sogs te rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar gsang ba bla rdo srog gi rten rdzas 'di dang gnyis su med par ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma 'jig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs te bdag bsgrub pa po dang khyod gnyis dam tshig gcig pa yin pas ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las
༄༅/ /kun thogs pa med par bsgrub pa dang / khyad par sa lam gyi bar chad thams cad sel zhing khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po'i rang zhal mngon sum du mjal nas mchog gi dngos grub stsol bar mdzod cig sa mā ya na raka gan/ zhes bris 'khor lo'i byug rdzas kyis byug la bla rdo man shel la dbu nas mar yi ge mgo nang bstan du dril la dar skud dkar pos bcing ngo / /de nas bla rdo srog 'khor ji ltar bsgrub tshul ni/stegs bur ras dkar bting ba'i khar snod 'bru dkar gyis bkang ba'i steng du srog 'khor mdun bstan du bkod pa'i khar bla rdo bzhag la gzungs thag btags/ de'i mdun du thang lha'i mchod gtor sogs bshams / rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi las gzhung bsrang thub na de'i gtor ma yang srog 'khor las steg mtho bar bkod/ de min rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi bdag bskyed la brten pa'i bzlas pa skabs sbyar mthar/ sbyangs khrus khyug tsam nas/ thang lha'i las byang shel gyi rnga bo lta bu gzhung bsrang la bzlas pa skabs sbyar bzlas mthar dam bsre/ spro na/ thod pa tshad ldan nam/ shel phor du dza gad bzang por sel med bstab pa yang sngon nas bshams la/ mdun gyi srog 'khor thang lhar gsal skabs/ bdud rtsi'i nang du yang thang lha gsal btab la/ oX aXhūX hrīXbadzra 'bar ba rtsal kā ya wākka tsitta dzanaXnyu baX hoX zhes pa bdun
nam gsum mam gang 'os sogs bzlas pas/ de'i sku'i 'od zer gyis mi mjed stong gsum gyi tshe dang dngos grub thams cad bdud rtsi'i nang du bstims pas/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par mos la de nas srog 'khor la yang gtor zhing rang gis myang la/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ sa mā ya na raka gan4༷༷ zhes tha tshig bsgrags la legs nyes kyi pra brtag pa yang gter gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /de nas las byang gi 'phrod dang gsol ka tshogs mchod bcas kyang bya4༷༷ 'grub na rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi las gzhung bsrangs nas thun bzhi'i rim pas gzhung bzhin rtags thon du bsgrub pa'am/ ma grub tshe ji ltar rig pa bsgrub la bskang ba gang rgyas dang brtan bzhugs sogs kyang bya/ de nas srog 'khor dkyil du bla rdo man shel de dang / 'phel gdung / rten 'dus/ chos sman/ dbu skra/ sku rus/ na bza' sogs sel med khungs thub nges bcug la srog 'khor spyi bzhin lteb/ dar skud dkar pos bcings/ dar dkar gyis thum btang la dbu zhabs ma log par sba lcag la btags/ de dang mnyam du shel phreng dkar po rgyan ldan zhig kyang sba lcag la btags te smyug rgod sku tsaka ldan pa phyi rten de dang mnyam du btsug go/ /de ni gsung rten dang thugs rten nam gsang rten gyi rim pa'o/ /gsum pa yon tan gyi rten ni/ dam tshig gtsang zhing rigs rgyud bzang po
༄༅/ /nas blangs pa'i 'bru nag rdul med bkrus te skam bseng bgyis pa'i rjen la khyad par gyi rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ zas nor 'phel ba'i phyir rin po che/ 'bru sna/ sha sna/ nad zhi phyir sman sna tshogs dang /khyad par las sbyor sogs dang 'brel na gri khrag bsre dgos pa yang gsungs/ mdangs rdzas me tog gi phye rnams bsres la/ gzhan du skabs 'dir gtor rdzas byin gyis brlab dgos pa gsung rung ma grub kyang 'thus pa dkar gsum mngar gsum bsres pa'i mar khu dang / chang bzang por sel med kyi mchod sman btab pa/ sha sna/ khrag sna/ spos dang dri bzang gi rigs/ spro na gtor ma'i de nyid nas gsungs pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dkar gsum kyang bsres te sbol la ha cang sla ba ma yin pa sugs thud lta bu'i rin po che'i snod du rten gtor ram sgrub gtor du grags pa/ gtor ma gru bzhi shel mkhar rgya phibs tog can la rin po che 'bur gsum gyis spras pa/ rtsa bar padma 'dab brgyad kyis 'khor yug tu bskor ba/ ratna 'bru gsum gyis mdzes pa/ dpangs su rab khru gang / 'bring rkang gang / tha ma mtho gang sogs skabs dang mthun par bzhengs pa'i nang du zangs sbug gam smyug sbug du/ rgya shog bzang por/ mtshal lam/ rgya snag gtsang mas/ oX āXhūX badzra gu ru padma: hrīXmahā kro ta: a ha ri ni sa: oX badzra thang ka ra: lha chen po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal
'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mnyes mchod rten gtor 'di dang gnyis su med par brtan par bzhugs nas bdag gi phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang legs nyes kyi mtshan ma dang rtags rnams gsal bar bstan du gsol/ zhes yig phreng gcig tu rdzogs par bris la dri bzang dang mchod sman byugs par rab gnas byas pa dbu nas yi ge 〈mgo 〉nang bstan du dril la smyug sbub du bcug la/sman phye rin po che sbos sna tshogs kyis bkang la gtor ma'i dbus su 'jug gtor ma rtsi dkar po dang / rgyan spros kyis mdzes par bgyis par gtor gdugs dkar po bcas smyug rgod kyi mdun du tshes bco lnga lta bur bshams / de'i g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du rin po che'i snod gas chags med pa'i gtsang ma'i nang du g.ya' chu gangs chu skyes chu gsum gyis bkang bar bkod/ de yang rten gtor 'dzug skabs byin brlabs dang gtor 'dzug gi rim pa gzhan dag tu rgyas par gsungs pa lta bu bgyis chog mod/ skabs 'dir yi ge kyang 'jigs shing ma byung yang 'thus pas byang gter rang lugs su mchod pa byin brlabs skabs mchod rdzas su shes pa dang / lha bskyed skabs lhar gsal ba la sogs gsungs pa bzhin sgrub pa'i skabs nas 'byung zhing / gtor ma'i pra brtag pa yang gter gzhung ltar bya'o/ /des yon tan gyi rten nam nang rten gyi rim par yang
༄tsho/ /ngos bzung chog go/ /bzhi ba phrin las kyi rten ni/ gtor ma dang mchod pa'i rim pa ste/ gtor mar yang / bskang gtor dang mchod gtor dgyes skong gi gtor ma sogs ni ming gi rnam grangs las don gcig pa yin cing / bzo dbyibs kyang gcig pas/ rin po che'i snod du mchod gtor zur gsum gsham dkris can sor bcu gnyis pa mdun du lug mgos mtshan pa rgyan spros kyis mdzes pa'i nang du spro na mchod gtor la yang gtor gzugs 'bul dgos pas smyug sbub lta bu'i nang du/ rgya blakhog la/ oX badzra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li a mṛ ta khā hi khā hi swā hā:༷༷ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa: sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags gsham du/ kyai mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid dri za'i rgyal po rdo nde 'bar ba rtsal 'bor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo/ /dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas phrin las rnam bzhi sogs / ji ltar bcol ba'i 'dod don thams cad thog pa med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bri/ byug rdzas byug la gtor mar gzhug /de'i g.yon du g.yu sgron ma'i gtor ma zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba dang /gzhan yang rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang pos mdzad pa'i phrin las shel gyi rnga po'i rtsa bar/ rgyal ba lnga pa chen pos ljags sgrigs mdzad pa'i lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi phrin las rgyas par brgya phrag nyi dngos 'dzin pa'i
snang gsal las gsungs pa bzhin gyi/ mchod pa/ gtor ma/ bskang rdzas sogs legs par bshams pa ni phrin las kyi rten no/ /lnga pa don ni/ de yang rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pas rten rdzas de rnams ma brten kyang rung bar sku gsal bar bsgom pa sku rten/ sngags bzla ba gsung rten/ dbyings rig dbyer med mnyam par 'jog pa thugs rten/ de lta bu'i tshul shes pa yon tan gyi rten/ 'phrin las bzhi'i sgyur kha shes pa phrin las kyi rten no/ /rdo rje lus kyi khams dkar po thang lha/ dmar cha yum/ rlung 'bor tshogs dang bcas pa'i rten te/ de'i don rtogs na rang gi rig pa'i ye shes/ ma rtogs pas dri za'i rgyal po 'bor bcas yin kyang / phyi nang gsang rten sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rten rdzas rgyas par 'grub na rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par gdod mi za bas de ltar tshul de la 'bad dgos/ don dam par rtag brtan ther zug rdos bcas su a 'thas kyi 'jur bus mi 'ching bar/ mchog gi rten gtso che bas/ rig 'dzin yol mo pa'i gsungs de kho na nyid kyi bskang ba las/ don dam dri bral ngo bo nam mkha'i snying / /rang bzhin lhun grub 'gags pa med pa'i mdangs/ /kun khyab lha chen ngang du nges rnyed pa'i/ /don dam mchog gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /bde gsal mi rtog dbyings rig dbyer
༄tshi/ /med pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho bgrod gcig lam/ /lha chen thugs kyi dgongs pa zab zhi'i ngang / /ji bzhin mnyam par bzhag pas thugs dam bskang / /zhes gsungs par/ tshul de lta bus nyams su blang ba gal che'o/ /de ni yang gsang mchog gi rten gyi rim pa'o/ /de ltar rten rdzas rnams legs par 'dzoms nas thang lha'i las byang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rigs la brten nas rtags thon du bsgrubs la snying rus sdug sran la 'bad dgos so/ /de ni rgyas pa'i lugs dang / rten rdzas khyer bde nyams su len na bla rdo srog 'bor sgrub gtor du bcug la/ de la smyug rgod sku tsaka dang bcas pa btsugs nas rten du bzung na legs pas/ gter gzhung gi bskang ba las/ man shel 'od 'phro gsang ba'i rten4༷༷ ting 'dzin gsal bas thugs dam bskangagiX dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten4༷༷ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pas thugs dam bskangagiX sku 'bag rgyan ldan phyi yi rten4༷༷ 'dod yon longs spyod thugs dam bskangagiX zhes gsung pas/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten dang / rig 'dzin yol mo bas kyang / nang rten gtor ma/ gsang bar gsang yum 'bul ba / gsang rten man shel 'dzug pa sogs gsungs so/ /thugs rten 'dzugs par spro na byang gter mgon po bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi nang rten 'dzugs thabs chog sgrigs bgyis pa la kha bsgyur bar 'thus shing
rten mdos 9〈9ga thabs bsnyen sgrub bskang mdos kyi lag len dran pa'i gsal 'debs zhes pa rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos mdzad pa las shes daskyurdzos rbesna/ /e ma/ bka' gter rgya mtsho'i nang tshan las/ /byang gter zangs mdzod bka' srung mchog /lha mchog dri za'i rgyal po de/ /rang rig rtsal las 'dzum zhal ston/ /sngon med gsar sdeb yin mod rung / /rang bzo'i dri mas sbags pa med/ /'khrul med gu ru'i thugs bcud rnams man ngag 'brel bas ba〈snal nas bkod/ /tshig gi brjod pa mi legs kyang / /lhag bsam dag pas gzhan gyi ngor / /bskardzod dges bdag gzhan kun tshe gcig /galngasad ma'i zhing sar nges rnyed phregag /de ltar gnyan chen thang lha'i rten 'dzugs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa yid 'ong dwangs shel me long zhesabya ba 'di yang sngon nas/ sde dge rgyal po'i bka' mngags zhe chen sprul sku mthu stobasanasa'adi lta bu zhig dgosazhesaphebasarung / rang blo zhan cing 'khosadapag rnam g.yeng gisakyang 'bul ma khom phyisaskyabasamagon rgyal tshab mkhan rin chen kun bzang nam mkha' klong yangs kyi bka' rim phebs/ stag lung gsang chosapa'i dpon slob chosa'akhor lags nas 'di ltar dgosazhesayang yang phebasapa bcasakyi bka' ma ldog pa o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyisapa dngosaskyabasamagon rig 'dzin khamsgsum zil gnon dang rje btsun ḍākki'i gtso mo gnyisakyi zhabs rdul byi ba'i cha tsam spyi bor len pa sprang chosamed sngagasaban o rgyan 'jigs med klong yangs kyisathub bstan rdo rje brag gi yang dben galhams chung phun tshogs yang rtse ru ḍākki'i gtso mchog nyid kyi spyan sngar thur brisasu bgyisapar nor
do༅/ /'brul mchisarigs bshagasalhang dge bas sems can thamasacad khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga lam// ///
(za)༄tsho/ /gnyan chen thang lha'i bstod bskul mu tig phreng ba bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so/ /
༄/ /bstod pa ni/ hūX chos kyi dbyings nas nam yang g.yo med kyang / /brlang por spyod pa'i yid srub sde dpung rnams/ /'dul phyir nam mkha'i snying po lha chen skur/ /ston mdzad rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod / lha brgyad gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i ljongs/ /rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus/ /padma nyi zla'i steng na gar dgu yi/ /rnam rol dri za'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /shel dkar ldan ma'i lhun po zla zer gyis/ /'khyud 'dra'i gzugs skus lha yi khengs pa 'phrog /rnam dpyod dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs rtser/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal pos mtshan la bstod/ /'ja' ltar rnam par bkra ba'i spyan dkyus ring / /smin legs g.yu yi 'khri shing mngon par 'khyug /cung zad khro nyams zhi chags mchu sgros 'dab/ /'dzum dbus tshems dkar ze'u 'bru rgod la bstod/ /phyag g.yas rdo
༄༅/ /rjes mtshan pa'i sba dkar lcag /lha lam dngos 'phyar ma bdun las la 'gyed/ /g.yon pa legs nyes rtsis su 'dren pa yis/ /man shel brgya rtsa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin la bstod/ /dmar mthing rtse gos rin chen gser sked bcing / /gos dkar ber chen lding stabs tshul du gsol/ /srog zhu snyan mgul gdu bu se mo do/ /do shal ser ga'i rgyan gyis spud la bstod/ /nor bu'i sga srab gong smad za 'og gi/ spu len ze long khebs mdzes ngang dkar chibs/ /gom 'gros lhod por rgyu steng phyed skyil zhabs/ /rin chen las grub mchil lhum gsol la bstod/ /bde chen gsang yum g.yu sgron nam mkha'i mdog /rgyal mtshan me long 'dzin cing lhab lhub gos/ /mdzes ba'i rgyan khrol g.yu 'brug steng bzhugs pa'i/ /yid 'phros sman btsun gnam lo'i rgyal mor bstod/ /gnam lcags spu gri'i rwa
dang mchu sder gyis/ /stong zil mdog bzhin gnag 'tsher dbu dgu pa/ /krim krim sgra yis sa bdag klu btsan klad/ /'gem byed gtsug lding khyung chen dbang por bstod/ /cho rigs mtshungs pa'i mched po lha yi bu ston zla'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i bzhin ras can/ /las sgrub pho nyar 'khor gyi sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /ston mdzad sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs la bstod/ /g.yu smin thor tshugs lha gnyen khye'u dang / /mi dkar g.yas g.yon mdun gyi dpung sna 'dren/ /'jigs rung lcags kyi mi sngon rgyab kyi rtswa /drangs nas g.yul las rnam par rgyal la bstod/ /rtsi sman ljon shing dri ngad 'thul ba dang / /lhan cig ka la ka yi bdud rtsi'i chus/bkrus tshe bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i las gyur pas/ /nad kyi zug rngu drung nas 'byin la bstod/ /rab 'bar nor bu rin chen sgrom bu las/ /lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi longs spyod kyi/ /'dzad med mchod sbyin char gyi bkres skom sogs/ dbul ba'i duXkha pha mthar mdzad la bstod/ /padma ra ga'i bum bzang 'khor 'das kyi/ /srog gi zung gyur bcud kun 'khyil ba'i rgyun/ /sbyin pa'i mod la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin sa la sbyor der bstod/ /mdun rnon mtshon gyis dgra snying tshal pa rtswa /btang bas ma tshig thogs med 'bar ba'i mda'/ /gnam lcags gzhu mor bkang tshe srid pa gsum/ /'dar byed drag shul brtul zhugs
༄tshi/ /'chang la bstod/ /skabs gsum bdag po'i lang tsho 'phrog nus pa'i/ /bzhin bzang skyes bu gzhon nu'i rnam 'gyur gyi/ /che mnyam tshangs pa lha yi me tog gi/ srung ma'i gtso bor zhal gyis 'ches la bstod sngo bsangs rwa rtse srid pa'i rtse mor lding / /rmig pas smyo 'dre la sogs 'byung po brdzi/ /kha rlangs na bun bzhin 'thul 'brug sgra ltar/ /ngur ba'i 'brong g.yag zhol chen dkar por bstod/ /btab pa tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog nus pa'i/ /rab dmar lcags kyu zhags pa'i 'phrul chen po/ /khab len rdo dang lcags bzhin brtan g.yos dngos/ /'bad med dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ /sindha wa ra'i mdangs kyi 'jig rten gsum/ zil gnon bran 'khor ral gri gser 'khor gyis/ /nag po'i rtsa lag 'thag pa'i mthu rtsal ldan/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la bstod/ /mi rabs phyugs dang longs spyod 'phung ba'i sri/ /'dre ngan 'byung po bya dkar gzugs sprul pa/ /gnam lcags mchu dang sder mos thal phyung du/ /'bugs mdzad sprul pa'i bya khra dkar por bstod/ /smyo 'bog snying rlung rgyal gzer dmu chu dang /'khrug slong gtong ba'i lha srin gdon gyi snying / /rnon po'i mche ba btab nas khrag 'jib pa/ /'jigs rung lcags kyi sdig pa nag por bstod/ /spu gri'i mche gtsigs sder mos sa gzhi bgrad/ /mjug ma brdabs
pa'i me rlung 'tshubs ma spyod/ /glog ltar 'khyugs pa'i stong gsum skad cig la/ myur mdzad sprul pa'i dung spyang wo mor bstod/ /mdog dbyibs cha lugs phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa/ /zhi rgyas chags pa'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur dang / /mi sdug gtum po tpū nang bar gsum du/ /'khor ba'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho chen por bstod/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ padma thod phreng rgyal ba'i nasadon gnyisamathar phyin mdzod bar 'jug phrin las bcol ba le'u tshan gnyisapo 'di gong gi cho ga'i gzhung du yod pas/ 'dir len dgosa'adi na cang ma dag pasaso/ yol mo gsum bas mdzad/ padma thod phreng rgyal ba'i spyan snga ṭa/ dam can zhal bzhes thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ rnal 'byor bdag gis ji ltar bcol pa'i las / ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /smyo ba'i 'dre rgod rgyal po kun 'dul zhing / rnam thos bu yi bdag pos yang dag 'gyor/ sngags skyes mu dra dbang du bsdu ba dang / phas rgol g.yul las rgyal ba'i las mdzod cig /'chi med bdud rtsi btung bas yun du 'tsho/ byad ma ban bon gdug pa'i mthus mi brdzis/ bstan 'dzin rigs brgyud chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ rang gzhan don kun 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig gnod byed dgra steng thog ser char ltar 'bebs/ gtad khram las kyi sde dpon sum cu'i tshogs/ bran bkol mdze phol gzer thab smyo 'bog dang / nad rims du mas bstan dgra phung du chug /lha yi lha
༄༅/ /mchog khyod 'khor lha chen brgyad/ sde dpon sum cu sde brgyad brtan mar bcas/ las la bkol nas srid gsum zil gnon cing / grag 'bar las bzhi 'grub pa'i nus ldan mdzod/ mtshan ldan thod pa shel phor ci rigs pa/ 'bras dkar dza gad bzang pos yongs bkang ba'i/ rten 'brel thabs kyi legs nyes kun gsal zhing / gza' rgod gnod pa zhi ba'i las mdzod cig khyad par rgyal bas gnyer gtad yongs 'dus rgyud/ dgung la reg dang bu bzhin skyong ba sa dam bca' zhal bzhes dus las mi g.yel bar/ srung skyob yongs su sbas pa'i las mdzod cig /slob dpon smod rtsod skur 'debs zhe sdang ba'i/ dam nyams slob bu mna' zan skye bo'i tshogs/ log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus tshar bcad nas/ bka' gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig gter gzhung nga ni dbang drag padma'i sras4༷༷ nyid ni lha chen 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes dgongs4༷༷ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs bskyed la4༷༷ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs4༷༷ ma lus zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams phan bde tshogs/ cir yang rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ snod bcud 'khor dang longs spyod tshogs4༷༷ khams gsum dbang sdud 'phrin las mdzod/ log lta gnod sbyin dgra bgegs rnams4༷༷ tshar gcod drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod/ snyan par
bsngags dang grags pa'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ 'gro kun smin grol legs lam ston4༷༷ don gnyis mthar phyin 'phrin las mdzodagiX bskul ba hnā gter gzhung / hūX hūX hūXltoX bzhugs yul 'dam shod snar mo nas/ ya zhur gnyen po sku bzhengs shog /bla mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang shed nas/ gnyan chen thang lha sku bzhengs shig /brag dkar gnyen po'i rtse mo nas/ dri za'i rgyal po sku: gangs dkar mthon po'i rtse mo nas/ yul lha chen po: sprin dang na bun gseb shod nas/ zur phud lnga pa: sdang ba'i dgra 'dul sku: gnod pa'i bgegs 'dul sku: smyo bas 'dre 'dul sku: sprul pa'i tshul du sku: sprul pa 'jig pa'i lus po de/ /lha g.yag dkar po zhig /dung ru gnam du byug /dung ru dkar po zhig /gnam gyi bdud la bsgyur/ /nang gi god kha bsgyur/ /rmig bzhi sa la 'khrab/ /dung rmig dkar po yis/ /lha srin nyal thag chod rnga ma dar dkar dbyug /rnga dkar sprug pa yis/ /lha btsan bran du 'khol/ /ngar skad theng gsum ngar/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /rdul bsigs lan gsum sprug /srid gsum dbang du sdud/mtho bo gung gsum nas/ /dung khra mol tshe bzhin/ /dung khra dkar po zhig /la nye khri li li/ /rong dang 'brong sgo nas/ /dung spyang dkar po zhig /dgra bo'i bla la rgyug /drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo
༄tshi/ /gsod / / gnod pa'i bgegs rnams thul/ /oX badzra ta na shī lam̐ mi lam̐ du bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa4༷༷ chosargyal ratna gling pa'i brag dmar chosasde lasabyung ba/ hūX yang cig nag po ti pa ra tsa khyod/ byang phyogs brgyud du che ba'i skur ston pa/ gnyan chen thang lha zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag rig 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrub/ skyi thekhod klong du che ba'i skur ston pa/ gnyan chen mkhar nag zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag rig 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ mi mthun rkyen sel mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrub/ pho mo rdzongs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ klu bdud mgo dgu zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma: bdag cag rig 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa: mi mthun rkyen: lho stod dbu rus phyogs su che ba'i skur: sku la mkha' ri zhes su mtshan: dam rdzas rgyan: bdag cag: mi mthun: sgo chu lho rgyab phyogs su che ba'i skur: bdud po zla ba'i gdong can zhes su mtshan: dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun:mon kha ring mo'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston: bdud po bkrag med zhes su mtshan: dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun: seng ge rdzong gsum phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ zu ra zur skyes zhes su mtshan: dam rdzas:
bdag cag: mi mthun: lho brag mkhar chu'i phyogs su che ba'i skur: dge gnyen bsgo kha zhes su mtshan: dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun: nag po ti pa ra tsa nā ga rakta kro ta pa tsa la dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la rbad rbad/ cesalan bdun brjod/ thun gtor la chab bran la/ gter gzhung / hūX g.yas ru ri rgyal bkra bzang rtser/ /rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /bka' nyan lha srin kun 'dus tshe/ /khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha khyod/ /lha brag thugs gter bdag po bsngags/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor skyong / /snyigs dus rgyal 'gong dam srid yi/ /gnyen po srog gi gshed mar bskos/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la gus mchod cing / /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i las la brtson/ /gus pa'i bstan la snying nye zhing / /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mi bral bsrung / /mdor na bdag sogs 'khor bcas kyi/ /byang chub sgrub la gegs med cing / /bsam dgu chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byung ba yi/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun grub 'phrin las mdzod/ mnga' gsol ni yol mo gsum pasamadzad/ lha dbang klu bdag lang ga'i bdag po sogs srid gsum dbang phyug kun gyi mdun brdar nas/ /mchod sprin rgyal mtsho'i srid zhur bcas mchod pa'i/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang brtsegs las rgyal ba'i/ /rin
༄tshi/ /chen shel gyi sku mkhar zla ba'i dbyibs/ /ba gam nor bu'i 'od tshogs rab rgyas pa'i/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i go skabs yang dag phrogs/ /rtsa ba yid bzhin 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyis/ /bar med rab rdzogs sked skabs mtshon lngas mdzes/ /'dzam bu na da'i rgya phibs ches 'bar ba'i/ /rtse mor rin chen char 'bebs chu 'dzin dkrigs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul dag las bzhin/ /rgya cher bkod pa'i khyad par rgya che ba'i/ /pho brang srid rtse'i gong nas mngon mtho'i rtser/ /yid bzhin rgyal mtshan gsar pas mnga' gsol lo/ /dpag yas zhing gi rdul snyed rab 'byams zhing / /skad cig myul ba'i 'gros ldan lha rta dkar / / rgyu skar bdag po'i dregs 'joms rgyan ldan pa/ /lha chen chibs kyi dam par mnga' gsol lo/ /ka tsa linta'i ber chen sum brtsegs pa'i/ /mdzes 'dzum rlabs kyi gzugs brnyan bgo 'os pa/ /'jam gnyen reg bya'i khyad par rmad byung ba'i/ /rab mdzes lha yi na bza' mnga': nor bu'i mchil lhum gser gyi ske rags 'bar/ /ga bur do shal rin chen se mo do/ /mu tig 'bras chags nor bu'i snyan cha gsol / mdzes byed rgyan gyi dam pas mnga'acha gser pad g.yu yi yal 'dab mdzes pa'i khongs/ /rnam mang 'od kyi ge sar rab rgyas pa/ /spel legs 'phreng ba bstar ba'i cod paṇa 'di/ /skra mtshams mdzes
pa'i rgyan du mnga': rgya byin thog pa'i nor bu las lhag pas/ /bkra shos dam pa kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /rgyal bas rab bsngags g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /thor tshugs mdzes pa'i rgyan du mnga': : mo zur phud lnga bcings ral pa'i rgyan/ /bung ba ltar zil mig sman ltar snum pa'i/ /rtsa ching bkra shis ri mos rnam bkra bas/ /dar dkar dri med ldan pas mnga': myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan pā la har/ /skul byed phyag gi khyad par mi 'tshal yang / /ma bdun las la bskul ba'i phul chen no/ /sba lcags rdo rjes mtshan par mnga': sha chen rab rdzogs zla ba'i spun zla zhes/ /bdud rtsi bran pa'i zegs ma dngos grub ltar/ /zad mi shes 'bab nor bu'i shel phreng 'di/ /thugs dam dbyings su bzlo phyir mnga'acha dar dkar spyan gzigs mang pos sa bla khongs/ /rgyan byin gzhu yi dra bas mdzes byas shing / /snyan brjid dpa' ba'i nyams ldan 'bod pa'i dbyangs/ /sna tshogs rol mor bcas pas: gtsang ma'i zhal zas la sogs 'dod yon lnga/ /lha klu mi dang gnod sbyin thams cad kyi/ /dkor nor ma tshang med dpung nor 'dzin pa'i/ /'phags pa rab rdzogs 'dod dgus mnga' gsol lo/ /dkon mchog skyabs kyi dam bar skyabs song mgron/ /dkar phyogs lha dang ldeng can 'byung po'i tshogs/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu rtsal rmad byung ba/ /kun gyi rje bor deng
༄༅/ /bdag gzengs bstod do/ /khyad par dpal gyi sprul pa padma 'byung / /ji bzhin mnos pa'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /gter bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag thams cad kyi/ tshogs bdag tshogs kyi rje bor gzengs bstod do/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs 'ches pa'i lha/ /bstan gsol mchod bsgrub lha bsrung gnyan rnams dang / /khri srong lha bsrung sku lha gnyan rnams kyi/ /rje btsan lha yi lha mchog gzengs bstod do/ /rgyal dbang padma'i ring lugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ /dbu 'phang ri rgyal rtse mor gzengs bstod do/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi mnga' gsol gzengs bstod na/ lha yi lha mchog lha zhal mthong bar mdzod/cesabar bya/ yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs bya/ lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang sogs brjod/ ser sna'i dbang gyur ma 'byor zhing / mchod pa ngan shing bshams nyes pa/ sbyor ba gtsang sbra ma thon pa/ de yang bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ rten yod na 'di ni gzugs dang / zhesapa nas/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med na/ khyod kyi sems can sogs nas badzra muX ye shes pa gshegs garbershal zhu// //
('a)༄7/ /lha mchog 'bar ba rtsal gyi phrin lasabargya phrag nyi ngosa'adzin pa'i snangagasal bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /na masti kya lo buddha padma ka ra ya/ zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'bor ma lusapa'i/ khyab bdag o ṭaṃ ya na'i rig sngags 'chang / 'dzam gling che ba'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang / rgyal mchog padma thod phreng bdag byin rlobs/ mgon khyod bka' rtagasaphyag rgyasasmyur phud rtser/rjesagasal lce la a mṛ ta blud pas/ dam ldan lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ bkra lhasasnying rje mthu stobs〈 'phrul rtsal/ gang de mchod gsol bskang dang bsnyen cing sgrub/ las sbyor brtsom la nyer mkho'i gyer bsgom bzhugs/ lha chen dgyesazhal 'dab stong 'dzum byed pa'i/brgya phrag nyi ma'i dngosa'adzin snang gsal spel/ de la 'dir dri za'i rgyal po gnyan chen thang lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las kyi rim pa nyamasasu bstar ba byed pa la sgrub rten mchod gtor spyan gzigs sogs mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad thamasacad mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar legs par bshams/ sngon du zhi khro gang yang rung ba'i 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs ba legs par thugs sgrub sogs kyi lasabyang don bstod yan rdzogs par btags/ 'di pa'i sgosachog thog mar 'gyur sngags brjod nas gnas yo byin gyisabarlabs pa ni/ 6༷kho sam bha
༄tsho/ /ra sam bha ra bi rang byung rang shar gyi sngona'agro lasabyung ba/ ma na sa ra mahā dza wa hūX phaṭa'oX e yaX raX suX keṃ ram bhūX hūXcaX bhūX bi shwa bi shuddhi bhanta dzña na e tsakra maṇḍal bhūXcaX bhūX las sa phyogs thams cad ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas 52 shwa dha na badzre swā hā'oX bar/ skyabasa'agro sems bskyed ni/ thugs sgrub kyi skyabasasems/ rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i sku:: rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal ba〈snam/ zhesalan gsum brjod/sems can thams cad bde ba dang :: zhesasogs 3 med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hrīXlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas bla ma 'od dpag med rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis ba〉rdzor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa ma ya dza dzacaX
spyan drangs/ rang byung rang shar gyi sngon 'gro lasabyung ba/ hūXltoX bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol4༷༷:: byed par thegagagiX cesabarjod/ gong gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal gdab pa ni/ bdag nyid tha mal snying ga na/ yi ge hrīXdamar gnas pa la/ /bdag nyid hrīXyi lus su gyur/ /hrīXde 'od du zhu ba las/ /bdag nyid dbang chen rgyal po ni/ /dbu ni tshangs ba'i yul rtser slebs/ /zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du bsgyur/ /g.yas kyi phyag gis gzugs khams 'degs/ /g.yon gyi phyag gis 'dod khams gnon/ /nyi zla gza' skar sked la 'bor/ /sku mdog bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /sku stegs ri rab steng na 'cha'/ /dbu gtsug rta mgos rta skad 'tsher/g.yas kyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /srid pa pho rgyud dbang du sdud/ /g.yon gyi rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /srid pa mo rgyud dbang du sdud/ /steng du rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /srid pa'i gza' rnams dbang du sdud 'og tu rta skad thengs gsum gyis/ /srid pa'i klu rnams dbang du sdud/ /hrīXhūX phaṭa gsum bsgrags pa yis/ /'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba tsam/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud byed cing / srid gsum zil gyis gnon par bsgom/ zhesabaskyed rim gsal gdab bo/ hrīXmahā kro ta padma ta krita hya ghri wa hūX hūX phaṭa/ ya ma ra tsa du tri phu ti hrīXhūX phaṭa4༷༷ cesaskabasasbyar bzlas/ bstod pa ni/ hrīXhūX phaṭa4༷༷ gter gzhung hrī4༷༷dbang chen las la
༄tsho/ /rngams mdzad khro bo che/ /sku mdog dmar nag thams cad dbang du sdud/ /dbu ni nam mkha'i dbyings su rta skad 'tsher/ /zhabs ni rgya mtsho'i gting du klu rnams gnon/ /g.yas kyi phyag gis snang srid gzugs khams 'degs/ /g.yon gyi phyag gis 'dod khams sa gzhi mnon/ /nyi zla gza' skar sked bcings gza' rnams 'dul/ /dur khrod chas brgyad lha srin sde brgyad 'jigs/ /rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /hrīXyi sgra chen srid gsum 'gul zhing dngangs/ /phaṭa kyis thog 'bebs bdud dpung spyi nas 'joms/ /hūX gis nga ros gdug pa bran du bkol/ /phyag mtshan mtshon chas ri rab rdul du 'jig bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jig rten ma lus bsreg /'jig rten dregs pas khengs pa'i sde brgyad ni/ /drag po gza' dang gdug pa klu la sogs/ /'chi bdag gshin rje nad gtong ma mo dang / /che btsan rgyal po rol pa btsan gyi tshogs/ /nag po bdud dang the'u rang bgegs kyi tshogs/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad stobs po che/ /rang dbang med par dbang sdud zil gyis gnon/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs dang gzi brjid 'phrog /rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi sman gtor byin gyisabarlabs pa ni/ oṃ la chosasman btab pa la brlab mi dgosalhang / de min bka' brgyad ltar byin gyisabarlabs/ hrī gsar brisamahā kro ta padma takrita hya
ghri wa hūX hūX phaṭa4༷༷ kyisabasangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhūX las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang oX 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du oX āXhūX gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi ro bcud thams cad 'dus te gtor ma la thim/ yi ge gsum yang 'od du zhu ba las dbyer med gcig tu 'dres bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ khiXkhi āXhūX mahā bha liṃ ta twe dzwa bha lin ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ye swā hā:༷༷ zhesalan gsum mam bdun brjod/ rten gsar brisabaskyed pa ñtsā/ hrīXmahā spre1 tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du/ bhūX las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang shar shel/ lho beeḍūrya nub padma ra ga /byang gser las grub pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ logs dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing mda' yab pu shus bskor ba'i steng du rgya phibs rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ de'i phyi rol du 'ber sa rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbus su man shel gyi khang bzang dzambha'i gser gyi rgya phibs 'od du 'tsher ba'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog gis mtshan pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi sgo lcog 'bar ba/ rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba/ rked par 'ja' 'od na bun gyi gur phubs pa/ rtse mor sprin dkar rin po che'i zil char 'bebs pa/ sa gzhi ljang sngon las
༄༅/ /me tog sna tshogs rgyas pa/ khor yug tu gnam lha brgyad kyi gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bus bskor ba/ de'i dbus su nyi zla padma'i gdan la stobs ldan rta mchog ngang dkar rin po che'i sga srab gong smed spu len ze long gi khebs sogs rgyan du mas mdzes par spras pa'i steng na oX badzra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li swā hā:༷༷ las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam par sprul pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i gtso bo mtshan drug rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal lam/ dam can shel geng dkar po/ lha gnam the dkar po/ gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po dung gi thor tshugs can/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i rgyal po zhes bya ba srung ma chen mo/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog shel gyi ri bo la ston mtshan zla bas byugs pa ltar dkar la brjid pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum rab tu bkra ba/ dbu skra gnag snum gyi thor tshugs dar dkar pos bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu 'bar bas spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa'i sba lcag nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon shel dkar gyi phreng ba thugs ga'i thad du 'dren pa/ zab chen dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rtse ber dang yug gyen gsol ba/
ber nang ma gnyis la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spud pa'i gser sked bcings shing / rin po che'i gsar pad la g.yu'i phra tshom gyis mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gser ga se mo do/ do shal gdu bu sogs rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong utpala'i chun po dang dar dpyang can/ sku gzhon zhing mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis nor bu'i mchil lham gyon nas rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/g.yon bde ba skyong ba'i dbang mo yid 'ong mdangs ldan gyi yum gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma sku mdog sngo bsangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas rgyal mtshan dang g.yon me long 'dzin cing / dbu skra thor tshugs lhag ma'i zar bu thur du 'phyar 〈'phyang 〉ba/ sman btsun mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad kyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i rnam pa can g.yu 'brug bcibs pa/ gtso bo'i steng gi nam mkhar ma rungs log 'dren klu gnyen sa bdag 'dul ba'i gnyen po ngo bo ye shes lha'i sprul pa rnam pa khyung nag dbu dgu pa zhal gdangs shing kri kri gi sgra sgrog pa phyag gnyis kyis sa bdag klu gnyan sbrul gyi rnam pa can bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ gnam lcags me'i mchu sder dang spu gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa can dmigs pa'i sa gnyan bkab cing nam mkhar lding ba/ gtso bo'i mtha' skor du mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu/ g.yas kyi ru
༄༅/ /'dren skyes bu g.yu'i smin ma can/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren khye'u chung g.yu'i zur phud can/ mdun gyi ru 'dren mi dkar g.yu'i thor lcog can/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa ste so so brgya phrag dang bcas pas bskor ba/ shar du bee ḍūrya dkar po las grub pa'i lha'i gzhal med khang rgya phibs can rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba'i nang du nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gyi me tog lo 'bras myu gu grangs med pas yongs su gtams pa'i dbus su pad zla'i steng na zhi mdzad rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dkar po g.yas sman gyi ljon shing thugs ka dang / g.yon bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum pa brla steng na 'dzin cing / zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa sman lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lhor 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs la rin po che'i sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i khang bzang rgya phibs can/ rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas 'bor yug tu bskor ba'i nang du rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rin po che'i ri yongs 'dul sa rdol 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog sogs lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dbus na pad zla dang ni'u 〈ne'u 〉le dmar ser gyi gdan la rgyas byed kyi rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas nor bu 'bar ba'i thugs ka dang / g.yon rin po che'i sgrom bu
pus steng na 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub tu padma ra ga'i khang bzang rgya phibs can khor yug dang bcas pa'i ra bar 'chi med bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum bzang / mtsho rdzing / lteng ka/ lu ma/ chu mig dang bcud len snying por gyur pa'i rdzas sman gyis yongs su khyab pa'i dbus na pad zla'i gdan la dbang gi lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na padma ra ga'i tshe bum 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan rdo rje'i dbyibs can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa tshe'i lha dang rig 'dzin drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor / byang du drag po gnas lcags 'bar ba'i mkhar steng du rgya phibs dang khor yug ra bas bskor ba'i nang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi dra bas sbrel ba'i dbus su padma nyi ma dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la garma las kyi khro po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog nag la khros pa mig rtsa dmar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzis shing rin po che'i rgyan rnams dang dug sbrul gyis brgyan pa rtse ber dmar nag brtsigs pa'i nang ma gser sked can g.yas mdung dmar dang g.yon lcags kyi mda' gzhu 'dzin pa rin po che'i hor lham gyon nas rta mchog bra nag rlung shugs can la bcibs shing me rlung 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs par mnga'
༄tshi/ /bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon rnams kyis bskor ba/ shar lhor rtse mor gangs dang / rgod par ne'u gsing/ me tog nags tshal gyis brgyan pa'i dbus su shel dkar gyi khang bzang yid du 'ong bar pad zla'i gdan la lha chen gzhon nu skyes bu bzhin bzang kha dog dkar la dbu skra g.yu'i zur phud can/ dung so kho mor yod pa g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon khu tshur dkur brten pa/ dar dkar gyi lu'u 〈lu ba 〉gsol zhing /zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par rang 'dra'i lha phrug du mas bskor ba/ lho nub tu mtshon cha sna tshogs rtse mo phyir bstan cing me rlung 'tshubs mar 'khyil ba las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis gnod byed dmigs bya rnams ra ba'i nang du bkug pa'i steng na skye 'gro'i srog gshed smyo 'dre srin po 'dul ba'i gnyen por lha chen gyi ngo bo rnam pa 'brong g.yag zhol can dkar po 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ rwa gnyis thang shing brgyangs pa tsam la shin tu rno ba/ kha rlangs na bun ltar 'thib shing ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ gnam lcags rmig pa me ltar 'bar bas rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dam ltar brdzis shing rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'gyed pa/ nub byang du byi ru'i ba gam lcags ris bskor ba'i ra bar utpal dmar pos mtshan pa'i me tog dang ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i tshal gyis khor yug tu dkrigs pa'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la rlung sems las
rung gi lha dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar la 'tsher ba padma dmar po'i phreng rgyan can/ g.yas lcags kyus bsgrub bya'i snying nas 'gugs shing g.yon zhags pas mgul nas 'ching ba/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs par 'gugs byed dbang gi pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang shar du yid 'ong 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i nang du rin po che las grub pa'i 'chi med lha'i khang bzang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i khor yug tu lha'i skyed tshal gyis yongs su bskor ba'i lte bar rin po che'i khri padma nyi zla dgra bgegs pho mo'i gdan la lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po sku mdog dmar ser mche ba gtsigs pa ag tshom dang smin ma glog stong ltar 'khyug pa/ dbu skra laṃ khri'i mdog can thor tshugs kyi rtser skye ba lnga pa'i dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba sum tshom gyi steng du nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhi ma khre'i nyams can/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar phyar zhing g.yon pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong thur du bskor ba stag lpags kyi rked dkris dang sbrul gyi do shal gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs nas me 'od klong nas bzhugs par tshangs ris kyi 'khor tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba/ zhi rgyas dbang 'gugs 〈drag 〉tshangs pa ste lnga ga'ang dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ srog zhu sogs rin po che'i rgyan snyan gong
༄7/ /utpal dang dung gi cod pan 'phyang ba/ nang kha dog sna tshogs dang phyi rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rtsegs ber nyis brtsegs gsol ba'i nang ma la gser sked bcings pa/ rin po che'i hor lham gsol zhing sku las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i/ sku'i rnam par 'phrul pa dgur bstan pa de dag gi g.yas phyogs su ngo bo dang ye shes kyi lha la rnam pa dung khra dkar pos nam mkha'i dbyings nas gzan la gshur ba bzhin bar snang rlabs kyis spyad de byur 'dre phung srid 'byung po phug ron 'dra ba'i rjes bshul bsnyegs te sha khrag rus pa za ba/ rgyab tu lcags sdigs nag po lus kyi sa gzhi khyab cing rwa dang mjug ma nam mkhar gdengs nas 'od zer lcags kyi drwa bar rgab 'dre phyir 'brang bcug ste snying khrag 'byin pa g.yon du sprul pa'i dung spyang pho mo glog ltar 'khyug pa spu gri'i mche bas dgra bgegs 'bigs shing lcags kyi sder mos sa gzhi bgrad pa/ mjug ma brdab pas me rlung 'tshubs pa/ phyi rol gyi khor sa dang po la lha dang klu gnyan bye ba 'bum sde'i dmag tshogs/ phyi ma la snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i cha lugs su 'jigs shing dpa' ba/ kun kyang nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid ltar 'bar ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūX hrīXmathar snying pos bskor ba dang bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od
zer 'phros pas mtho ris lha'i tshal lha brgyad gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i pho brang sogs nas dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku'i rnam 'gyur brgyad dang bcas par grangs med pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba badzra sa ma yā dza dzaXs spyan drangasasposaskyor bsreg cing g.yab dar rol mo dbyangasadang bcas te spyan drangasabazhugs gsol ba ni/ gter gzhung / hūXltoX sngon tshe ka dag rdo rje'i dbyings/ /snang gsal 'od kyi gzhal yas khang / /'og min 'phrul gyi zhing khams su/ /sangs brgyas bstan pa bsrung bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying / /sprul pa lha chen 'bar ba rtsal/ /mi mjed kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po mthu bo che/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon kun gyi rje/ /shel gyi gnam lha dkar po grags/ /gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ /byang thang gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo ste/ /mchod 'khor gtsang ris lha yi tshogs/ /bka' sdod dregs ldan du mas bskor lha chen dpal 'bar drag shul can/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis sku bskyed tshe/ /sa gzhi ri brag thams cad kyang / /mtho dma' med par zhongs se zhong / /dpung tshogs char sprin 'thibs pa bzhin/ /dgyes pa'i gang rgyangs di ri ri/ /spyan 'dren dang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /nyi zla padma rin chen khrir/ /ye shes gsang ba'i lha mchog khyed/ /bstan srung rgyal por mnga' gsol tshe/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil
