༄༅/ /'khor la/ /gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum bzhin rgyas/ /nag phyogs bdud dpung zil gyis gnon/ /dpa' bo stobs ldan snying po can/ /sde dpon chen po'i spyan snga rtswa /bdag gis khas blangs dam bca' g.yel dam tshig nyams chags mtho 81 bshags/ /mnyes mchod thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /man shel 'od 'phro gsang ba'i rten/ /ting 'dzin gsal ba'i thugs dam bskang / /dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten bsnyen sgrub bzlas pas thugs dam bskang / /sku 'bag rgyan ldan tpū yi rten/ /'dod yon longs spyod thugs dam bskang / gter gzhung / hūXltoX ye shes gzhal yas cu gtsang mas mchod/ bar la mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo 'bul ba ni hūXltoX dri yol mo gsum pa'i yinamed g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma'i chu/ /rab dkar yol go'i snod du kun nas bskyil/ /mdangs mdzes dri zhim lte ba rab mtho ba'i/ /me tog dkar pos gser gyi bum bzang mdzes/ /tsandan sbos dkar rgya shug sbyar ba'i bsangs/ /srid gsum 'jig rten khyab pa'i dud sprin 'thul/ /rtsi bcud gsar ba'i zhun me dngul dkar gyi/ /kong bu nyi ltar 'bar ba'i snang gsal mchog /rin chen brdar shel las grub pad phor nang / /ga bur bsil ba'i chur btab byug pa'i rdzas/ /dmar dang ma 'dres bdag dgur sbyar ba'i zas/ /rin chen byu ru'i gzhong par ri ltar spungs/ snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs
ma 'dres sna tshogs pa/ /dga' dang spro dang dad pas gus mchod kyi/ /lha chen gsang mtshan rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /yum gcig mtsho sman sprul 'khor rta dmag 'bum/ /ma bdun bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul dgyes shing thugs brtse dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ oX badzra thang ka ra sa pa ri wa ra arghaX puspro nas/ shabha pra titstsha swāhā'i bar brjod do/ dam tshig rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas pa/ gsar brisadapal phyag na rdo rdze/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ chos rgyal mnga' bdag yab sras/ jo mo mkhar chen bza'/ gter ston rig 'dzin yab sras/ sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/ mtshan ldan bla ma rnam gnyis / drin can sangs rgyas dpal bzang / ldong ston chos rgyal bsod nams yab sras/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ gzhan yang gter ston yab sras nas/ rdo rje 'chang bsod nams bzang po/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan nam mkha' grags pa/ rje dkon mchog blo gros mtshungs med blo gros dbang po/ mnyam med shākya dpal bzang / nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gzhan yang gter ston yab sras nas/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal ba/ rje chos dpal
༄༅/ /'byor / mtshungs med rin chen gzhon nu/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje dang nub dgon pa ste/ rnam gnyis gtsug rgyan dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ yol mo gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bu/ brgyud pa kun 'dus thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol sogs rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam la btags pa'i dam tshig gnyen po nye bar dgongs la mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sku lha/ ya rabs bsod nams can gyi srung ma/ dbu gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha/ dam tshig nyams pa'i srog bdud mna' zan yongs kyi gshed ma/grib gnon rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnya' gnon/ sku gcig la rnam 'gyur dgur ston pa/ don gcig la mtshan drug tu grags pa lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal khyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon cog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ mchod gnas sde gnyis kyi 'dus sde skyongs/ bod yul ru bzhi'i rgyal khams 'dir bde skyid spel/ khyad par rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra thul gnod par byed pa'i bgegs choms/ bye brag grib gnon rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po rnams kyi mthu stobs nus pa rdul phran bzhin du rlog la bdag sogs yongs kyi nad rims
dus min 'chi bas mtshon pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang / tshe dpal longs spyod mnga' thang sogs chos srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus yar ngo'i zla ba ltar spel ba dang / srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i 'phrin las thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod cig /badzra sa ma ya hūXltoX zhesadam bsgrags gter gzhung du pra ston par gsol ba ni/ lha chen po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa la gnyes mchod mchod gtor 'di 'bul bas bdag gi phy-i nang gsang ba'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang legs nyes kyi mtshan ma dang rtags rnams gsal bar bstan du gsol/ zhesdmod mo bor zhing brtag lugs gzhan du shes/ sman gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūXltoX gsar brisartsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ rdo rje 'bar rtsal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bzhes nas dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram khā hi/ hūXltoX dkar gsum mngar gsum bzang sman 'bru dkar zan/ legs sbyar ye shes bdud rtsi byin brlabs la/ ro mchog brgya phrag ldan pa'i bha linta/ 'bul gyis bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcasal/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūX las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can
no༅༅/ /gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oX badzra thang ka ra sa pā ri wā ra mahā ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtsa bo la lan bdun nam nyer gcig ā ka rosagatso 'khor spyir lan gsum mam bdun gyisa'abul/ bka' srung rgyas mchod dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo/ gter gzhung / 'dzab ni/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du āXdakar po'i mthar oX badzra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li swā hā:༷༷ zhes pa dung gi 'phreng ba lta bus bskor ba rang dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hrīXdamar po la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba/ de'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus lha chen gyi nus pa dang gzi byin 'od zer sna tshogs su rang la thim par bsam/ gsar bris/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams su bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ de dag las kyang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ lha mi'i gnas su bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal so so'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs las ma dag pa sbyangs pa'i khrus char 'bebs/ dri bzang sbos kyi ngad pa 'thul/ ā laṃ kā li'i rang sgra bsgrags pas nad gdon bar chad zhi zhing tshe dpal 'dod dgu'i legs tshogs rnams bsdus nas rang la thim/ stong gsum gyi skye rgu kun dbang du 'dus te bran du bkol zhing 'dar yed yed gnas dgra bgegs bdud dpung thams cad tshar bcad/
mdor na ci bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin du sgrub par bsam zhing sngags ci nusabazlas/ las so sor sgrub tshe skabs thob kyi gtso bo 'pho ba dang dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur gyi gnad zhal las brisanyams chag gi ltas che na bag chagasastobasasbyangs kyi sgo nasakhrusagasol/ ye shesasku mchog ma dang / gzhan yang / gsar bris/ hūXltoX byang sems nam mkha'i snying po 'gro ba'i don/ /las bzhi bsgrub phyir sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /ston mdzad zur phud lnga pa dri za'i rgyal/ /'khor dang bcas pa deng 'dir snyan gson zhig/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /log par lta sogs spyi dang bye brag gi/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig las/ /nyams chags nongs par gyur pa'i tshogs kun bshags tshon brgya nye ba'i man shel ji bzhin du/ /lha khyod bgrangs yas sku yi rnam par 'phrul/ /gsal stong bskyed rim tshul ldan ma bsgoms pa/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /srog gi snying po gsang ba sngags kyi sgra/ /grags stong rgyun mi chad pa'i 'dzab bzlas kyi/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bsnyen bsgrub g.yel la sogs/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams chag ma lus bshags/ /ngo po ye nas rang bzhin 'od gsal bar/ /kun khyab kun la 'jug pa'i thugs rje'i gdangs/ /bde stong zung 'jug ting 'dzin la g.yol ba'i/ thugs kyi dam tshig: srog dbang lung dang man ngag gnod byang kun/ /dam med snod
༄tsho/ /min rnams la bstan pa dang / /bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor mchod pa'i rdzas ma tshang / /'bag rtsog 'chol dang nor 'khrul ma dag bshags/ /dam tshig sdom nyams 'khon mdze dme yug gshon/ /ro bag mi gtsang ka ca rdzas ngan sogs/ /rtsing sogs spyad pas lha dang sgrub pa po/ /nongs pa'i rgyun rkyen bsags pa ma lus bshags/ /lo zla tshes grangs dus kyi gsol bskang mdos/ /rgyun gyi gtor ma bag med g.yeng bas chags/ /nag phyogs lha rigs 'byung por yid bstad de/ /'bad pas bsten cing mchod pa'i nyes kun bshags/ dri med rig pa ye nas rang dag kyang / /kun rdzob sems kyi 'khrul ngo'i nyes pa rnams/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang ji bzhin don ma dbyings/ /bshags bya bshags byed bral pa'i ngang nas bshags/ zhesabarjod phyi nang gsang ba'i bskang rdzas byin gyisabarlabs pa ni/ hūXltoX stong gsum kun nas dri mchog sogs/ hūXltoX pad sdong 'dab drug sogs dang / dbang sdud 'phrin las kun 'grub thekhog/ cesabyin gyisabarlabs/ phyi yi bskang ba ni/ yol mo ba gsum pasamadzad rab dwangs zhi ba'i rlabs ldan gtsang ma'i chab/ /lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgrar bcas rgyun 'bab klung / /g.ya' chu gangs chu lu mar skyi sogs kyi/ /mchod yon mdzes par sgrengs pas khyod mchod do/ /paṇḍa ri ga'i tshal rgyas utpal nags/ /gzhan yang chu dang thang skyes me tog sogs/ /dpyid kyi dpal mos rab spel phreng
mdzes pa/ /lha mchog dbu la 'ching ba'i thod du 'bul/ /tsan dan spos dkar lha shug sogs sbyar ba'i/ /dud sprin srid pa gsum gyi blar spungs pas/ /ma dag nyes pa'i dri ma kun sel ba/ /shangs kyi dbang po tshim phyir bdag 'bul lo/ /rab sbyangs nor bu'i sgron me sna tshogs dang / /rtsi bcud til gyi mar me gsal 'bar bas/ bskal pa'i gshe mun mthar byed ā lo ke/ /ma bsgribs gsal bar spyan gyi gzigs mor 'bul ga bur dgos pas rab bsil gur gum gyi/ /ge sar rdul tshogs rgyas pas rab mdzes pa/ /yid 'ong khrus kyi rdzing bu 'di dag ni/ /brjid pa'i sku la byug pa'i rdzas su sbyar/ /'bras dkar phung po 'bru bcud bzang po dang / /gnyis su med sbyar rgyan ldan gtsang ma'i bshos/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum shing tog 'bru sna yis/ /ljags kyi dbang po kun nas tshims gyur cig /rnga chen dung dang sis snyan gling bu'i sgras rab drangs dri za'i dbyangs su rab 'tsher ba'i/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod bskul ba'i gyer mang po/ /thogs pa med gsan lha yi snyan la 'bul/ /skad cig gcig la stong gsum 'jig rten kun/ /bgrod byed rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan mdzes pa'i chibs/ /gser dngul dar zab rgyan ldan lha rta dkar/ /gsang chen bka' yi bya ra mdzad phyir 'bul/ /sprin dkar dag pa'i phung po cher phungs lta'i/ /zhol dkar rdo rje'i rwa
༄༅/ /ldan ri ltar 'gying / /sna tshogs dar gyi 'phan [chun ]pos ltar mi mngon/ /phyi rten lha g.yag mdzes pas thugs dam bskang / /thogs med cir yang rgyu ba skar mda'i spun/ /mdzes pa'i dung khra 'phur lding gzan la 'jum/ /shel dum ltar dkar gtsang lug mang po yis/ /lha mchog thugs kyi dgyes pa skongs gyur cig /'dod zung 'jig rten kun na zla bral zhing / /zla ba'i gdugs dkar g.yas su 'khor ba'i tog /yid bzhin nor bus mtshan pa bsil bas 'bad/ /rgyal mtshan dar 'phan rnga yab dkar pos bskang / /mchog dman rin chen mang spungs gter gyi ri/ /dar zab lda lding rab dpyang tshon ris kyi/ /phyogs la dbang po'i tshon dgod spyan gzigs kyis/ /lha gnyan 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig /gsar bris/ sra brtan khrab chen za 'og sham bu can/ /rgyal mtshan dar lcog rgod spu chas ldan rmog /rnga ma'i 'ja' ris zhol btags lcags gzhi sogs/ /rang srung rdo rje'i go chas thugs dam bskang / /ral gri spu gri dgra stu dpag chen mda'/ /gri gug rtse gsum mdung rnon 'phrul skyong sogs/ /pha rol dgra dpung phye mar 'thag nus pa'i / sna tshogs mtshon cha'i rigs kun khyod la 'bul/ /kha dog rab bkrag gtse ber lhab lhub g.yo/ /lha mi'i rin chen rgyan cha ska rags lham/ /pad phreng snyan gong utpal dar lte g.yo/ /stag sham sbrul gyi chun
pos khyed mchod do/ /sba lcag sher phreng gser gyi 'khor lo bram/ /sman ljongs bcud bum nor bu rin chen sgrom/ /mdung zhags lcags kyi mda' gzhu mchil pa dang / rgyal mtshan me 'o(nga phyag mtshan tshogs rnams 'bul rta nag ne'u le g.yu 'brug seng stag dom/ /sha rkyang rma bya ne tso thang dkar sogs/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwags 'phreng dgu'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang / /bzang drug tsandan ga bur la sogs sman/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun dang / /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla sogs/ /lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi 'byor tshogs 'bul/ phyi'i rten ni/ yol mo pa'i gsung rtsom cung zad bsnan pa 'di maṇḍal gru bzhi smyug rgod dar snas brgyan/ /bris 'bur zhal brnyan ye shes sems dpa' 'khyil/ /dar dkar gzhi dmar long bris snying po'i phreng / /lha chen chags pa'i tpū sgrub rten du 'bul/ nang gi bskang ba ni/gser skyems/ raX yaX khaX/ oX āXhūX gisabyin gyisabarlabs/ hūXltoX yol mo gsum pasamadzad 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba'i dza gad dang / /dkar dang rgya ja gtsang ma'i gser phye sbyar/ /'chi med bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen po 'dis / /lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur cig/ cesabarjod/ logs su gser skyems bshams pa lasakyi rdo rje btag la/ gsar brisaho dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gser skyems kyi mchod pa rgya chen
༄tshi/ /po 'di bzhes la bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor kun la gnod par byed pa'i ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad snang srid lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa/ nad gdon bar chad/ chags che nyam nga ba/ khyad par steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon gnod thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ bye brag che ge mo sogs dngos nyams rmi lam du cho 'phrul ngan pa ston pa po rnams sprul pa'i lha g.yag dkar pos 'dam ltar rdzis so/ dung khra dkar pos mchus thal phyung du phug lcags kyi sdig pa nag pos srog rtsa chod la rdul du rlog cig mdor na phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod du gsol/ zhesabarjod/ gtsang sar gtor/ de nasatshogs mchod ni/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs las/ oX usnyasma bee ta le kro dha ni sarba pra phyam shwa dha ni hūX phaṭa swā hā:༷༷ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ chos kun thams cad sgyu mar rig rig pa'i ye shes raX yaX khaX/ tshogs kyi dngos po bsregs sbyangs bkrus/ oX āXhūXgisabyin gyisabarlabs/ yol mo gsum pasamadzad/ zhi rdzas dang drag rdzasakyi tshog phud ma 'dresapar bshams/ dang po mchod pa ni/ gdod nas yongs dag dam tshig chen po'i rdzas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i bza' bca' btung ba'i dngos/ /lha chen yum gcig 'khor dang bcas par 'bul/ /bzhes nas dam tshig bka' yi bya ra mdzod/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sa pā ri wā ra ga na tsakra pā tsa khā hi/ bar pa ni/ sgrub rdzas ma tshogs mna' dang dam las 'gal/
mi gtsang grib phog dam med mi dang 'dres/ nag phyogs lha rigs brten 〈snags nyes spyad tshogs/ rang gnong 'gyod pas bshags rbesna byang bar mdzod/ tha mal nya bo dang phyag mtshan rnams bzhams/ gsar bris/ hūXltoX e las thar med gnam lcags brub khung nang / /rghaṃ dang tri las dam nyams dgra bgegs lhangogs/ /skra gzings ring cing yan lag lcags sgrog gdams/ /nyam thag mya ngan 'dug stangs can du gyur/ /dgra bgegs bla tshe rnam shes 'gugs pa'i ched/ /rang nyid dri za'i rgyal por gsal ba yi/ /phyag g.yas sba lcag 'phyar bas ma mo bdun/ /skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du thogs med sogs/ na ma rbad bhyo bhyo/ lan bdun brjod/ hūX zhes brjod pas skad cig gnas 'gyur te/ /dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar rtsal phyag gnyis kyis/ /lcags kyus snying bzung zhags pas ske bcings tshe/ /ma mo bdun gyi ro zan bcus te bkug snra tri dza dzaX lan bdun brjod/ de nas pho nya bskul lo/ na mo rtsa gsum lha tshogs bden pa dang / chos nyid ye nas 'gyur ba med pa la/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med bden pa dang / khyad par zhi ba byang sems nam mkha'i snying / khro bo rdo rje 'bar rtsal 'khor bcas kyi/ mthu stobs nus pa rdzu 'phrul bden pa dang / tshe [che ]mnyam bsod nams 'brel ba'i: 'go lha ru bzhi'i yul lha'i: mna' dang dam la gnas pa'i sgrub pa po'i: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i
༄tsho/ /byin rlabs dang / khyod gsol mchod sgrub brtson pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog /yang gsang bka' gter snying po'i bstan pa bsnubs/ khyad par sngags 'chang dpon slob rgyu sbyor la/ byad ma dug sbyor g.yul 'khrug ngan gros mkhan/ bsam ngan sbyor ba brtsam pa'i gzugs can dgra/ tshe la sku zhing srog la rngam par 'jab/ lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal gtong / bsam pa bar du gcod pa'i gzugs med bgegs/ smyo 'dre rgyal bsen 'gong po dam sri'i tshogs/ rbad 'dre lha srin 'byung po ma rungs kun/ khug cig badzra aX ku sha ya dzaXske nas chings shog badzra pa sha hūm̐XltoX yan lag sdoms shig badzra sbo ṭa baX/ myos par gyis shig badzra gharnye ho:༷༷ phyes shig badzra pra be sha ya phaṭa4༷༷ dbyer med bstims shig a be sha ya āX zhesalan gsum mam bdun sogs dgug gzhug bya/ de nasabasgral ba ni/ hūṃX rang nyid garma rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ thabs shes lcags kyi mda' gzhu rab bkang nas/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mde'u dgra bgegs kyi/ snying la 'phangs te sod cig sha ri ṇa/ dar lte rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan can/ rno ngar dbal dang ldan pa snon po'i mdung / gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs tshogs kyi/ lte bar bsnun no phug cig kunti na/ rang nyid lha chen tshangs par gnas
'gyur ba'i/ mi bzad rno ngar ldan pa'i ral gri yis/ gnod sbyin dgra dang bgegs kyi yan lag rnams/ tshal pa dum bur gtubs shig /rtsibs stong gser gyi 'khor lo thogs med du/ shugs drag rab 'khor rno dbal 'bar ba yis/ sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs rnams kyi/ mgo la bskor bas 'gems so tsakra ṇa/ dgra bgegs smyo 'dre dam sri 'byung po'i srog la mā ra ya phaṭa4༷༷ snra tri ma ra ya sod/ cesadum bur gtubs / lir ro bdud rtsi bran la/ yol mo ba gsum pasamadzad do/ gdug byed dgra bo mi bsrun dam nyams kyi/ gzugs phung sha khrag rus pa klad tshil snying / glo ba rgyu ma nang khrol rkang mar dang / dwangs ma chu ba dbang po rnam lnga'i tshogs/ bhanta yangs pa'i snod du yongs bskyil nas/ rlung me 'bar ba'i sbyor bas snyom byas shing / 'bru gsum zhu ba'i bdud rtsi chen po 'di/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas 'bul/ rab khros lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ rdo rje g.yu sgron bdud mor khros pa'i gzugs/ 'jigs pa'i ma bdun las byed shan pa'i tshogs/ sprul 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bzhes/ ma hā maX sa rakta go ro tsa na ba su ta bo dhi tsitta keṃ ni ri ti anti pañtsa khā hi/ zhesa'abul/ lhag ma la bdud rtsi bran/ yol mo bas mdzad do/ oX āXhūXltoX gisabyin gyisabarlabs la/ rang lha chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ lhag la dbang ba'i bran dang pho nya'i tshogs/ mchod sbyin bka' yi pham
༄༅/ /phab 'di longs la/ gtso bo'i bka' bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ ma thogs myur du sgrub pa'i las mdzod cig /mahā ba linta khā hi/ nang rten ni/ yol mo ba gsum pa'i gsung la cung zad bsnan pa/ dkar gsum gtsang phye sman phud yongs sbyar bar/ sna tshogs rgyan gyi khyad par bkod legs pa/ shel mkhar rin chen sgo lcog 'bar ba'i dbyibs/ dam rdzas gtor ma nang gi rten du 'bul/ zhesabarjod gsang ba'i bskang ba ni/yol mo gsum sems mdzad/ rab mdzes gsang ba'i yum chen g.yu sgron ma/ 'dzum sgeg zur gyis lta ba'i mig yang ma/ nu 'bur rab mtho ske skabs rab phra ma/ brgyad gnyis 'ordzon 'dra'i gzugs bzang bde sbyin ma/khyug khyug smin legs ri mor bris 'dra zhing / sil sil dbu skra'i lan bu rgyab tu grol/ khrol khrol gser gyi gdu bu rab 'khrol zhing / lhang lhang snyan pa'i glu sgra len par brel/ sngo bsangs lang tsho ldan pa'i lus kyi mkhar mu tig rgyu skar bye bas rnam bkra zhing / dar zab sna lnga'i 'ja' tshon spel legs kyi/ smad dkris sham bur mdzes pa deng 'dir dran/ ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi ci yang ster byed cing / mnyen lcug dam por mkhyud pa'i phyag zung ldan/ zag med dga' ba'i 'dod 'byung utpal la'i/ dri ldan mkha' dbyings gsar ba'i rnam par mtshan/ lha mo khyod ni lha chen rgyas mdzad do/ gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi/ zung
'jug ye shes chen po'i dgongs pa yis/ bde chen dga' bzhi'i rol pa bzhes su gsol/ mahā mu tra pu tsa ho/ gu hya su dza sa ma ya ho/ gsang ba'i rten ni/ yol mo ba gsum pasamadzad/ ting 'dzin gsal ba'i don mtshon man shel dkar/ dri med 'od rgyun zad mi shes pa'i rten/ rnam par mi rtog thugs kyi dam rdzas mchog gsang rten yid bzhin nor bus thugs dam dang / de kho na nyid kyi bskang ba ni/ gsar bris/ hūXltoX gdod nas dri bral ngo bo nam mkha'i snying / rang bzhin lhun grub 'gags pa med pa'i gdangs/ kun khyab lha chen ngang du nges rnyed pa'i/ don dam mchog gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang/ bde gsal mi yol mo ba gsum pasamadzad rtog dbyings rig dbyer med pa'i/ dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ba11da gcig lam/ lha chen thugs kyi daskyurdzongs pa zab zhi ngang / ji bzhin mnyam par bzhag pa'i thugs dam bskang / rtsa gsum bskang gso btang nas tshogs la rol bstod pa ni / hūXltoX dpal ldan lha yi lha mchog khyodagiX gter gzhung / 'dzam gling byang phyogs kha ba can4༷༷ kha ba can gyi byang ljongs nas4༷༷ sa gzhi ljang sngon rtsi bcud rgyas4༷༷ me tog padma 'od du 'phros4༷༷ gangs dkar shel gyi 'phreng bas bskoraltoX yid 'ong mtsho chen mdangs dang ldan4༷༷ shel dkar rin chen sgo lcog 'baraltoX rtsa ba yid bzhin rgya mtsho'i bsten4༷༷ rked par 'ja' 'od na bun 'thibs4༷༷ rtse mo sprin dkar dgos 'dod kyi4༷༷ rin chen
༄tsho/ /char 'beb 'brug sgra sgrogs4༷༷ gzhal yas de yi nang shed na4༷༷ nyi zla padma rta mchog steng ltoX dam can rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷ sku mdog dkar la khro 'jum 'gying ltoX phyag g.yas rdo rje sba lcag 'phyaraltoX g.yon pas zla ba'i shel phreng 'dren4༷༷ dar dkar thod bcings dbu skra'i rtseraltoX yid bzhin nor bu 'bar bas brgyan4༷༷ sku la ber chen phrug gsum gsol4༷༷ gzhon mdzes yid 'phrog rgyal po'i chas4༷༷ 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros4༷༷ mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang ltoX dmag dpung bye ba 'bum sdes bskoraltoX kun kyang khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs4༷༷ dar mtshon rol mo nam mkha' gang ltoX bde gshegs stong gi bstan pa srung ltoX padma 'byung gnas bka' bzhin bsgrubaltoX chos rgyal mnga' ri bu bzhin skyong ltoX dbus gtsang ru bzhi yul lha mdzodagiX rje dpon yongs kyi dgra lhar gyuraltoX rdo rdze 'bar ba rtsal la bstodagiX lha chen yongs kyi rje bor bstodagiX dri za'i rgyal po khyed la bstodagiX de nas rig 'dzin mchog thob paraltoX snyan pa nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs4༷༷ grags pa gza' skar 'od ltar 'khyil4༷༷ dbu 'phangs ri rgyal rtse ltar bstodagiX rigs brgyud chu bo rgyun ltar spel4༷༷ dgos 'dod dpag bsam shing ltar rtsol4༷༷ sde brgyad dregs pa bran ltar bkol4༷༷ smyo 'dre rgyal po rdul bzhin thul4༷༷ dam med mna' zan bgegs bzhin sgrol4༷༷ bdag gi lus dang
grib ma bzhin4༷༷ 'grogs nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsolaltoX gsar bris/ chos kyi dbyings las nam yang g.yo med dang / /brlang por spyod pa'i yed srub sde dpung rnams/ /'dul phyir nam mkha'i snying po lha chen skur ston mdzad rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /lha brgyad gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i ljongs/ /rin chen brgyan gyi mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus/ /padma nyi zla'i steng na gar dgu yis/ /rnam rol dri za'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /shel dkar zhun ma'i lhun po zla zer gyis/ /'khyud 'dra'i gzugs skus lha yi khengs pa 'phrog /gnam sngon khu bas byug pa'i thor gtsug rtser/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i mtshan la bstod 'ja' ltar rnam par bkra ba'i spyan dkyus ring / /smin legs g.yu yi 'khri shing mngon par 'khyug /cung zad khro nyams zhi chags mchu sgros 'dab/ /'jum dbus tshems dkar ze'u 'brus bskor la bstod phyag g.yas rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i sba lcag dkar/ /lha lam ngos phyar ma bdun las la 'gyed/ /g.yon pa legs nyes rtses su 'dren pa yi/ /man shel brgya rtsa'i phreng ba mdzes la bstod/ /dmar mthing rtse gos rin chen gser skud bcings/ /gos dkar ber chen lding stabs tshul tu gsol/ /srog zhu snyan mgul gdu bu se mo do/ /do shal gser ga'i rgyan gyis sprad la bstod/ /nor bu'i sga srab gong smad za 'og gi/
༄tshi/ /spu len zel 〈za 〉long kheb mdzes ngang dkar bcibs/ /goms 'gros lhod por rgyug stong phyed skyil zhabs/ /rin chen las grub mchil lhum gsol la bstod/ /bde ster gsang yum g.yu sgron nam mkha'i mdog rgyal mtshan me 'ordzong 'dzin zhing lhab lhub gos/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan 'khrol g.yu 'brug steng bzhugs pa'i/ /yid 'phrog sman btsun nam mtsho'i rgyal la bstod/ /gnam lcags spu gri'i rwa dang mchu sder can/ /steng zil mdog bzhin gnag 'tsher dbu dgu pa/ /kram kram sgra yi sa bdag klu gnyan klad/ /'gem byed gtsug ldeng khyung chen dbang por bstod/ /cho rigs mtshungs pa'i mched po lha yi bu/ /ston zla'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i bzhin ras can/ /las grub pho nya 'khor gyi sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /ston mdzad sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs la bstod/ /g.yu sman thor gtsug lha gnyen khye'u dang / /mi dkar g.yas g.yon mdun gyi dpung sna 'dren 'jigs rung lcags kyi mi sngon rgyab kyi rtswa /drangs nas g.yul las rnam par rgyal la bstod/ /rtsi sman ljon shing dri ngad 'thul ba dang / /lhan cig ka la sha yi bdud rtsi'i chus/ /bkrus tshe bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi las gyur pa'i/ /nad kyi zug 'a khrung nas 'byen la bstod/ /rab 'bar nor bu rin chen sgrom bu las/ /lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi longs spyod kyis/ /'dzad med mchod sbyin char gyi bkres skom sogs/ dbul
ba'i duXkha pha mthar mdzad la bstod/ /padma ra ga'i bum bzang 'khor 'das kyi/ /srog gi zungs gyur bcud kun 'khyil ba'i rgyun/ /sbyin pa'i mod la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin sa la sbyor der bstod mdung rnon mtshon gyis dgra snying tshal pa rtswa /btang bas ma tshim thog chen 'bar ba'i mda'/ /gnam lcags gzhu mor bkang tshe srid pa gsum/ /'dar byed drag shul brtul zhugs 'chang la bstod/ /skabs gsum bdag po'i lang tsho 'phrog nus pa'i/ /bzhin bzang skyes bu gzhon nu'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /che mnyam tshangs pa lha yi me tog gi/ /srung ma'i gtso por zhal gyis mches la bstod/ sngo bsang rwa rtse srid pa'i rtse mor gdeng / /rmig pas smyo 'dre la sogs 'byung po brdzis/ /kha rlangs na bun bzhin 'thibs 'brug sgra ldir/ /ngur ba'i 'brong g.yag zhol chen dkar por bstod/ /btab pa tsam gyis yid 'ong 'phrog nus pa rab dmar lcags kyu zhags pa'i 'phrul chen po/ /khab len rdo dang lcags bzhin brtan g.yo'i dngos/ /'bad med dbang du sdud par mdzad la bstod/ /sin ddhā wa ra'i mdangs kyis 'jig rten gsum/zil gnon bran 'khol ral gri gser 'khor gyi/ /nag po rtsa lag 'thag pas mthu rtsal ldan/ /tshangs pa dung gi thogs gtsugs can la bstod/ /mi rabs phyugs dang longs spyod phongs pa'i sri/ /'dre ngan 'byung po
༄tshi/ /bya dkar gzugs sprul pa/ /gnam lcags mchu dang sder mos thal phyung du/ /'bug mdzad sprul pa'i rgya khra dkar por bstod/ /smyo 'bog snying rlung rgyal gzer dmu chu dang / /'khrug slong gtong ba'i lha min gdon gyi snying / /rnon po'i mche ba btab nas khrag 'jib pa'i/ /'jigs rung lcags kyi sdig pa nag por bstod/ /spu gri mche gtsug sder mos sa gzhi bgrad/ /mjug ma brdab pas me rlung 'tshub ma g.yo/ /glog ltar 'khyug pas stong gsum skad cig la/ /nyul mdzad sprul pa'i dung spyang wo mor bstod/ /mdog dbyibs cha lugs phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa/ /zhi rgyas chags pa'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur dang / /mi sdug gtum po phy-i nang bar gsum du/ /'khod pa'i 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho bstod/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ yol mo gsum pasamadzad/ /padma thod phreng rgyal ba'i spyan snga rtswa /dam can zhal bzhes thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis ji ltar bcol pa'i las/ /ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /smyo ba'i 'dre rgod rgyal po kun 'dul zhing / /rnam thos bu yi bdag pos yang dag 'byor/ sngags rgyas mu dra dbang du 'du ba dang / /phas rgol g.yul las rgyal ba'i las mdzod cig /'chi med bdud rtsi btung bas yun du 'tsho/ /byad ma ban bon gdug pa'i mthus mi'i brdzes/ /bstan 'dzin rigs brgyud chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ /
rang gzhan don kun 'grub pa'i las mdzod cig /gnod byed dgra steng thog ser char ltar 'bebs/ /gtad khram las kyi sde dpon nyi shu'i tshogs/ /bran bkol mdzes phol gzer thab smyo 'bog dang / /nad rims du mas bstan dgra phung du chug /lha yi lha mchog khyod 'khor lha chen brgyad/ /sde dpon sum cu sde brgyad brtan mar bcas/ /las la bkol nas srid gsum zil gnon cing / /grag 'bar las bzhi 'grub pa'i nus ldan mdzod/ /mtshan ldan thod pa shel phor ci rigs pa/ /'bras dkar dza gad bzang pos yongs bkang ba'i/ /rten 'brel thabs kyi legs nyes kun gsal zhing / /gza' rgod gnod pa zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /khyad par rgyal bas gnyer gtad yongs 'dus rgyud/ /dgung la reg dang bu bzhin skyong ba rtswa /dam bca' zhal bzhes dus las mi g.yel bar/ /srung skyob yongs su sbas pa'i las mdzod cig /slob dpon smod rtsod skur 'debs zhe sdang ba'i/ /dam nyams slob bu mna' zan skye bo'i tshogs/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus tshar bcad nas/ /bka' gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig nga ni gter gzhung dbang drag padma'i sras4༷༷ nyid ni lha chen 'bar ba rtsal4༷༷ sngon gyi zhal bzhes thugs dam dgongs4༷༷ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs bskyed la4༷༷ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs4༷༷ ma lus zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzodagiX
༄tshi/ /tshe dang bsod nams phan bde tshogs4༷༷ cir yang rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzodagiX snod bcud 'khor dang longs spyod tshogs4༷༷ khams gsum dbang sdud 'phrin las mdzodagiX log lta gnod sbyin dgra bgegs rnams4༷༷ tshar gcod drag po'i 'phrin las mdzodagiX snyan par bsngags dang grags pa'i tshogs4༷༷ phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzodagiX 'gro kun smin grol legs lam ston4༷༷ don gnyis mthar phyin 'phrin las mdzodagiX bskul pa ni/ hūX hūX hūXltoX gter gzhung / /bzhugs yul 'dam thekhod snar mo nas/ /ya zhur gnyen po sku bzhengs shig /bla mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang shed nas/ /gnyen chen thang lha skur bzhengs shog /brag dkar gnyen po'i rtse mo nas/ /dri za'i rgyal po skur bzhengs shig /gangs dkar mthon po'i rtse mo nas/ /yul lha chen po skur: sprin dang na bun gseb shed nas/ /zur phud lnga pa skur: sdang ba'i dgra 'dul skur: / gnod pa'i bgegs 'dul: smyo ba'i 'dre 'dul skur: sprul pa'i tshul du skur bzhengs lhag /sprul pa 'jigs pa lus po de/ lha g.yag dkar po zhig /dung ru gnam du g.yug /dung ru dkar po zhig /gnam gyi bdud la bsgyuraltoX nang gi god kha bsgyur/ rmig bzhi sa la bgrad/ dung rmig dkar po yis/ lha srin dmyal thag chod/ rnga ma dal khar dbyug /rnga dkar sprugs pa yis/ lha btsan bran du khol/ ngar
skad theng gsum ngar / khams gsum dbang du sdud/ ru bsig lan gsum yug /srid gsum dbang du sdud/ mtho mtho gong gsum na/ dung khra mel tshe bzhin/ dung khra dkar po zhig /la nyi khril li li/ rong dang 'brog sgo nas/ dung spyang dkar po zhig /dgra bo'i bla la rgyug/ drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ sdang ba'i dgra bo gsod/ gnod pa'i bgegs rnams thul/ oX badzra kro ta na shi li mi li du bgegs ma ra ya phaṭa/chosargyal ratna gling pa'i brag dmar chosasde lasabyung / hūṃX yang cig bzhengs shig nag po ti pa ra tsa khyod/ byang phyogs rgyud du che ba'i skur ston pa/ gnyan chen thang lha zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di zhes la/ bdag cag rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi/ mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs/ skyi rdzogad klung du che ba'i skur ston pa / gnyan chen mkhar nag zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i: bdag cag: mi mthun: pho mo rdzong rong phyogs su skur ston pagiX klu bdud mgo dgu zhes su: dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun: lho stod dbu ri'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa/ sku lha mkha' ri zhes su:dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun: sgo chu'i sku rgyab phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pagiX bdud pho zla ba'i gdong can zhes suza dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun: mon kha ring mo'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pagiX bdud
༄༅/ /pho bkrag med zhes su: dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun: seng ge rdzong gsum phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pagiX zu ra ra skyes zhes su: dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun: lho brag mkhar chu'i phyogs su che ba'i skur ston pa: dge bsnyen bsnyo kha zhes su mtshan yang gsol4༷༷ dam rdzas: bdag cag: mi mthun skyen sel: nag po ti pa ra tsa na ga raka kro ta pa tsa la dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la rbad rbadagiX cesalan bdun brjod / thun gtor la chab bran la/ gter gzhung / hūm̐X g.yas ri ri rgyal bkra bzang rtser/ /rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal / /bka' nyan lha srin kun 'dus tshe/ /khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha khyed/ /lha brag thugs gter bdag por bsngags/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor skyong / /snyigs dus rgyal 'gong dam sri yi/ /gnyen po srog gi gshed mar bskos/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gus mchod cing / /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i las la brtson gus pas bstan la snying nye zhing / /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mi 'bral srung / /mdor na bdag sogs 'khor bcas kyi/ /byang chub bsgrub pa geg med cing / /bsam dgu chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byung ba dang / /mchog thun dalnga(sa khru/ba ma lus rnams/ /'bad med lhun khru/ba 'phrin las malnga(da/ /yang thog tu mchod gtor spyan gzigs dang / gzhan yang brten mdosarnams gzhung bzhin bshams/ mdosardzasarnams
dkyusaltar byin rlabs/ hūṃX ye shes gzhal yas bskyed pa rgya ma chung / zhesapa nas/ sam ya dzaraX ༷༷ spyan drangs: bswo bswo/ gter chen gyisamadzad/ /bod yul phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga/ /'dzam gling sa gzhi dbus phyogs na/ /lha ri chags pa gangs dkar ri/ /gangs dkar shel 'od 'bar ba'i gnas/ /rtse la na bun thibs se thib/ /logs la 'dab chags stongs se stong / /zur la gcan gzan khra la la/ /rtsa bar g.yu mtsho kyi li liṃ/ /'dzam gling shar nas bltas tsa na/ /shel gyi maṇḍal brtsegs pa 'dra/ /'dzam gling lho nas bltas tsam na/ /za 'og yol chen 'then pa 'dra/ /'dzam gling nub nas bltas tsa na/ /dung gi gur dkar phub pa 'dra/ /'dzam gling byang nas bltas tsa na/ /dung seng gnam du mchong pa 'dra/ /rtse lnga nam mkha'i mthongs su gsal/ /shel 'od gur khang rtse ri ri/ /rming gzhi dog mo'i dkyil na gnas/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi li li rked pa g.yung drung gling dgur gnas/ /sde brgyad srog 'khor sgor ro ro/ /de 'dra'i gzhal yas dam pa na/ /su bzhugs su mi bzhugs de nas/ /rje yi sku lha gnyan po bzhugs/ /zur phud lnga pa 'khor bcas bzhugs/ /de na jo bo gnyan chen thang lha bzhugs/ /mi dkar g.yu yi smin ma can/ /dar dkar ber chen sku la gsol/ /rin chen rgyan cha du mas brgyan/ stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon/ /sku
༄tshi/ /yi chas ni mdzes sdug 'od du 'bar/ /thog rgod gtum pos khams gsum zil gyi gnon/ /mas kyi thog mdas dgra bgegs srog dbugs 'dral/ /lcags kyi ral gris dgra bgegs mgo lus bcad/ /bar snang khams nas gar gshegs thogs pa med/ /thang lha gnyan sras sku la bstod pa 'bul/ /mdzes pa'i zur phud lnga pos sku la brgyan/ /gser gyi sba lcag g.yu yi lcags 'bras can/ /lan gsum klad g.yug chibs par drag tu brgyab/ /thang lha gnyan sras sku la bstod pa 'bul/ /ngang dkar zhur pos gar bsam yud kyi phyin/ /'jigs pa'i bya khyung dbu yi gtsug na lding / /sa bdag klu gnyan las kyi wo nyar 'gyed/ /klu rgyal thod dkar sku la bstod pa 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bstod cing mchod phul bas/ /stag sogs dom dred rngam 'jigs dgra la ston/ /bstod cing bskul bas g.yel ba ma mdzad cig/ /tshur gshegs bdag gi bcol pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi steng du/ 'bru gsum oX āXhūX 'od du zhu ba las/ grub pas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa 'di/ lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'o(gyor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oX badzra thang ka ra sa pā ri wa ra mahā ba liX ta kha kha khā hi khā hi oX āXhūX/ zhesapa lan bdun gyisadabul bsadagyesapa'i tshul du bsgom/ de nasayang 'bor tshogs la gtor ma zur gsum mtho gang ba brgyad dam/
bcu gnyis/ bcu drug gi rtse la rgyan gyi brgyan pa gsur dud shin tu che ba chang phud 'o phud/ phud dang bcasate 'di skad do/ bswo bswo/ sku lha g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa/ /lha gnyan g.yu yi smin ma can/ /sku lha g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa/ /khye'u chung g.yu yi zur phud can/ /sku lha mdun gyi ru 'dren pa/ /mi dkar g.yu yi thor tshugs can/ /sku lha rgyab kyi ru 'dren pa/ /lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa brgyad/ /'dir spyon phud dang gtor ma bzhes/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /khab ni gnam mtsho phyugs mo ste/ /sman mo g.yu yi thul ba can/ /gser dngul spel ma'i zur phud can/ /sku la dar dkar thul pa gsol/ /phyag na dngul dkar me long bsnams/chibs su chu rta sngon po bcibs/ /sras ni thabs sras mchod pa ste/ /mi dkar g.yu yi smin ma can/ /sku la dar dkar la'u gsol/ /lcam ni 'bri rje gang bzang ma/ /dkar mo g.yu yi thul pa can/ /nangablon phyi blon sgo mar bcas/ phyag brnyan 'khor dang bcas rnams bsgrub/ /bskul lo 'khor bcas ma g.yel zhig /bskul cing rbad na gnyan sras mthu ma chung / /thang lha gnyan sras 'khor bcas la/ /phyi yi mchod pa 'bru yi g.yag lug dang / /nang gi mchod pa gser g.yu chang dang sbyar/ zhal zas rten du 'bru yi g.yag po 'bul/ /thang lha gnyan sras 'khor bcas rnams/ /rin chen gser gyi thugs dam bskang / rten rdzas tshang
༄tshi/ /mas thugs dam bskang / /lha g.yag dkar pos thugs dam bskang / /dmar rtsa lug gis thugs: rngan chang tshang mas: rgyan gyi gtor ma: bdud rtsi sman gyis: dza gad phud kyis: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis:khyed kyi thugs dam bdag gis bskang / /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /de ltar mchod cing bskang ba yis/ /bdag sogs dgon gnas rgyu sbyor gyi/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen khyed kyis mdzod/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa dang / /bsgrubs shing bstan pa bsrung du gsol/ /bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/ /g.yag lug phul bas yon tan gyis/ /nor la god kha med pa dang / /gling stod rta ra'i bdag po mdzod gling smad lug ra'i bdag po mdzod/ g.yag dang mdzo yi bdag po mdzod/ nor la 'phel kha khyed kyis thongs/ ci bsam 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/ rten mdosani/ yol mo gsum pasamadzad/ hūXltoX cang shes rta mchog gser sga dngul srab can/ /sna tshogs dar zab bzang pos rab mdzes pa/ /g.yang lan gsang lug gangs ri lta bur 'tsher/ /bag phebs dal bur rung dang 'gro ba'i stabs/ /zla shel zhun mun 〈mas 〉byugs ltar rab dkar ba'i/ /mkha' lding 'dab chags snyan pa'i skad gsang can/ /sprin dkar phung po lta bu'i lha g.yag cho/ /rdo rje'i rwa dang rnga yab dkar po can/ /kun kyang dar zab dril
bu g.yer kha dang / /mu tig bzang po'i 'phreng bas rab mdzes pa/ /phyi rten mdzes pa'i 'gro tshogs 'di dag gis/ /lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig mya/ g.yas ri ri rgyal bkra bzang rtser zhesasogs bya / mnga' gsol ni/ yol mo ba gsum pasamadzad lha dbang klu bdag lang ga'i rgyal po sogs/ /srid gsum dbang phyug kun gyis mdun bdar nas/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho srid zhir bcas mchod pa'i/ /lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bstod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang brtsegs las rgyal ba'i/ /rin chen shel gyi sku mkhar zla ba'i byin/ /ba gam nor bu'i 'od tshogs rab rgyas pas/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i go skabs yang dag 'phrog /rtsa ba yid bzhin 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi/ /bar med rab sbogs [sbar ]rked skabs mtshon lnga'i mdzes/ /dzambha nā da'i rgya phub cher 'bar ba'i/ /rtse mo rin chen char 'bebs chu 'dzin dkrigs/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul dag las bzhin/ /rgya che bkod pa'i khyad par rgya che ba'i/ /pho brang srid rtse'i dgung na mngon mtho'i rtse/ /yid bzhin rgyal mtshan gsar ba'i mnga' gsol lo/ /dpag yas zhing gi rdul snyed rab 'byams zhing skad cig myul ba'i 'gros ldan lha rta dkar/ /rgyu skar bdag po'i dregs 'joms rgyan ldan pa/ /lha chen chibs kyi dam par mnga' gsol lo/ /ka tsa linta'i ber chen sum brtsegs pas/ /mdzes 'dzum
༄tshi/ /rlabs kyi gzugs brnyan bog 'os pa/ /'jam mnyen reg bya'i khyad par smad byung ba'i/ /rab mdzes lha yi na bza' mnga' gsol lo/ /nor bu'i mchil lhum gser gyi ska rags 'bar/ /ga bur do shal rin chen se mo do/ /mu tig 'bras chags nor bu'i snyan cha gsol/ /mdzes byed rgyan gyi dam pas mnga' gsol lo/ /gser pad g.yu yi yal 'dab mdzes pa'i khongs/ /rnam mang 'od kyi nee sar rab rgyas pa/ /spel legs 'phreng ba bstar ba'i cod pan 'di/ /skra mtshams mdzes pa'i rgyan du mnga' gsol lo/ /brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu las lhag nor/ /bkras shos dam pa kun gyi bkra shis par/ /rgyal bas rab bsngags g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /thor tshugs mdzes pa'i rgyan du mnga' gsol lo/ /rtse mo zur phud lnga bcings ral pa'i khyon/ /bung ba stang zil mig sman ltar snum pa'i/ /rtsa chings bkra shis ri mo rnam bkra ba'i dar dkar dri med lwa bas mnga' gsol lo/ /myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan bha la har/ /bskul byed phyag cha'i khyad par mi 'tshal yang / /ma bdun las la bskul ba'i 'phrul chen po/ /sba lcag rdo rjes mtshan pas mnga' gsol lo/ /cha shas rab rdzogs zla ba'i spun zla zhes/ /bdud rtsi bran pa'i zegs ma dngos grub ltar/ /zad mi shes 'bab nor bu'i shel 'phreng 'di/ /thugs dam dbyings su zlo phyir:
dar zab spyan gzigs mang pos sa bla'i khungs/ /brgya byin gzhu yi dra bas mdzes byas shing / /snyan brjid dpa' ba'i nyams ldan 'bod pa'i dbyangs/ /sna tshogs rol mor bcas pas: gtsang ma'i zhal zas la sogs 'dod yon lnga/ /lha klu mi dang gnod sbyin thams cad kyi/ /dkor nor ma tshangs med spungs nor 'dzin ma'i/ /'phang par rab rdzogs 'dod dgusaca dkon mchog skyabs kyi dam pa skyabs song mgron/ /dkar phyogs lha dang gdong can 'byung po'i tshogs/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu rtsal rmad byung ba/ /kun gyi rje bor deng bdag gzengs bstod do/ /khyad par dpal gyi sprul pa padma'i lung / /ci bzhin mnos pa'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /gter bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag thams cad kyi/ /tshogs bdag tshogs kyi rje bor gzengs bstod do/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs mchis pa'i lha/ brten gsol mchod bsgrub lha srung gnyan rnams dang / /khri srong lha brgyud sku lha gnyan rnams kyi/ /rje btsan lha yi lha mchog gzengs bstod do/ /rgyal dbang padma'i ring lugs 'dzin rnams kyi/ /dbu 'phangs ri rgyal rtse mor gzengs: sngags 'chang bdag gis mnga' gsol gzengs bstod na/ /lha yi lha mchog lha zhal mthong bar mdzod/ /cesapa bya/ nang du log nas yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang /sogs bya/ lhag pa dang ni chad
༄༅/ /pa dang /sogs bya/ ser sna'i dbang gyur ma 'byor zhing / /mchod pa ngan zhing bshams nyes pa/ /sbyor ba gtsang sbra ma thon pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ zhesapa nas/ 6༷/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra swāhās brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med pa'i skabs yin na/ khyed kyi sems can sogs/ badzra muXye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ shisabarjod ni/ hūXltoX gar dbang gsar bris 'od mtha' yas pa chos kyi sku/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad rta mgrin longs spyod rdzogs/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /dbyer med ye shes gsum ldan bkra shos shog /sa brgyad brnyes kyang bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon tshul 'dzin gnyan gyi rigs/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i bkra shis: zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i/ gsang yum mched blon sprul pa yang sprul dang / /sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tshogs sogs/ /grangs med 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /bdud dang rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po'i rigs/ /dngos dang yid la brlag pa'i skye bo'i mtshon/ /nag po'i rtsa lag ba dan rab bsnyil te/ /dkar phyogs rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i bkra shis shog /bod skyong lha rigs dngos dang dngos 'dra ba/ /che mnyam bsod nams ldan pa ya rabs
kyi zla/ lha gnyan lngardzo mdzad nas gangs 3glengs 'dir/ /bde skyid dga' 3sten dpal 'bar bkra phranas phregag /gzhan yang bkra shisakyi tshig bcad ci rigs pa brjod cing me tog spel ma phyogs kun du bkram par bgyi'o/ pad 'byung rigs sngagasa'achang ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /sabatul bsam yas gtsug lag 'byung ba'i sgo/ /g.yung drung bon gyisabarten pa'i lha chen po/ /lugs de'i gyer bsgom gsol mchod ci yang dar/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyisapas zangs mdzod kyi/ /srung mar bka' bsgosasgrub ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /shog ser ma bu'i za ma tog 'khyil ba'i/ /tshoms pa'i rnying rgan nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /brgyud pa'i gsung sgrosaphyag len mthong thosabral/ /gab dkrugs 'bror bsdebasami shesaphyogs re'i gzhung / /klog cing rol mo brdung ba lhur len yang / /pon dkar lha gsol mkhan po'i cho ga bzhin/ /de phyir shog ser dri ngad cham chil du/ /g.yo ba'i dgosadon rig 'dzin zhal gyi lung / /bklag pas don kun 'grub pa gaṅga'i rgyun/ /kho bo'i rnam dpyod ma drosamatsho lasababs/ /'bad pasanyer bsgrubasarlung gi lhang rta yin/ /drangs pa'i bde skyid brgya phrag nyi ma'i dngos/ /legs khyab dgung la 'char nub rab spangs nas/ /rtag tu snang ba'i dga' ston dar bar shog /de'ang lha chen 'di nyid kyi mchod bskang rim pa chosargyal maṅga'i mtshan can yan chad du gsung rgyun ma gtogs khrigs chags kyi yig rigs mi snang zhing zhang sna rnam pa'i sprul pa'i sku mchog rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po chosargyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi gter gzhung dang khra tshangs pa gter gartan gsum pa'i gsung 'khrugs bsdebasasu mdzad pa khungs thub tu 'dug kyang phyag len rnams dkyusasu bkod pa sogs cung zad rtogs dka' ba nas 〈bsan 〉rang nyid bka' srung chen po 'dir mosapa'i dwangs ba'i yid drangasate mchod sprin tshangasapa
༄tsho/ /lha'i shel gyi rnga bo che'i go rim phal cher gtso bor bzung gzhan ma gter gzhung bla ma gong ma dag gisamadzad pa gsar brisarnams so sor khungs sgesalhang gcig po 〈sbyar ro 〉/[cesapa ] de nyid las du ma'i gar yin na'ang gangs can 'dir 'brel chags kyi rnam 'gyur gtso por bzung /mdor na cung zad mi gsal zhing ma tshang ba rnams tshangs ba 〈kha bskang 〉snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyisakun nas blangs te/ lha mchog rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyisa'aphrin las brgya phrag nyi ngosa'adzin pa'i snang gsal 'di ni za hor gyi sngags btsun zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyisakun dga' zhesapa shing stag hor zla bdun pa'i dkar cha'i dga' ba dang po rgyal phur gyi thog la dbu gtsugs zla ba de pa'i tshesalnga zla ba gro bzhin 'dzom pa'i 'phrod dge bar gnam bskosakyi pho brang chen po dmar po ri grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangasagrags pas bgyisapas dpal ldan lha chen tshangspasanyin mtshan dusadrug tu bsrungs zhing skyob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laX// // sde tshan 'di masprul lung rtogs khams yig ma dpe gzhir bzhag pa yin/ gzhan gyi bcosapar rtags []'di rgyab 87da/ rang nyid kyi bsam tshul la rtags 〈〉'di rgyab lngardzod/
(ya)༄tsho/ /thang lha'i phyi rten 'bul thabs legs par bzhugs so//
༄༅/ /rig 'dzin yol mo pa'i gsung thang lha'i phyi rten 'bul tshig ni/ cang shes rta mchog gser sga dngul srab can/ /sna tshogs dar zab bzang pos rab mdzes pa/ /g.yang ldan gsang lug gangs ri lta bur 'tsher/ /bag phebs dal bur 'gyu dang 'a97 ba'i stabs/ /zla shel zhun mas byugs ltar rab dkar ba'i/ /mkha' lding 'dab chags snyan pa'i skad gsang can/ /sprin dkar phung po lta bu'i lha 〈yi 〉g.yag /rdo rje'i rwa dang rnga yab dkar po can/ /kun kyang dar zab dril bu g.yer kha dang / /mu tig bzang po'i 'phreng bas rab mdzes pa/ /phyi rten mdzes pa'i 'gro tshogs 'di dag gi /lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig /thang lha'i phyi rten g.yag lug 'bul thabs/ gu ru sarba sirnyi hūXcaX rgyal kun ngo bo padma thod phreng gi /dam tshig rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyir bcings pa'i/ /ye shes lha mchog rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /
༄༅/ /'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du/ /sprin dkar pho brang dal gyi rgyu ba ltar/ /rab 'gying 'gros ldan rdo rje'i rwa mig can/ /zhol can 'bras ldan lha g.yag dkar po la/ /rnam mang dar gyi lhab lhub rgyan gyis mdzes/ /thabs mchog ting 'dzin zab mos byin brlabs te/ /'khor bcas dgyes dgur spyod pa mchod pa'i sprin/ /phyi rten mthun rdzas spyan gzigs 'bul lags na/ /lha zhal mngon mthor mdzod la dgyes pa skongs/ /sdom gsum dam tshig nyams chags so sor bshags/ /las bzhi'i phrin las rgya mtsho bsgrub pa dang / /deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin la sdong grogs mdzod/ /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /gnod byed smyo 'dre rgyal 'gong dam sri'i tshogs/ /lha chen dngos sprul g.yag rgod drag po yis/ /rab khros drag
po'i 'phrin las dus la babs/ /gnam lcags rwa rtses phug la sa gzhir brdabs/ /rdo rje'i ltes bldag lcags rmis 〈rmig 〉'bar bas brdzis/ /sha khrag rus pa chom chom zhal du gsol/ /sngon tshe dam bcas ji bzhin las mdzod cig /thub bstan e waX dge 'dun sder bcas pa/ /dbyar malham ltar 'phel thos bsam ba〉rdzom 'chad nyan/ /rnam par dkar ba'i bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyogs las rnams par rgyal ba'i bkra shis rogag /cesapa 'di yang chu glang 'on phu stag tshang mjal bar phyin skabasathang lha'i rten g.yag dkar po zhig byung na snyams te/ lam bar rta thog tu 'brog pa rnams dang 'phrosagleng zhig yongs 〈yong 〉bsalha chen nyid kyi thugs rjesabakug pa'i g.yag phrug shin tu dkar ba zhig lam gyi mdun ngosanas rwa 'khyer dang bcas khrab nyung 'dug pa'i bdag po rtsad bcad pas/ deng nub 'dug pa'i sbyin bdag de kha yin 'dug pa'i ming la yang rdo rje zer 'dug pa'i rten 'brel shugs 'byung du 'grigs par go nasaster dgosatshul smrasapas dad gusadang bcas byin byung bas de 'phral lha bsangs thog tu sku lha'i sger gsol dang bcas 'dzugs pa'i mchod 'bul tshig tu dge slong padma 'phrin las kyi sgrub thabasadang mthun par rig 'dzin mnga' risachen po'i gdan sa'abri sgang rig 'dzin pho brang du de 'phral du brisapa'o/ /
(ra)do༅/ /thang lha'i bka' gtad spyo 'dre rgod kyi 'grim shul zhesabya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ dusasnyigs ma'i skabs su rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnod pas/ srog rlung sogs rgyal gzer byung ba la/ smyon pa sogs 'dul ba la gnyan chen thang lha'i bka' gtad bya ba ste/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyisabasam yasadakor bdag 'dul ba'i phyir mdzad/ smyo 'dul rgod kyi 'grim shul zhesabya ba'i phyag len ni/ gzhi dkar po'i steng du 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ rin po che'i gtor ma gru gang ngam rkang gang mtho gang gru bzhi rtse rgyal nyi zla nor busabargyan pa bzhag phud phor du ja phud dam chang phud gtsang ma bshams/rang nyid phyag rdor bskyed la/ rgyasapar na sngon du gsol kha rgyas par btang zhing / 6༷9 ) za'i rgyal 7rdzo sa brgyad gnas pa sogs la brgya tshar ci mang gsog cing / 'di'i bsnyen pa ci mang bzlasan byin rlabasache/ de tsam long med na dbang sgrub mi dgosate/ mdun du slob ma maṇḍal khrusabyas la/ bdag nyid skad cig gis ngo bo padma 'byung gnas la rnam pa phyag na rdo rje dregs pa kun 'dul sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/
༄tshi/ /phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan/ de'i mdun du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang / rgyal 'gong gnod pa zhi ba'i phyir/ jo kro gnyen chen thang lha yi/ smyo 'du rgod kyi 'grim shul gyi/ bka' gtad bdag la stsal du gsol/ lan gsum 'don 'di'i lo rgyus zur tsam zhu na/ phyon chen po bod du byon dus/ thang lhas kha ba bu yug 'tshubs/ smug pas lam 'gags pas slob dpon phyag na rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pas/ thang lha brtul nas srog snying dang gsang mtshan phul lo/ de nas bsam yas has po rir byon dus thang lha g.yag dkar po rwa nam mkha'i mthong la ye re ba/ rmigs bzhis ru bzhi'i sa bdud non pa cig byas nas slob dpon
gyi rjes nas tshur byung ba/ khri srong lde'u btsan mthong ba dang / skyes bu bzhin bzang zur phud lngas brgyan pa gcig byas nas/ rgyal po la phyag dang phul nas/ khri srong la dga' tshul smras/ bdag dam tshig nyams pa'i srog bdud/ dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed ma/ grib gnon ma rabs kyi gnya' non/ smyo 'dre rgyal 'gong gi gnya' non lags/ zhes dang / bdag gi 'phrin las smyo 'dre 'dul zhing sdang ba'i dgra bo gsod pa lags so/ zhes sogs zhus pas/ de nas rgyal pos/ kyai slob dpon bdag rigs mtho bas rjes mi 'brang zhing gzhan la mi gnod pa/ don ye shes pa yin pas phyi ma bde gnas su 'dren nus pa/ tshul 'jig rten pa yin pas 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi thogs pa med par sgrub nus pa/ snying nye zhing dam tshig la gnas pas rje 'bangs brgyud pa dang bcas pa la 'bral med bu bzhin du skyong ba/ mthu rtsal thogs pa med pas smyo 'dre dang rgyal 'gong mngon sum du 'dul ba/ bdag chos skyong ba'i srog lha/ bcang thub pa gcig brtse bas gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/ spyir bod kyi lha srin phal cher sde brgyad gnod sbyin gdug pa can gyi rigs yin pas/ rgyal po'i sku lha mi nyan yang / lha chen po thang lha ni/ sngon sangs rgyas mang pos byin gyis brlabs cing sa la gnas shing bden pa mthong ba'i dri za'i rgyal po chen por mdo las
༄tshi/ /gsungs pa de yin pas/ gong gi yon tan ma lus pa dang ldan pas/ de nyid rgyal po'i srog lhar bsko bar bya gsungs nas/ rgyal po dang thang lha gnyis rta mgrin gyis dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur dam bsres nas/ 'od gsal lha'i gdung rgyud tha ma dgung la ma gshegs kyi bar gyi sku lha gyis lhag /rgyal pos mchod cig gsungs/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam par sprul pa/ dam can shel ging dkar po'am gnam lha byang chub/ sems dpa'/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po thor tshugs can la dri za zur phud lnga pa'am khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i bdag po sogs/ mi dang brten gnas dang sku du mar sprul nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong zhing khyad par snyigs ma'i dus su nad dang sde brgyad kun gyi sna 'dren rgyab brten rgyal po pe har gyis byas nas/ dang po lhar bsten nas tpū rgyud rgab 'drer 'brangs/ tha ma dbugs len srog bdud kyi khyer 'dre byed cing mi rabs tshun chad 'phung bar byed cing / de ni ru nga phrag dog cho 'phrul che/ khyad par skye bo kun gyi snying la zhugs nas/ brgyal nad smyo 'bogs snying rlung stod 'tshang smug tshal rgyal gzer 'brugs longs sogs kyis bod khams 'phung bar byed pa'i dus su/ de'i gnyen po ngo po ye shes kyi lha la tshul 'jig rten pa de dang mthun pa gcig gis 'dul dgos pa'i phyir/ phyon bdag gis lha chen
'di'i sgrub skor rnams bstan/ 'di mchod na rnal 'byor pa'i mgon dang srung ma byed/ sde pha chos la dkar ba rnams kyi mgon skyabs dang dgra blar 'gyur ro/ lhag par yang rje dpon rigs mtho ba kun gyi dgra blar brten na bkra shos rtags mtshan che/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas phrin las dgos 'dod yid bzhin du sgrub po/ sgrub na mi 'grub mi srid do/ 'di ni srid pa gsum gyi bdag po yin pas/ gab cing sbas nas gsang ba'i chos skyong du bstan na/ gzhan gyi dam can chos skyong pho mo kun gyi nus pa tshur 'phrog cing dam can dregs pa thams cad 'di'i bka' 'og na yod pas/ rgyal po dam la thog na blon 'bangs zhor la 'du ba dang 'dra'o/ 'on kyang 'di shin tu gnyan pas gzhan la ming tsam mi smra bar shin tu gsang zhing rab tu sbas nas bsten pa dang bla ma dang dam tshig mi nyams pa rnams ni 'di'i bka' rgya dam tshig yin no/ khyad par dam tshig tu mdze pho nal phrug sogs grib chen la 'dzem/ 'di zhus bla ma la dam tshig sel med cing / lha chen gnad gzer min pas dam ldan re re la gcig rgyud byed/ des kyang tshul bzhin brten pa las/kun la 'chol bar spel na 'khu ldog mngon sum du byed do/ de lta bu'i bka' gtad gnyan po zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul/ de nasagazhung ltar gtor mchod bran la/ gsol mchod bstod pa bskul thung yan chad byas la/ rnga rol mo bya/ gser skyems nam
༄7/ /mkha' la gtor/ de nasarnga rol bskur la/ da nge gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul du gsal/ mdun gyi thang lha 'od du zhu nas/ gtor ma dang dbyer med pa skad cig gi gtor ma/ lha chen thang lha'i ngo bo la/ rnam pa 'brong g.yag zhol chen dkar lus ni ri rab rwa gnyis ni/ thang shing brgyang tsam shin tu rno/ kha rlang na bun ltar 'thib cing / ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ gnam lcags 'chol po me ltar 'bar/ 'jigs shing ya nga'i skur gyur pa/khyod rang rnams la gnod pa yi/ dkor bdag rgyal po'i gnod byed de/ mi ring skya ba spre'u bu chung/ shin tu ring pa'i gzugs gyur pa/ steng du 'khrab brdzis nang khrol rnams/ dmar dang rdzir rdzir phyir thon pa/lcekeg 'dra'i 3)sa ldag gon lpags ༄9la/ 〈cos pa dkar dang lhang lhang de/ gastu1ba dang thul thul tshig par 〉khom (keg de nasarang nyid gsang bdag gi nga rgyal drag po byas la/ lag pa g.yon pas nad ba'i srin lag nas bzung/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pasathang lha'i gtor ma mgor bzhag nas 'don rgyu yin te/ smyo rgod yun ring mi thul na bskul btan nas sngags brjod tshe srin mdzub nas 'dzugs pa dang / gtor ma mgor bzhag bas chog gang ltar yang grwa pa yod na ro 'bu mnyams du gyer zhing rnga rol bya'o/ /sngags brjod tshe rol mo drag tu bya zhing 'dir gtor rgyag dang 'dra/ don la drag lasayin/ hūX hūX hūXltoX bzhugs yul 'dam phre(da nal nas/ zhesasogs nas/ gnod pa'i bgegs rnams thul/ rgyal 'askyusteng daX sri thul/ sdug 'dre 'bordzong po thul/ smyo 'apogs brgyal nad
thul / oX badzra kro dha na shi li mi li du dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa4༷༷ bdun dang / oX āXhūX hrīX badzra 'bar ba rtsal bighān rā dza mā ra ya phaṭa4༷༷bdun gnyisatsam brjod/ yang dmigs pa ni/ gtor ma ngo bo lha chen thang lha la/ rnam pa dung khra mkha' lding tsam/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas gzan la 'jug rgyal po bya dkar phug ron 'dra/ tshir gyis bzung nas spu btog go dung khras bsad nas zos par bsgom/ gang ltar bskul pa tshar gachig dang sngags rnamsbrjod / yang gtor ma gnam lcags sdig pa ni/ nag po lus kyis sa gzhi khyab/ rwa dang mjug ma nam mkhar gdengs/ kha nas 'od zer lcags drwa ltar/ 'phros pas dkor bdag de nang rgyud/ de nyid 'ub kyis tshur drangs nas/ snying gi dkar nag mtshams de ndasga lcags kyi mche ba btab byas nas/ lus phyed man chod khog par tshud/ de ltar bsgom zhing / yang sngon ltar bskul pa dang sngags rnams brjod/ de ltar lan gsum tshar nas/ sngon gyi slob dpon gsang bdag tu gsal bas gtor ma skad cig gis thang lha dalnga(sa su gsal ba la bka' bsgosapas de ltar bgyisaso/ zhesakhas blangs bar bsgom zhig zhesagator ma mgor bzhag pa la/ ho daskyu1ngas su garbershal/ byang chub sems dpa'i nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa/ sa brgyad non pa'i sems dpa'/ ngo kro ye shes kyi lha la/ tshul 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa/ gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'/ dam can shel ging dkar po/ tshangs pa'i
༄tshi/ /rgyal po dung gi thor tshugs can/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga'/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i bdag rgyal po gnyan chen thang lha yar zhud/ khyed sngon gyi slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar phrin las smyo ba'i 'dre 'dul ba'i khas blangs/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis smyo 'dre rgyal 'gong gi kha gnon du khyed bskos pa'i dam tshig dran par gyis/ srung bya nad pa 'di slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la skyabs zhus shing khyod la bcol ba yin pas/ nyi ma de ring phyin chad nas/ smyo 'dre rgyal 'gong gi gnod pas mi tshugs par srungs shog /skyobs shig/ oX āXhūX hrīXbadzra 'bar ba rtsal dṛ bhūX badzra rakṣa rakṣa ku ru yi swā hā:༷༷ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / sogs shisapa brjod/ 'o des thang lha smyo 'dul rgod kyi 'grim shul zhes bya ba thob pa yin pas/ de ring phyin chad phyon padma bla mar bzung / rta mgrin yi dam du bzung thang lha 'di chos skyong du bzung snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ galhum bos ji ltar bka': de nasarten khyad par can yod na de la zam par bsam/ med na gtor ma phyi rol du 'bul rgyu bskur la/ yig chen: zhesarang gnasasu gshegs par bsam / gal te rang la rgyal 'gong gisaganod pa sogs byung na/ gsol ka dang bskul pa sogs thon na legs/ ma thon yang rung ste/ rang nyid skad nyug dran rdzogs su ngo bo thang lha yin pa la/ rnam pa gong du bshad pa'i g.yag dang lcagasasdig sogs su bsgom nas/ mā ra ya zhesapa'i sngags ci
mang bzlas pas chog go/ 'di mchod pasalha rigs dman pa dang nag po'i phyogs su gtogs pa rnamasagasol mchod mi byed/ dusakyi gtor ma mi chag pa dam tshig go/ lha mchog srid gsum bdag po yi/ sgrub thabasayang gsang srog snying 'di/ nub phyogs dbang gi srung mar sbas/ gcig rgyud ming tsam ma smosarnams so/ thun mong 'tshol bar spel byed na/ sde brgyad shan pa dmar po yis/ dam med de'i srog lusaskrol lo zhesagasungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i bka' gtad srog dbang ni re zung tsam la bskur bdag mod/ bsgrub thabasaman ngag kyang de dang 'dra/ gsol kha dang gtor bsngosani de tsam mi dgosate/ g.yar kha lung rgyun ni dgosapar bya'o/ smyo 'dul gyi bka' gtad 'di la ni bka' rgya yod de/ nad pa sogs gal che ma gtogs mang po la mi bya/ zhesapa 'di ni snyigs dusargyal 'gong dang srog rlung gi nad mang du dar bas de la phan pa'i phyir/ rā ga a gsesabasgrigs pa ste / yi ge pa ni bcerdzon 'grusaso/ 'dir nyesa'agal gang mchisalha chen nyid la bshagasashing dge bas 'brel pa thob tshad lusasems bde ba dang ldan bar gyur cig maṅga lam// //
