(/snye)༄7/ /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdosabaskang mdosabazlog mdosakyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul bzhugs/
༄༅/ /sin zla'i chu lngar padma'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /snang ba mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /rab bsgyur srid gsum zil gnon thod phreng rtsal / /zhabs rdul byang chub bar du gtsug na mdzes/ /khyed las gzhan min rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /zur chen chosadabyings rang grol zhal lung bcud/ /btungs pas smra ba'i sprosapa gzengs mgro'i drin/ /bgrangs yas lusasu sprul kyang gzhal nus:/ /de phyir rang rig don gyi bla mar rgyud/ /ngesarnyed rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol bzhin du/ /lha chen rten bskang bzlog pa'i mdosakyi gzhung / /rgya 'bag yi ge'i rnam par 'phrul 'di'o/ /de yang gsang sngagasarnying ma bka' gter gyi gzhung rnams su ma mgon dregs pa sde brgyad so sor gyer sgom kyi mdosagazhung rnam grangs yid chesamang zhing / de dag kyang spyi mdosasgosasu bsngo ba/ sgosamadosaspyir bsngo ba/ pho sna mo yisadrang ba/ mo sna pho yisadrang ba'i lag len kha bsgyur mtha' klasalhang snying po rten mdosabaskang mdosabazlog mdosasogs rgya che na'ang dri za'i rgyal po 'di nyid la lha brag gter byon du mdosaskor mi gsal zhing shesabya
༄tshi/ /mtha' ma bkag pa'i gter kha gzhan dag na med ba'i ngesapa mi 'dug rung thosatshad kyi grags pa dag mngon sum du spyod yul du ma gyur la/ 'jig rten dregs pa rnamasani mdosakyi bskongs ba phan yon mchog tu che zhing dkyil 'bor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zur thams cad mkhyen pa chosadabyings rang grol gyi zhal snga nas bshad khung gzhan nas blangs te rgyu mthun sbyar ba 'thad cesagasung gisaganang ba brtsal zhing tshul 'di la lha chen gyi kyang dgyesapa'i mtshan ma mthong bas rten mdos/ bskang mdosabazlog mdosagasum gyi bcas rkyi rim pa rigs cig dang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len gyisardzogs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dang po rdzas bsogs pa dang / gnyisapa bshams pa rnams btang snyoms su bgyis/ de yang bskang mdosargyag ched chu babasasu bkod/ gzhan gnyisade la 'byin 'jug gang dgosanusapa'i dbang tu byas te/bka' brgyad phur pa zil gnon sogs zhi khro gang rung gi gzhung bsrang ba mdzab bzlas kyi bar bya/ gnas dang yo byad brlabs nas/ dpal ldan lha mchog las bstod pa yan phrin las brgya phrag nyi dngosa'adzin pa'i nang gsal bzhin btang ngo / /gsum pa mdosabyin rlabasal shes
pa rnam pa bzhi lasadang po ri rab gzhal yas su shesapa ni/ hrīX ma hā kro tarsābasangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha' rlung me chu/ sa steng 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ri rab lhun po shar shel/ lho int+ra ni le/ nub padma ra ga byang gser las grub pa/ bang rim bzhi pa/ phyi rol gyi rmang du gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ gling bzhi gling phran/ mtha' lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i nang lha mi'i 'dod yon bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar phyur pa'i ri rab kyi steng gi dbus su bhūX las man shel gyi khang bzang dzam bu gser gyi rgya phibs 'od du 'tsher ba'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog gis mtshan pa/ rin po che'i sna tshogs kyi sgo lcog 'od 'bar ba/ rtsa bar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba/ sked par 'ja' 'od na bun gyi gur phub pa/ rtse mor sprin dkar rin po che'i zil char 'bebs pa/ sa gzhi ljang sngon la me tog sna tshogs rgyas pa khor yug tu gnam lha brgyad kyi gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bus bskor ba/ shar gyi lcog beḍūrya dkar po las grub pa'i lha'i gzhal med khang rgya phibs can/ rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba'i nang du rtsi sman gyi ljon shing sogs nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gyi me tog lo 'bras myu gu grangs med pas yongs su gtams pa/ lhor dzambha chu bo'i gser sbyangs la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i khang bzang rgya phibs can/
༄tsho/ /rin po che'i ra ba gru bzhi pas khor yug tu bskor ba'i nang du rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad rin po che'i ri yongs 'dul sa brtol 'dod 'jo ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog sogs/ lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang ba/ nub tu padma ra ga'i khang bzang rgya phibs can khor yug dang bcas pa'i rwa bar 'chi med bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum bzang / mtsho rdzing / ldeng ga lu ma/ chu mig dang bcud len snying por gyur pa'i rdzas sman gyis yongs su khyab pa/ byang du drag po gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mkhar steng du rgya phibs dang khor yug tu rwa bas bskor ba'i nang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi dra bas sbrel ba/ shar lhor shel dkar gyi khang bzang rgya phibs can ra bas bskor ba'i nang du me tog nag tshal gyis gang ba / lho nub tu drag po gnam lcags kyi gzhal med khang bzang rgya phibs can ra bas bskor ba'i phyi rol tu mtshon cha'i bu yug dang nang du me rlung 'tshubs ma 'khyil ba/ nub byang du byi ru'i ba gam rgya phibs can lcags ris bskor ba'i ra bar utpal la dmar pos mtshon pas me tog dang ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i tshal gyis khor yug tu dkrigs pa/ byang shar du yid 'ong 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i nang du rin po che las grub pa'i 'chi med lha'i khang bzang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i khor yug tu lha'i skyed tshal gyis yongs su bskor ba'i/ gnyisapa dregs
pa'i gzugs brnyan gtso 'khor pho nyar shesapa ni/ dbus ma'i pho brang gi lte bar nyi zla padma'i gdan la stobs ldan rta mchog ngang dkar rin po che'i sga srab gong smad spu len ze long gi khebs sogs rgyan du mas mdzes pas spras pa'i steng na oX badzra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li swā hā:༷༷ las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam par sprul pa rnam pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i gtso bo mtshan drug rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la dam can shel ging dkar po/ lha gnam the dkar po/ gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'/ tshangs pa'i rgyal po dung gi thor tshugs can/ dri za'i zur phud lnga pa/ khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i rgyal po zhes bya ba srung ma lha chen po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog shel gyi ri bo la ston mtshan zla bas 'khyud pa ltar dkar la brjid pa zhal 'dzum zhing mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum rab tu bkra ba/ dbu skra gnag snum gyi thor tshugs dar dkar pos bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu 'bar bas spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa'i sba lcags nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon pa shel dkar gyi phreng ba thugs ga'i thad du 'dren pa/ zab chen dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi tse ber dang yug gyin gsol ba/ ber nang ma gnyis la rin po che'i rnam mang gis spud pa'i gser sked
༄༅/ /bcings shing rin po che'i gser pad la g.yu'i phra tshom gyis mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gser ga se mo do/ do shal/ gdu bu sogs rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong utpala'i chun po dang dar dpyangs can/ sku gzhon zhing mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis nor bu'i mchil lhum gyon nas rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du bde ba skyod ba'i dbang mo yid 'ong mdangs ldan gyi yum gnam mtsho'i rgyal mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma sku mdog sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ g.yas rgyal 'tshan dang g.yon me long 'dzin cing dbu skra thor tshugs lhag ma'i zar bu thur du 'phyang ba/ sman btsun mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad kyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i rnam pa can g.yu 'brug la bcibs pa/ gtso po'i steng gi nam mkhar ma rungs log 'dren klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i gnyan por ngo bo ye shes lha sprul pa'i rnam pa khyung nag dbu dgu pa zhal gdangs shing kyim kyim spring kring gi sgra sgrog pa/ phyag gnyis kyis sa bdag klu gnyan sbrul gyi rnam pa can bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ gnam lcags me'i mchu sder dang spu gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa can/ dmigs pa'i sa gnyan bkab cing nam mkhar lding ba dang / gtso bo'i mtha' bskor du mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren skyes bu g.yu'i smin ma can/
g.yon gyi ru 'dren khyi'u chung g.yu yi zur phud can/ mdun gyi ru 'dren mi dkar g.yu'i thor cog can/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa ste so sor bye brag dang bcas pas bskor ba/ shar gyi gzhal med khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na zhi mdzad rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dkar po g.yas sman gyi ljon shing thugs ka dang g.yon bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum pa 'dzin cing / zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par sman lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lho'i khang bzang gi dbus su pad zla dang ne'u le dmar ser gyi gdan la rgyas byed kyi rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas nor bu 'bar ba thugs ka dang g.yon rin po che'i sgrom bu pus steng du 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub kyi ba gam gyi nang du pad zla'i gdan la dbang gi lha rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na padma ra ga'i tshe bum 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan rdo rje'i dbyibs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa tshe lha rig 'dzin drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang gi lcags mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus su padma nyi ma dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol pa'i gdan la garma las kyi khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog nag la khros pa/ mig rtsa dmar
༄tshi/ /zhing mche ba gtsigs pa ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzis shing rin po che'i rgyan rnams dang dug sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rtse ber dmar nag brtsegs pa'i nang ma gser sked can/ g.yas mdung dmar dang g.yon lcags kyi mda' gzhu 'dzin pa rin po che'i hor lhum gyon nas rta mchog bra nag rlung shugs can la brtsibs shing me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par mnga' bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs kyis bskor ba/ shar lho'i khang bzang gi nang du pad zla'i gdan la lha chen gzhon nu skyes bu bzhin bzang kha dog dkar ba dbu skra g.yu'i zur phud can/ dung so khor mor yod pa g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon khu tshur dkur brten pa/ dar dkar gyi la'u gsol zhing zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par rang 'dra'i lha phrug du mas bskor ba/ lho nub kyi gzhal med khang gi dbus su gnod byed dmigs bya'i steng na skye 'gro'i srog shigs smyo 'dre srin po 'dul ba'i gnyen por lha chen gyi ngo bo rnam pa 'brong g.yag zhol can dkar po 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ rwa gnyis thang shing brkyangs pa tsam la shin tu rno ba/ kha rlang na bun ltar 'thibs shing ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ gnam lcags kyi rmig pa me ltar 'bar bas rgyal 'gong daX sri 'dam ltar brdzis shing rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag med 'gyed pa/ nub byang gi byi ru'i ba gam gyi nang du pad nyi'i gdan la rlung sems las rlung gi
lha dpa' bo rdo rdze 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar la 'tsher ba/ padma dmar po'i phrag rgyan can/ g.yas lcags kyus bsgrub bya'i snying nas 'gugs shing g.yon zhags pas mgul nas 'chings ba/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs par 'gugs byed dbang gi pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang shar gyi 'chi med lha'i khang bzang gi dbus su rin po che'i khri padma zla nyi dgra bgegs pho mo'i dan la lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po sku mdog dmar ser mche ba gtsigs shing og tshoms dang smin ma glog stong ltar 'khyug pa/ dbu skra li khri'i mdog can thor tshugs kyi rtser skye ba lta ba'i lnga pa'i dung sum tshom gyi steng du nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa/g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong thur du bskor ba/ stag lpags kyi sked dkris dang sbrul gyi do shal gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs nas me 'od klong na bzhugs pa tshangs ris lha'i 'khor tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba/ zhi rgyas dbang 'gugs tshangs pa sde lnga ga'ang / spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhi ma khro'i nyams can dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs dang srog zhu sogs rin po che'i rgyan/ snyan gong utpal dang dar gyi cod pan 'phyangs ba/ nang kha dog sna tshogs dang phyi rang mdog dang mthun pa'i tse ber nyis brtsegs gsol ba'i nang ma la gser sked
༄tshi/ /bcings pa/ rin po che'i hor lham gsol zhing sku las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pa'o// sku'i rnam par sprul pa dgur bstan pa de dag gi g.yas phyogs su ngo bo ye shes kyi lha la rnam pa dung khra dkar pos bar snang rlabs kyis bcad de byur 'dre 'byung po phug ron 'dra ba'i rjes shul bsnyegs te sha khrag rus pa za ba/ rgyab tu lcags sdig nag po lus sa gzhi khyab cing rwa dang mjug ma nam mkhar gdengs nas 'od zer lcags kyi dra bar sgrab 'dre phyir 'bar ste snying khrag 'byin pa/ g.yon du sprul pa'i dung spyang pho mo glog ltar 'khyug cing spu gri'i mche bas dgra bgegs 'begs shing lcags kyi sder mos sa gzhi 'drad pa/mjug ma brdab pas me rlung 'tshubs pa/ bang rim gnyis par lha dang / klu gnyan bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i cha lugs su 'jigs shing dpa' ba/kun kyang nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ gsum pa thun rdzasayasaglud stag glud dang skongs su shesapa ni/ raX las ye shes kyi mes dngos po'i skyon rnams bsregs/ yaX las chos nyid kyi rlung gis dngos po'i skyon rnams sbyangs khaX las mtshan med kyi chus dngos po'i skyon rnams bkrus/ oX gyis phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod rnams dang ldan par byas / ā las sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon rnams yongs su bkang ste 'dzad pa
med pa nam mkha'i mdzod du spel/ hūX gis rmad du byung ba'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ swās gzugs brnyan thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad phung khams skye mched dang ldan/ hās dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis thugs dam gnyan po yongs su skong ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par gyur/ oX āXhūX sbaX paX traX ratna pre lokya phaṭa4༷༷ bzhi pa thun rdzasamatshon char shespa ni/ mda' mdung ral gri gser 'khor sogs phyag mtshan gyi rdzas rnams gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog ltar gyur nas gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du brlag ste tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/sngagasadrug phyag drug gisaphrin las ltar byin gyi brlabs/ bzhi pa spyan drangasazhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sposaskor rol mo g.yab dar dang bcas la/ ye ro|sa gzhal yas ma nas/ sa ma ya dza dzaX'i bar brjod/ hūX dus ga༄rgyam sangs rgyas padma sam bha wa/ /gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rgod ldem sogs/ /rtsabargyud bla ma'i spyan sngar bstan skyong bar/ /zhal bzhes lha mchog chen po spyan 'dren no/ /phun tshogs 'chi med bdag po'i pho brang dang / /lha brgyad gangs kyi bskor ba'i gzhal med khang / /ngo mtshar bkod legs zhing khams grangs med nas/ /sna tshogs phrin las bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren no/ /dam can shel ging dkar po spyan 'dren no/ /gnam lha byang chub sems dpa'
༄tshi/ /spyan: / tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs: /dri za zur phud lnga pa: /khyab 'jug gnam mtsho'i rgyal po: /gsang yum rdo rje g.yu sgron: /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu spyan 'dren no/ /rnam 'gyur sprul pa'i tshogs rnams: /dbu dgu mkha' lding dbang po: /yang sprul dung khra dkar po: /rab 'jigs lcags sdig nag po spyan 'dren no/ /glog ltar 'khyug pa'i dung spyang = /lha klu gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad kyi/ /dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa: /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /sku gcig mtshan drug rnam 'gyur brgyad ston pa/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /sngon gyi dam dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /dgyes pa'i rten la gnyis su med par bzhugs/ /oX badzra thang ka ra sa pa ri wa ra dza hūX baX hoX padma ka ma la ya staX/ lnga pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ nga ni dbang chen he ru ka /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /de bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /ming sring bzhin du dam bsres pa'i/ /dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi mchog /pañtsa amṛ ta sbyar te/ /tshangs pa dri za'i rgyal po che/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron sprul 'ber bcas/ /khro wo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis/ /lce la bdud rtsi bzhag nas ni/ /sngon tshe ji srid mna' bor bzhin/ /nga
yang dam las mi 'da'o/ khyed rnams dam las ma 'da' zhig /gal te dam las khyod 'da' na/ /khro kro rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis/ /snying khrag bzhes te 'thung bar byed/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /badzra yakṣa hūX hūX/ drug pa mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūX g.ya' gangs rgyun 'bab arghaX yerdzon chab sgreng / /thang dang chu skyes me tog phang phung g.yo/ /dri zhim ngad ldan bdug sbos lang 'ordzong 'khrigs / / snod bcud kun gsal sgron me tshar du dwangs/ /ga bur tsan dan chus sbran byug pa'i rdzas/ /ro bda' lha yi zhal zas phyur bur spungs/ /pi waX rdza rnga sil snyan gling bu'i sgra/ /gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan ba dan lda ldi sogs/ /yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phyes nas/ /bod skyong mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sku yi lha/ /dri za'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul oX badzra thang ka ra sa pā ri wa ra arghaX puṣṭi sogs mchod/ sman mchod dang gtor ma phrin las ltar bsngo'o// bdun pa dbang du bsdu ba ni/ rang nyid khro bo'i bskyed rim gsal ba'i nga rgyal bskyed/ /nga ni che mchog he ru ka /nga ni padma dbang chen yin/ /sku ni ri rab bas kyang che/ /gsung gi hūX sgra 'brug ltar sgrog /shangs nas bskal pa'i 'thor rlung 'tshubs/ /mig nas me yi phung po 'bar/ /smin ma khro gnyer rba rlabs 'khrugs/ /ral pa kham nag srid rtser 'bar/ /
༄tshi/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrug /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / khro rgyal thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /gzi brjid phyogs bcur me ltar 'bar/ /bskal pa'i me yi klong dkyil na/ /dregs pa ma lus las la 'khor/ /khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /'jig rten khams kun g.yo 'gul byed/ /dam las 'da' ba'i snying khrag 'thung / /bdud dang 'ordzog badren zhabs kyis gnon/ /dam can ma lus srog las gzer/ /dbang gi rgyal po las 'tshol gyi/ /nga yi bka' las gang 'da' ba/ /lus sems rdul du brlag par byed/ /de bas dam can ma lus pa/ /gong gong chung chung dam la 'du/ oX āXhūX swā hā:༷༷ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka ya manta ka padma kro dhi shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ ka la ru pa badzra yakṣa kro dha/ padma banta ma ka ā garsha ya/ a garsha ya/ banta ya banta ya/ to sha ya to sha ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ shri ma hā kā la sarba ru pa/ badzra sarba daṣṭha sarba ṭa zhi ni hri dha ya/ ha ha hi hi/ e a ra lam̐ hūX dzaX zhesabargya rtsa sogs ci rigs pa bzlas/ brgyad pa mdosakyi rabs dang yas kyi cho 'brang bden pa ni/ raka'i gter byon gyisabastod mchod len/ dgu pa mdosabasngo zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hāX 'byung ba rim brtsegs nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor steng / /shar phyogs man shel int+ra nī la lho/ /nub ngos padma rwa ga byang gser las/ /legs grub bang rim bzhi ldan ri rab
steng sna tshogs rin chen khang bzang lcog brgyad mdzes/ /rgya phibs nor bu'i tog can drwa ba dang / /drwa phyed dril g.yor dar dpyangs rin chen brgyan/ /yongs 'dul sa brtol srog shing brtan pa'i rtser/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra gdugs dang khyung tshang brtsigs/ /rked par nyi zla rtsa bar gser gyi ri/ /rol mtsho bdun dang gling bzhi gling phran mthar/ /lcags ris legs bskor bzhugs gnas pho brang che/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal rnam 'phrul gsang ba'i yum/ /mched sprul pho nya bka' sdod rgya mtsho rnams/ /rten 'dir brtan bzhugs mchod pa'i tshogs bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod/ /nam mkha' khro po bya dkar sgro phud tsan/ /sgro yugs bal tshon gyis spras rgyang bu spel/ /yul mkhar pho gdong mo gdong sde brgyad kyi/ /byad rbod gnod byed ma lus bzlog pas khram/ /thabs shes zung 'jug mda' khra 'phang khra bsnol/ /yid tshe srog dbugs phung khams skye mched dbang / /gos rgyan ldan pa mi las dga' ba'i glud/ /bzhos chang ril bu mtheb kyus bskor ba 'di/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal rnam 'phrul gsang ba'i yum/ /mched sprul pho nya 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor 'bul/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skongs gyur nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag ma lus grub par mdzod/ /mchod yon g.ya' gangs skyems chu shel snod bskyil/ /lha mi'i me tog 'dab rgyas
༄tsho/ /ze'u 'bru rgod/ /shing sman bsangs dud na bun bzhin du 'khrigs/ /nyi zla rtsi 'bru'i mar mes phyogs kun gsal/ /ga bur gu gul 'dag chal byug pa'i dri/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum zan sbyar ro brgya'i bzhos dkar dung dung chen gling bu rnga bo che/ /sbug sil dril bu g.yer kha rol mo'i sgra/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal rnam 'phrul gsang ba'i yum/ /mched sprul pho nya 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor 'bul/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skongs gyur nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las mdzod/ /'dod yon lnga ldan snyed phra zlos gar bsgyur/ /thogs med gser 'khor nor bu bsam dgu 'grub/ /bde stong btsun mo gru 'dzin khyim gyi bdag / stobs ldan ba glang cang shes rlung gshog rta/ /dgra 'joms dmag dpon nor bu'i tog 'dzin gdugs/ /gser nya gter gyi bum bzang padma dkar/ /g.yas 'khyil dung dkar 'khor lo dpal belnga /rgyal mtshan ba dan rnga g.yab lda ldi 'phan/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal: /mched sprul: /thugs dam gnyan po: /zhi rgyas: /thor tshugs g.yas 'khyil sum stong nor bus spud/ /dar chings cod pan utpal chun po ldem/ /rin chen srog zhu snyan cha mgul rgyan dang / /gdu bu do shal gser ga se mo do/ /gser sked kha dog sna tshogs rtse ber gos/ /yug gyon hor lham pad phreng stag sham sbrul/ /chas mdzes ngang dkar rta mchog g.yu
'brug dang / /ne'u le rta nag padma nyi zla'i gdan/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal: /mched sprul: /thugs dam: /zhi rgyas: /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i sba lcag shel dkar phreng / /chu srin rgyal mtshan me long srid gsum gsal/ /sman gyi ljon pa bum pa bdud rtsis gtams/ /rab 'bar nor bu rin chen gyis bkang sgrom/ /'chi med tshe bum gnam lcags mda' dang gzhu/ /mdung rnon utpal las mtshan lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa rno ngar ral gri gser sbyangs kyi/ /'bor lo rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan sogs/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal: /mched sprul: /thugs dam = /zhi rgyas: /sga chas rag spras rta mchog ngang pa dkar/ /'brong dkar dbang sngon rwa gdengs dar snas brgyan/ /beeḍūrya 'dra'i rwa 'khyil lug dkar mdzes/ /khyung ltar lding ba'i rgya khra 'phur zhing rgyug /'dzad med 'o ma'i rgyun snyel zhol mo dang / /bsam pa'i re skongs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba mi bzad khur chen 'degs pa'i gnyis 'thung ba/ /rab dkar ma he 'dab chags rgyal po khyung / /rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal: /mched sprul: /thugs dam = /zhi rgyas: /khrung khrung go bo bya nag skyung ka rgod/ /rma bya ne'u mmu 'dab chags pu shud 'ug pa glag /khyim bya 'ol ba gong mo ngang ngur dang / /seng stag gzig gung dom dred wa spyang gsal/ /ce spyang 'phar ba spra sprel byi la khyi/ /sha ba dgo ba gnyan gtsod gla ba rgya/ /ri bong gna' ba ru ru
༄tshi/ /bse ru thung / /sar 'dzul gnam 'phur ri dwags 'phyo dgu'i tshogs/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal: /mched sprul: /thugs dam = /zhi rgyas: /sbal sbrul nya lcong rta bla sdom sdig sogs/ /klu gnyan sa bdag chags pa'i srog ldan rigs/ /rta dang dre'u bong bu rnga mong g.yag /mi bzad dkor nor khur gyis rab tu lci/ /rten gtor rgyun gtor bskang gtor amṛ ta/ /phrum thud phye mar khur ba shing tog tshogs/ /'bru sna ja chang dkar gsum mngar gsum tshogs/ /lug sha mgo 'byar dkar mo lag g.yas rten/ /rdo rje 'bar rtsal: /mched sprul = /thugs dam = /zhi rgyas: /khrab chen gos gsham mgo chas brjid pa'i rmog /sprir phub zhol btags lcags bzhibs btsan pa'i go /mda' mdung rtse gsum dgra stu gri gug gri/ /khri sgrogs dpag chen la sogs rdo rje'i mtshon/ /tsan ldan ga bur se 'bru a ka 〈sna /bzang drug sman sna btsod zhun ram skag mtshal za 'og dar ras snam phrug sogs pa'i rigs/ /lha dang mi yi rin chen sna tshogs rigs/ /rdo rje 'bar = /mched sprul = /thugs dam = /zhi rgyas: phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūX lha khyod sbrul dkar gzugs kyis mtho 'tshams tshe/ /pad 'byung gzi byin ma bzod khye'u gzugs/ /bstan nas srog gi snying po phul ba na/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje mchog rab rtsal du btags/ /has po ri'i mdun g.yu yi zur phud can/ /rnam par
bstan tshe bod skyong rgyal po'i gdung / /rdzogs min sku lha gnyan po byed do zhes/ /slob dpon spyan sngar dam bcas mdzad min nam/ /gter ston chen po dngos grub rgyal mtshan la/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang chos dbyings rang grol bar/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rim par byon rnams la/ /zhal bzhes dam tshig gnyan po ma g.yel dgongs/ /'gro la phan bde 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan/ /mdo rgyud lung dang mngon par rtogs pa las/ /'chad nyan dam don bsam sgom sde rnams kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /khri srong lde'u btsan rjes su brtse ba'i yul/ /bod 'bangs ngo tsha khrel ldan bzang spyod kyis/ /legs skyong sa dbang rgyal po'i mnga' thang dang / /sku tshe mtshan rgyus chab srid 'phel bar mdzod/ /gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /nad yems skya pham mu ge g.yul 'khrug sogs/ /mi mthun nyes pa'i dri ma ma lus pa/ /byin rlabs mtho ris chu bos dag par mdzod/ /tshe yang ring gnas mi phyugs rigs brgyud dar/ /sman rnams nus 'phel bzlas brjod mthu che zhing / /brlags spyod med par phan tshun mnyes gshin pa/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /'byung bzhi khod snyoms lo tog dus su smin/ /mtha' bzhi'i las rnams ma lus yongs su 'dud/ /tshong dang khe spogs don grub 'byor pa dang / /ci bder spyod pa'i
༄༅/ /dga' ston la sbyor mdzod/ /khyad par log smon mthu brtsan sa bon tshogs/ /lha min phung sri'i gsher gyis bskyed pa'i 'bras/ /byur chu smra mchu 'thibs po dpung pa'i sman/ /drag rtsal nyi ma'i 'od kyis sangs par mdzod/ /stod smad mtha' dmag sdang ba'i sems ldan pas/ /drag shul brtsom pa'i rje blon mngags gzhugs sde/ /sgo gsum spa bkong mnga' thang tshe srog rnams/ /rdul phran lta bur rlog pa'i phrin las mdzod yang sgos bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor la/ /gnod byed phyi rol mu stegs sbyor ngan mda'/ /bar pa drang srong bram ze dmod pa'i mtshon/ /nang pa sangs rgyas bden mthus phyir bzlog mdzod/ /sngon bsags 'phral gyi spyod lam ma dag pas/ /'phog dang las kyi dbang gi rang bzhin gyis/ /lha srin sde brgyad za kha zug pa yi/ /nyer 'tshe'i bar gcod ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bgegs kyi rigs/ /sum brgya drug cu'i ma rungs gdug pa'i gdon/ /mtshan dang ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang / /sum brgya drug cu'i ye 'grogs bzlog par mdzod/ /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lngas rnam 'tshe ba/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi zug rngu dang / /dus min rkyen gyis 'chi ba rnam pa brgyad/ /gshis ngan 'gums pa bco lnga zhi bar mdzod/ /lo zla zhag dus keg dang sri ngan sogs/ /dngos nyams rmi ltas mo pra ngan
babs pa/ /dug mtshon bshams pa'i mi dang mi min gyi/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /khyad par rgyal bsen 'gong po spun dgu'i rigs/ /chos byed las mtha' log pas dam sri rtswa /skyes nas 'gro mang 'phung ba'i bya ba la/ /zhugs pa'i ma rungs mtha' dag rdul du rlog /khyod nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsten gnyer gtad pa/ /dmigs yul bsrung byar gyur pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /lus dang nad dang rims kyis mi 'tshe zhing / /lcags srog rdo rje'i sra dbus bsdam par mdzod/ /lo brgyar 'tsho ba'i tshe yi dngos grub dang / /rnam thos bur 'gran bsod nams mnga' thang rgyas/ /ci bsam 'grub pa'i rlung rta'i dar po che/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'phyar bar mdzod/ /khams gsum gnas so lcog gi gtsug gtor ngos/ /rkang sen zla ba tshes pas nyer brgyan te/ /'bangs su bkol nas ji ltar bsgo ba'i las/ /thogs pa med pa lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /gtan mdun dkar po dam pa'i chos sgrub par/ /yid srubs mda' yis 'tshe bar mi nus shing / /mthun rkyen kun tshang lung rtogs yon tan gyis/ /rang gzhan don rnams 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na deng nas byang chen ma thob par/ /lha mchog rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal khyod kyis/ /nyin mtshan dus drug mel tshe rab mdzad de/ /bsam pa'i don kun thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ gzhan yang / padma
no༅༅/ /21da phreng rgyal ba'i spyan snga 〈sdo zhesasogs bya/ bcu pa bstod pa/ chosadabyings ma dang / bskul ba 'dam shod snar mo dang gnasabargyad ma gtong / bcu gcig pa 'bul ba ni/ thog tu mdosagator ste bso sgran byin gyisabarlabs la/ ye gonas gzhal yas mas spyan drangs shing mchod gtor 'bul ba las/ g.yas 〈co ri rgyal bkra bzang rtser/ zhesasogs kyi mdosazhal phyir bsgyur zhing gtong / mnga' gsol byed na nang du log nas/ bcu gnyisapa mjug chog dkyusabazhin no// zhag sbrel byed na thun gtor gyi rjesasu mnga' gsol/ bsam pa lhun grub la sogs smon lam ci rigs pa bya/ bskang mdosabasdusapa byed na sku rten sogs dar ba'i lag len bcasabashams te phrin las kyi bstod pa/ lha yi lha mchog ma sogs mtshams byin rlabasashesapa bzhi'i gnyisador/ sngagasadrug phyag drug gisabyin gyisabarlabs/ mdosabasngo ba dang phrin bcol gyi rjesasu bstod pa chos dbyings ma nas yang khong du mdosabategs pa sogs/ mjug chog rnams sngar ltar ro// rten mdosadu byed na phrin las kyi sman gtor byin rlabasaman dkyusaltar la mdosabarlabs pa nasabaka' bsgo'i rjesasu phrin las kyi dam bsgrags nas/ ji ltar mnyam par gzhag pas thugs dam yan bya/ de nasamadosagazhung gi che ba nga rgyal bskyed pa nas mdorsā'abul ba'i bar gtong / de yang brtan dusasho lo ka gcig po'i tshab/ 17 rje 'bar rtsal rnam 'phrul gsang ba'i yum/ mched sprul 21 nya bka' 3sted rgya mtsho rnams/ rten 'dir brtan bzhugs ma〉rdzod pa'i lhunags bzhes la/ bakhyerdzol pa'i phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzangod/ cesabasgyur phrin las bcol ba nas bskul gyi bar bskang mdosaltar dang thun gtor mnga' gsol mjug chog bar 'dra/ zhag
grangasasu byed kyang 'khri bsnon med/ bzlog mdosasu byed na thog mar sngags pa bdag nyid ber thod kha g.yu kha gser sogs kyi chas su bzhugs/ 'bru sna bre bcu gsum gyi steng du bsangs phye la mda' dar rin po che'i btagasapa btsugs/ rgya phor dang dngul skyogs gser skyems kyisabakang /sngagasadrug phyag drug gi byin gyisabarlabs nas mgron rnam pa bzhi la mchod pa phud skongs gtong zhing khrigs chog gang rung gi gzhung bsrangs ba bas khor yug gnam lha brgyad kyi gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten lta busabaskor ba yan mdosagazhung ltar la/ shar du yid rngo(nga 'ja' gur 'khrigs pa'i nang du rin po che las grub pa'i 'chi med lha'i khang bzang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i khor yug tu lha'i skyed tshal gyis yongs su bskor ba/ lhor drag po gnam lcags kyi gzhal med khang rgya phibs can ra bas bskor ba'i/ phyi rol tu mtshon cha'i bu yug dang nang du me rlung 'tshubs ma 'khyil ba/ nub tu byi ru'i ba gam rgya phibs can lcags ris bskor ba'i ra bar utpal dmar pos mtshan pa'i me tog dang ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i tshal gyis khor yug tu dkrigs pa/ byang du drag po gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mkhar steng du rgya phibs dang khor yug tu ra bas bskor ba'i nang mtshon cha sna tshogs dra bas sbrel ba/ dbus ma'i pho brang gi lte bar nyi zla padma'i gdan la zhesapa nas/ rgyab ru 'dren lcags kyi mi sngon 'jigs pa ste so so brgya phrag dang bcas pas bskor ba/ shar gyi 'chi med lha'i khang bzang gi dbus su rin po che'i khri padma nyi zla dgra bgegs pho
༄tshi/ /mo'i gdan la lha mchog srid gsum gyi bdag po sku mdog dmar ser mche ba gtsigs shing ag tshom dang smin ma glog stong ltar 'khyug pa dbu skra laṃ khri'i mdog can thor tshugs kyi rtser skye ba lta bu'i dung sum tshom gyi steng du nor bu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong du bskor ba/ stag lpags kyi sked dkris dang sbrul gyi do shal gsol ba/zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs nas me 'od klong na bzhugs pa tshangs ris lha'i 'khor tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba/ lho'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su gnod byed dmigs bya rnams kyi steng na skye 'gro'i srog gshed smyo 'dre srin po 'dul ba'i gnyen por lha chen gyi ngo bo rnam pa 'brong g.yag zhol can dkar po 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ rwa gnyis thang shing brgyangs pa tsam shin tu rno ba/ kha rlangs na bun ltar 'thibs shing ngur sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ gnam lcags rmig pa me ltar 'bar bas rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dam ltar brdzis shing rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa dpag med 'gyed pa/ nub kyi byi ru'i ba gam gyi nang du pad nyi'i gdan la rlung sems las rlung gi lha dpa' bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog dmar la 'tsher ba/ padma dmar po'i phreng rgyan can g.yas lcags kyus sgrub bya'i snying nas 'gugs shing g.yon zhags pas mgul nas 'ching
ba zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs par 'gugs byed dbang gi pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang gi lcags mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus su padma nyi ma dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la garma las kyi khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sku mdog nag la khros pa mig rtsa dmar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing rin po che'i rgyan rnams dang dug sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rtse ber dmar nag brtsegs pa'i nang ma gser sked can/ g.yas mdung dmar dang g.yon lcags kyi mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i hor lhum gyon nas rta mchog bra nag rlung shugs can la bcibs shing me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par mnga' bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs kyis bskor ba/ tshangs pa dang 'gugs pa ste gnyis ga'ang spyan gsum dang ldan cing zhesapa dang / mdosabasngo ba'i bar bskang mdosabazhin bag ngo mdorsāskongs sham bu bsgyur lugs/ rdo rje 'bar rtsal sprul yum 'bor dang bcas/ mdos mchod 'di bzhes bdag sogs rgyu sbyor gyi/ nad gdon bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ dgra bgegs steng du bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod/ cesabasgyur bar rigs 'dres/bzhos chang ril bu mtheb skyus bskor ba 'di/ rdo rje 'bar rtsal: mdos mchod 'di bzhes: nad gdon bar chad mi mthun: dgra bgegs steng du bzlog bsgyur: cesapa'i mjug tu/ mtshon cha sna tshogs rdzas kyis ngar
༄tshi/ /btags pa'i/ 'bru nag rjen btags bshos bu zur gsum pa/ dmar gyi gtor zor gang bzang mtsho yis brgyan/ dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bu yug lta bur 'tshubs/ lcags ri'i steng na drag po'i shing gi rtsang dmar nag stod nas 'brug sgras stong gsum 'geng / smad nas glog stong dmar po khyugs se khyug sked par gnam lcags thog ser 'khrug pa 'di/ rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal: mdos mchod: nad gdon: dgra bgegs :zhesamajug pa khyad par ri/ phrin las bcol ba'i le tshan gyi mjug tu bzlog bsgyur ni/ hūX rngam brjid gtum drag rol pa'i pho brang na/ padma nyi zla ngang dkar rta yi steng / lha yi lha mchog rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs ma bdun las la 'gyed/ gtsug na khyung chen sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul/ bdud lngardzo'i gtso ngedzi gsang yum gnam mtsho'i rgyal/ sum brgya drug cu'i mched 'khosar las la rngam/ ru bzhi'i dmag tshogs mdos zor mthu dpung bskyed/ chags che'i nad rims dug mtshon dmag gi tshogs/ ban bon mthu byad steng 'og bar gsum gdon/ khyad par rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnod pa kun/ dgra bgegs steng du bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod/ shar phyogs lha yi khang bzang chen po na/ padma zla nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng / srid gsum zil gnon tshangs pa rgyal po che/ bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung gi thor gtsug can/ rno ngar ral gris
dgra bgegs yan lag gtubs/ rtsibs stong gser 'khor mgo lus tshal par gshags/ lha yi dmag dpung bye ba pho nyar 'gyed/ bka' nyan las byed mdos zor mthu dpung bskyed/ chags cha'i nad rims dug mtsho: ban bon mthu byad steng 'og bar: khyad par rgyal 'gong dam sri'izo dgra bgegs steng du bzlog bsgyur: lho phyogs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal med nang / mtshon cha me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus shed na/sprul pa lha yi 'brong g.yag gangs ri'i mdog dbang sngon mdangs 'dzin rwa rtse mkha' la bsnyegs/ dug gi kha rlangs na bun lta bur 'thul/ me 'bar rmig pas 'byung po 'dam bzhin brdzis/ grangs med g.yag rgod mdos zor mthu dpung bskyed/ chags che: ban bon :khyar par cadagra bgegs :nub phyogs rab dmar byi ru'i ba gam nang / padma nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan stengs du/ rlung sems las rung dpa' bo 'bar ba rtsal/ khro chags nyams ldan g.yas pa'i lcags kyu yis/ dgra bgegs snying nas rang dbang med par 'dren/ g.yon pa'i zhags pas yan lag bcings nas 'gugs/ rang 'dra'i sprul pa stong gsum khyab par spro / mngags gzhug las mkhan mdos zor mthu dpung bskyed/ chag che za ban bon: khyad par zo dgra bgegs :byang phyogs 'jigs rung lcags mkhar 'bar ba'i nang / pad nyi dgra bgegs bra nag rta yi steng /
༄tshi/ /drag po garma rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ lcags gzhur lcags kyi mda' bkang dgra snying 'bigs/ mdung rnon log 'dren lnga phung tshogs la bsnun/ sprul pa'i pho nya srin po'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ grangs med bla tshe sha khrag srog la rngams/ lha srin dmag tshogs mdos zor mthu dpung bskyed/ chag che: ban bon: khyad par zo dgra bgegs: /dung khrag dkar po nam mkha'i dbyings su bshur/ /lcags sdig yan lag rwa mjug phyogs bcur khyab/ /dung spyang mcho gtsigs sa la glog ltar 'khyug /lha klu gnod sbyin rtsub 'gyur drag shul ston/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad bgrang yas pa/ /sna tshogs mtshon 'dzin gtum khros mi sdug bzhin/ /'gugs 'chings bswo sgra 'brug sgra lta bur ldir/ /bka' nyan shan pa mdos zor mthu dpung bskyed/ /chag che: /ban bon: /khyar par: /dgra bgegs: /bhyo lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /skyin mthing rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / / rnam sprul sprul pa yang sprul dang / /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho yis/ /gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing bar du gcod pa yi/ /ltas ngan brgya cu rtsa gcig bzlog /ye 'grogs sum rgya drug cu bzlogaza /glo bur bdun rgya nyi shuza bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu: gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad: keg chen sum rgya drug cu: lha chen drag po'i gdug
rtsubacu lha ma yin gyi rgyu stabs: mgon po'i par bu bskor bcu gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor bcas pa: drang srong bram ze'i dmod paza gza' yi zhing gang 'phen paza btsan nad gzer kha gtong bza sa bdag klu yi mdze nadangupe dkar rgyal po'i cho 'phrul: 'gong po spun dgu'i gnod pa: 'dre ngan dam sri'i bar chod: ban rde 'bum bskor byed pa: sngags pa'i sngags zor 'phen pa: bon gyi btso dmar 'phen pa: mu stegs ngan sngags byed pa:byad phur rbod gtong byung bzo mnan gtad sreg 'phang byas pa: snga zhags mda' ltar 'phen pa: phyi zhags dug ltar mthul bzo yas kyi bdud du gaskurdzos pa: mas kyi sri ru langs pa: pha tshan nang gi rgya 'drecha ma tshan nang gi dug 'dreca mo btab mo ru ngan palnga rtsis byas rde'u ngan (5 khyim gang mi yi nad 'dreca sgo gang nor gyi god 'dreca ban bon sngags pa'i zor khadzdza mgon pos sbyin sreg byed paza ma mo'i thun zor 'phen pa2 yungs dkar khro bo'i rbab zor: ban rde yongs kyi sngags byad: dbang phyug chen po'i par bu: klu bdud nag po'i gtad khram: bon po yongs kyi lta chad: bal po'i ngan sngags sbyor ba: rgya gar chos kyi mthu byad: mar pas phra men gtong ba: sum pa'i glang dmar rmo ba: mi nyag 'bo le thams cad: bod kyi rbod gtong byed pa: bram ze'i sngags rgod dmod pa: dri za'i smyos shing 'thibs pa: rgyal pos smyosa'abog gtong bza srin pos shod kha gtong
༄tshi/ /bzo bdud kyis khram la btab pa: btsan gyis zhags pa 'phen pas: gnod sbyin rtsis la 'debs pa: 'byung pos nyams len byed pa: mtshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa: the'u rang sri la rku bzo gyo bur ye 'drog thams cad: 'byung po'i god 'dre byed pa: bse rag srod la rku bcu dar tshan nang gi stong 'asre: bdud btsan yongs kyi gnod 'askre: ma mo yongs kyi rims nad: nad dang mtshon gyi gru gu: rims nad gag lhog gzer gsum: mi nad sna dgu thams cad: rgan sri dar sri thams cad: byis pa'i chung sri thams cad: bdud kyi cho 'phrul gtong bzo gshin gyi dur sri langs bcu rus la tshig ngan gtong bcu snag la mtshan ngan bdags pa:rta nad nor nad thams cad: lo dgra btsa' sad ser gsumaca nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi: ltas ngan nyi khri chig stong : byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga: phyi yi ltas ngan phyi rtsa bar gyi ltas ngan dbyings su: mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun: bzlog go mdos dang zor gyis: bsgyur ro tshangs pa chen pos bsgyurazo zor ro dgra dang bgegs la zor/ /dri za'i rgyal po 'bar bcas kyis/ /mdos glud yas mchod 'di bzhes la / / dgra bgegs gcesad pa bsgyur ba dang / /ngathestol pa'i phrin las khrugab par malnga(da/ /thun gtor dang mnga' gsol gtong / bcu gcig pa glud yas rnams byin gyisabarlabs nas gtong ba/ bcu gnyisapa mdosaglud kha bsgyur zhing khram sna bsgyur ba/ bcu
gsum pa sgo dbye zhing lam bstan pa/ bcu bzhi pa gser skyems gtong ba/ bco lnga pa mjug zor gyisabacad pa: bcu drug pa yas gzhi sprug pa thams cad rnams raka'i gter ston gyi smad 'chong bzhin bya/ gtor ma phyir bdog la gser skyems 'bul/ hūX dri za'i rgyal lngardzo 17 rje 'bar ba rtsal 'khor tshogs dam can mthu rtsal dpung bskyed cig /mdos dang yas glud 'di yis sna drangs te/ /bdag sogs rgyu 'byor dmigs byar bcas pa la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs chags che ba/ /dug malhaman dmag 'khrug mthu byad keg ngan sri/ /mi phyug dal yams rims dang nad kyi rigs/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khrugs pa'i dal kha dang / /khyad par mtha' dbus rgyal bsen 'bordzong po'i lhanags/ /dam nyams sngags pa nag po ru trar skyes/ /btsun pa khrims 'chal smon lam log pa'i mthus/ /dam srid gyur nas mtho 'tshams bar chad kun/ /mi srun dgra bo sde dpung steng du bsgyur/ /bzlog go drag po mdos dang zor gyis bzlog /bhyo bhyo dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du bhyo/ /ba:rdzog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /cesabazlog pa bya zhing rol mo brdung mtshon cha brtab/ zhing lpags brdab/ bhyosagadab/ mi chusargyas 'debasashing phyi mig mi lta bar nang du log go/ bcu bdun par tshe 'gugs lhang mjug gi cho ga dkyusabazhin bya'o// smrasapa/ rten 'dzugs dam skyongs bzlog pa'i rnam dbye dag mi shesabal tshon lhang risa'ajam bsalas/ gang dran lag len zog gi bslu ba mkhan/ sngagasarlom de 'dra rol mo'i gar mkhan bzhin/ 'ga' zhig
༄༅/ /dpa' bo'i lusal rtagasapa'i zhen/ dpa' bo'i lugs pa rtogs pa'i zhen/ la la chad lta'i stong skad lta ba rngom/ phal cher zer mo'i tshogs la yid brtan 'dzin/ dpyad gsum dag na dkar po'i pho rog tu/ snga 'gyur sde dgon bzung dang gong chog dkor/ zosapa'i khral 'bab risasu sen min yang / sngagasapa'i gral rigs shog ser nyer mkho 'di/ dam pa'i zhabs rdul brten pa'i drin las rnyed/ snga ma mi 'tshol nga che khengs pas 'gyings/ thob gam bar nasame 'di'i khol po brim/ dbang thang tsam la rnam dkar phrin las zhes/ re rnams mun mal ñtsu bder gzim 'jam mdzod/dngosapa'i gshisalugs brjod na gzhan mtshang la/ phog ste drang pa'i gtam gyisadagra bo 'gug gcam bu'i tshig gi me tog 'thor ba na/ mi mngon dbyings nas dkon mchog khrel gyi dogs/ de lta'i khe nyen sems kyi snang cha tsam/ btags na ka dag rtog bral chosasku ru/ thag chod zhe blo med ba'i gdengs tshad kyis/ ci byas dam pa'i chosasu 'gyur ram snyam/ rang rig dag pa 'phang mchog nam mkha'i snying / kun rtog dregs pa'i mthu stobasaseng bde yis/ 'phrul gzugs dgra bgegs sgyu ma'i rta glang rdzong / rab 'phral gdod ma'i ye shesadar sbyor shog cesadri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rten mdosabaskang mdos/ bzlog mdosakyi rim pa rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul 'di ni gzhung lugs kyi po ti spyan shad tsam la gzigs pa yangs pa'i gsar ma phyogs la mkho byed med par ma zad/ snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin ral khur lci ba kho na mthu stobasache zhing bla gser 'jol ba tsam gyistshul khrims ldan pa rnamasal rnga thogs par yang mi snang yang bdag dang bdag 'dra'i sngags chung gsar bu rnams kyi dran gsosasu zur thams cad mkhyen pa chosadabyings rang grol dang khyab bdag khra tshang pa rnam gnyisakyi bka' drin las mdosaglud yas kyi phyag len la goms 'drisadang ldan pa'i za hor
gyi sngags smyon rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyisamagon po g.yul bzlog dang khro chu dug sdong nasakha cung zad bkang zhing gzhan ma'i tshig sbyor rnams gsar du bsgrigs te shing stag gro zhon zla ba'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshesal pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom btson 'jam dbyangs grags pasba3)tra/pa dza yantu/ 'khurba maṅga 95ma// //
༄tshi/ /zab gnad rten 'brel chos bdun 'di la gter ltar zhal khrig gdams ngag la/ 'og nas rig 'dzin chen po padma 'phrin las dang / skyabs gcig lo ban dharma shri dang rdo rje thogs med nas kha skong dang chog khrigs bkod pa dang ltoX yang lhan nas gsum gsum zil gnon la rdo rje'i srin pos zhus pa'i rtsa gsum cho ga bsgrig ma gter gzhung ltar chog khrig khog phab byas pa sogs/ de thams cad rang lugs dri ma med pa'i e waX cog sgar yab sras brgyud 'dzin bcas pa'i gzhung lugs ltar du babs pa'i zab gnyan gter gzhung de kho na la bsten nas legs sbyar babs nas 'dir cho ga'i gzhung 'phrin las de/ dang po 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs/ gu ru gnyen po stobs gsum bla ma ltar du bsgrub pa la/ dregs pa dbang bsdud dang / dregs pa dbang bsdud kyi 'phrin las chen po/ 'khor 'das dbang bsdud gsum yi dam ltar du bsgrub nas/ 'khor 'das dbang bsdud nas g.yon gyi phyogs nas phag mo gri thod can dang / skal bzang padma dbang phyug gam rdo rdze thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i kha skong bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mo rtsa gsum phyi dril can gnyis mkha' 'gro ltar sgrub dgos so/ /lha chen dbang phyug chen po 'khor mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi dang bcas pa de rnam par pho rgyud mo rgyud ltar bsgrub dgos te/ yang na lha chen dbang phyug chen po lha bdag
mdun g.yel med du bsgom nas/ khams gsum zil gnon gyi chog sgrig dang mthun pa byed/ bskul ba sum cu rtsa gsum la sten rigs bzhi gter gzhung sgrub khog nas kha skong byas nas khog phab dgos la/ yang na thod sgrub dang ar la gtad pa'i man ngag cho ka can ting / rlung nag can gyi bsgrubs pa/ myur zhag rlung gi 'khor lo/ nor bu bsam 'phel gyi sgrub pa/ 'di ston dbang phyug chen po'i 'phrin las gter gzhung dang mahā dhe wa'i sngags kyi 'phrin las dbang phyug skor brgya rtsa brgyad kyi 'phrin las bzlas pa'i sngags 'khor dang / skang du kha skang la bskang ba bshags pa chen mo'i 'phrin las zab gnad de tshogs 'khor dang sbyar nai sbyin zisreg la dngos 'phrin las chen po dpyi / dmigs gsal gter gzhud dbang bsdud sprabs kyi sbyin bsreg bde ba sprad can sdong sbrel te/ rang rang ga brag gi rdzas khyad par can rang rang gi las dang ma
༄tshi/ /byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs kyi par byang smon tshig bzhugs so/ / swasti/ 'di na rgyal ba nyid lhag bka' drin can/ /o rgyan rje des brtse bas gangs can pa'i/ /skal ba kho nar zab mo'i chos gter gyis/ /mtha' dbus kun tu nam mkha'i mdzod ltar gtams/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'a39) zhal rlangs ma yal ba/ /bskyed rjesags rjezlogs pa'i man ngag gzhan las kyang / /khyad 'phags lha brag mdzod chen lnga yi gter/ /chos tshul 'di yi dza gad nying bcud la/ /spyod pa'i skal chen du ma nyams rtogs kyis/ /rab myos do ha'i rgyang glu len dang bcas/ /'pho chen 'od sku'i gar gyis gshegs par grags/ /bstan 'gro'i srog rtsa bzung ba'i las tshogs kyang / /sna mang dgos pa kun tshang 'dir mchis pas/ /bod kyi blon po lta bu'i gter yin zhes/ /che thang nyid du padma'i lung gis bsngags/ /de phyir thubaX bstanaX 'dren la zla med pa'i/ /thugs bskyed shing rtas zab chos 'di'i nyi mbaX / /mi zad chos sbyin par gyi mkha' dbyings su/ /drangs par mdzad la snying nas rjes yi rangs/ /rlabs su che ba'i bstan pa'i bya ba la/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha dang ḍākkis kyang / /dbyings nas gzigs shing dga' ba'i gar dang bcas/ /bsngags pa'i me tog char du bsnyil bar nges/ /legs byas 'di yis rgyal bstan spyi bye
brag / snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs rgyas/ /de 'dzin skyes chen zhabs zung srid mthar brtan/ /phrin las rab rgyas bzhed don yongs 'grub shog /dge 'dun sde yi rol mtsho rgyas pa'i dbus/ /thugs mthun khrims kyi lhun po rmang nas brling / /bslab gsum la gnas bang rim rnam par brjid/ /bshad sgrub nyi zla'i rna chas rtag mdzes shog /'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par swa la'i ljongs/ /mi zad dus kyi rgud pa kun bral zhing / /snod bcud dge mtshan lang tsho dar drag pa'i/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /'dir 'bad 'brel bcas skye bar dam pa'i chos/ /chos bzhin spyod dang dge ba'i mthun rkyen yang / /yang dag 'byor sogs rten 'brel phun tshogs la/ /la 'ur 'jug nas byang chen myur 'thob therdzog /lam mchog 'di yang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing ltar/ /phrin las yal 'dab nam mkha'i bla brer bres/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i char gyis nor 'dzin khye1na/ /'gengs pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar rtag brtan phregag /ces par byang smon tshig g.yar khral tsam zhig rdo brag rig 'dzin bla ma'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs tsam phog pa'i mañdza'i ming can nas shin tu dga' gus yi rangs kyi ngang nas bris te rab byung bcu bdun pa'i kun 'dzin sa byi lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bzang po la phul// //
